  "content": "# Fused (residual_out = residual + alpha * x) + RMSNorm for MiniCPM-SALA.\n#\n# Why: each MiniCPMDecoderLayer does\n#   residual_new = residual + alpha * hidden_states   (alpha = scale_depth / sqrt(L))\n#   hidden_states = RMSNorm(residual_new) * weight\n# which costs two separate kernels and an extra HBM round-trip on `residual`.\n# This kernel does both in one pass: read x and residual once, compute\n# `r_new = r + alpha * x` in registers, RMSNorm + weight, write back r_new\n# and the normed output.\n#\n# Used by cross-layer residual passthrough refactor in MiniCPMDecoderLayer:\n# each layer's ln_pre absorbs the PREVIOUS layer's post-mlp residual add, and\n# ln_post absorbs THIS layer's post-attn residual add. Both via this kernel.\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport torch\nimport triton\nimport triton.language as tl\n\n\n@triton.jit\ndef _alpha_add_rmsnorm_kernel(\n    X_ptr,\n    R_ptr,\n    W_ptr,\n    OUT_ptr,\n    ROUT_ptr,\n    alpha,\n    eps,\n    n_cols,\n    stride_row,\n    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,\n):\n    row = tl.program_id(0)\n    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)\n    mask = cols < n_cols\n\n    x = tl.load(X_ptr + row * stride_row + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)\n    r = tl.load(R_ptr + row * stride_row + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)\n\n    r_new = r + alpha * x\n    tl.store(ROUT_ptr + row * stride_row + cols, r_new, mask=mask)\n\n    var = tl.sum(r_new * r_new, axis=0) / n_cols\n    rrms = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)\n    w = tl.load(W_ptr + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)\n    out = r_new * rrms * w\n    tl.store(OUT_ptr + row * stride_row + cols, out, mask=mask)\n\n\ndef alpha_add_rmsnorm(\n    x: torch.Tensor,\n    residual: torch.Tensor,\n    weight: torch.Tensor,\n    alpha: float,\n    eps: float,\n    out: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n    residual_out: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n):\n    \"\"\"Fused (r_new = residual + alpha * x) followed by RMSNorm * weight.\n\n    Returns:\n        out: (M, N) — RMSNorm of the new residual, scaled by weight\n        residual_out: (M, N) — the new residual (residual + alpha*x)\n\n    `residual_out` aliases `residual` allowed (in-place semantics) IF residual\n    is contiguous BF16/FP16 — we write before any further reads, so safe.\n    \"\"\"\n    assert x.is_cuda and residual.is_cuda\n    assert x.dtype == residual.dtype\n    assert x.is_contiguous() and residual.is_contiguous()\n    assert weight.shape == (x.shape[-1],)\n    assert x.shape == residual.shape\n\n    orig_shape = x.shape\n    if x.dim() != 2:\n        x2 = x.view(-1, orig_shape[-1])\n        r2 = residual.view(-1, orig_shape[-1])\n    else:\n        x2 = x\n        r2 = residual\n\n    m, n = x2.shape\n    if out is None:\n        out = torch.empty_like(x2)\n    if residual_out is None:\n        residual_out = torch.empty_like(x2)\n\n    BLOCK_N = triton.next_power_of_2(n)\n    assert BLOCK_N <= 8192, (\n        f\"alpha_add_rmsnorm: hidden={n} larger than supported BLOCK_N=8192\"\n    )\n\n    _alpha_add_rmsnorm_kernel[(m,)](\n        x2,\n        r2,\n        weight,\n        out,\n        residual_out,\n        float(alpha),\n        float(eps),\n        n,\n        x2.stride(0),\n        BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N,\n        num_warps=8,\n    )\n\n    if x.dim() != 2:\n        out = out.view(*orig_shape)\n        residual_out = residual_out.view(*orig_shape)\n    return out, residual_out\n"
}

  "new_string": "    def forward(\n        self,\n        positions: torch.Tensor,\n        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,\n        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,\n        residual: Optional[torch.Tensor],\n    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:\n        # Cross-layer residual passthrough path (cuts 4 ops × num_layers / chunk):\n        # - input `residual` carries layer i-1's POST-ATTENTION residual; layer\n        #   i-1 left the post-mlp add deferred.\n        # - input `hidden_states` is layer i-1's mlp_out (delta only, no\n        #   residual added).\n        # - ln_pre fuses the deferred post-mlp add: r_new = residual + alpha*hs;\n        #   out = RMSNorm(r_new) * w_pre.\n        # - ln_post fuses the post-attn add of THIS layer: r_new2 = r_new +\n        #   alpha*attn_out; out2 = RMSNorm(r_new2) * w_post.\n        # - return (mlp_delta, r_new2). MiniCPMModel.forward flushes the final\n        #   deferred add via self.norm.\n        if (\n            _MINICPM_RESIDUAL_PASSTHROUGH\n            and _alpha_add_rmsnorm is not None\n            and hidden_states.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)\n            and hidden_states.is_contiguous()\n        ):\n            if residual is None:\n                # Layer 0 — no deferred add to absorb. Standalone RMSNorm.\n                residual = hidden_states\n                _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n                hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)\n                _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"ln_pre_ms\")\n            else:\n                # Fuse deferred post-mlp add (from layer i-1) into ln_pre.\n                _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n                hidden_states, residual = _alpha_add_rmsnorm(\n                    hidden_states,\n                    residual,\n                    self.input_layernorm.weight.data,\n                    self.residual_scale,\n                    self.input_layernorm.variance_epsilon,\n                )\n                _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"ln_pre_ms\")\n\n            _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n            hidden_states = self.self_attn(\n                positions=positions,\n                hidden_states=hidden_states,\n                forward_batch=forward_batch,\n            )\n            _mm_profile_end(\n                _t0,\n                \"attn_standard_ms\" if self.mixer_type == \"minicpm4\" else \"attn_gla_ms\",\n            )\n\n            # Fuse post-attn add of THIS layer into ln_post.\n            _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n            hidden_states, residual = _alpha_add_rmsnorm(\n                hidden_states,\n                residual,\n                self.post_attention_layernorm.weight.data,\n                self.residual_scale,\n                self.post_attention_layernorm.variance_epsilon,\n            )\n            _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"ln_post_ms\")\n\n            _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n            hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)\n            _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"mlp_ms\")\n\n            # Defer the post-mlp add to next layer's ln_pre (or final flush).\n            return hidden_states, residual\n\n        # Legacy path: in-layer residual_add + plain RMSNorm.\n        residual = hidden_states\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)\n        _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"ln_pre_ms\")\n\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = self.self_attn(\n            positions=positions,\n            hidden_states=hidden_states,\n            forward_batch=forward_batch,\n        )\n        _mm_profile_end(\n            _t0,\n            \"attn_standard_ms\" if self.mixer_type == \"minicpm4\" else \"attn_gla_ms\",\n        )\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = torch.add(residual, hidden_states, alpha=self.residual_scale)\n        _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"residual_ms\")\n\n        # Fully Connected\n        residual = hidden_states\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)\n        _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"ln_post_ms\")\n\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)\n        _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"mlp_ms\")\n\n        _t0 = _mm_profile_begin()\n        hidden_states = torch.add(residual, hidden_states, alpha=self.residual_scale)\n        _mm_profile_end(_t0, \"residual_ms\")\n\n        return hidden_states, None"

  "new_string": "        aux_hidden_states = []\n        for i in range(len(self.layers)):\n            if i in self.layers_to_capture:\n                # Capture point semantic: this captures the FULL post-residual\n                # output of layer i-1 (matches EAGLE-3 training data collection\n                # convention). On the legacy path, layer i-1 returned\n                # `hidden_states = residual + alpha*mlp_out` (full state) and\n                # `residual = None`, so `hidden_states` is already the full\n                # state. On the passthrough path, layer i-1 deferred the\n                # post-mlp add, so we materialize it here.\n                if (\n                    _MINICPM_RESIDUAL_PASSTHROUGH\n                    and _alpha_add_rmsnorm is not None\n                    and residual is not None\n                ):\n                    aux_hidden_states.append(\n                        torch.add(\n                            residual,\n                            hidden_states,\n                            alpha=self.layers[i].residual_scale,\n                        )\n                    )\n                else:\n                    aux_hidden_states.append(hidden_states)\n            layer = self.layers[i]\n            hidden_states, residual = layer(\n                positions,\n                hidden_states,\n                forward_batch,\n                residual,\n            )\n            _eagle3_capture_layer(i, hidden_states)\n        # Flush deferred post-mlp add of the last layer (passthrough path only)\n        # and run final RMSNorm. We use plain `+` then RMSNorm rather than a\n        # fused alpha_add_rmsnorm_norm_only here because the saving is one op\n        # out of (32 layers × 4 ops + 1) = 129; the engineering cost of a\n        # separate \"no residual_out\" kernel outweighs the gain.\n        _fn = _mm_profile_begin()\n        if _MINICPM_RESIDUAL_PASSTHROUGH and residual is not None:\n            hidden_states = torch.add(\n                residual, hidden_states, alpha=self.layers[-1].residual_scale\n            )\n        hidden_states = self.norm(hidden_states)\n        _mm_profile_end(_fn, \"final_norm_ms\")"

> AGENT

诚实摊数字。先确认我之前的工作错在哪。

## 1. 之前为什么是鸡毛蒜皮

我做的三件事：
- **skip-early refactor** — 改 CPU 路径长度，不动 GPU 计算（wall delta = -0.05s 噪声内）
- **alpha_add_rmsnorm 单侧融合** — fused 1.52× 微观，wall +0.05s 噪声内
- **跨层 residual passthrough**（刚做完未 commit）— 删 128 个 small kernel 但 wall +0s 噪声内

错在哪：**只优化了"非 critical path"的小算子**。GPU 上 residual_add / rmsnorm 已经和大 GEMM 在 stream queue 里背靠背调度，删了一个 small op 不会让大 GEMM 提前结束 — 真正的 wall 由大 GEMM 串起来决定。

## 2. Wall 35s 的真实 GPU work 分布

64 chunks profile event time（INTERVAL=1，每 op 都 sync，总和 ≈ wall）：

| 算子 | total (s) | % 35s e2e | 性质 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **stage1_score (InfLLM-v2 block-score)** | 10.0 | **28%** | sparse attn 计算长 KV，O(N×Q) 走 hdim16 reduce |
| **mlp gate_up + down (NVFP4)** | 8.7 | **25%** | dense FP4 GEMM 32 层 |
| **attn_gla (Lightning Attention 24 层)** | 6.4 | **18%** | linear attn chunk kernel |
| **extend_sparse_fa (stage2 sparse FA)** | 5.2 | **15%** | FlashInfer sparse |
| 其余（residual / ln / qkv_proj / o_proj / quant / metadata） | ~5 | ~14% | 都不到 1% 单项 |

**5% wall = 1.75s。撬一项前 4 大就够，撬小项几个加起来够不到。**

## 3. 可能撬动 5%+ 的几条真正方向

| 方向 | 收益区间 | 复杂度 | 风险 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. InfLLM stage1 C++/CUDA kernel 融合**：`hdim16_reduce → score → max_pool → topk` 单 kernel 出 pooled+topk，省 stage1+sparse_topk 间的两次写回+读回 | 估算 1.5–3.0s wall（**4–8% e2e**）若内存 BW 不是 cap | 高，跨周 C++ 工程 | 精度对拍 bitwise 不能放（doc §2.11 教训） |
| **B. mlp gate_up SwiGLU+FP4 quant epilogue 融合**：FP4 GEMM accumulator 内直接 `silu(gate)*up` 输出 FP4 给 down，消掉 BF16 gate_up 中间态（256MB/chunk × 32 层 × 64 chunks = 524GB HBM 写回+读回）| 估算 0.5–1.5s wall（**1.5–4% e2e**）| 高，要写 SM120 CUTLASS gated blockscale epilogue（doc §3.24 已 lay 出来） | sm120 cuDNN/FlashInfer gated epilogue 不存在，要自己实现 |
| **C. stage2 sparse FA backend 重做**：page64 单 wrapper 或 BlockSparse 重写。doc §3.19-§3.22 验证过 page64 forward 9.81ms/call vs page1 10.04ms — 微小但 forward 数已经低。要更大收益必须改 KV layout | 估算 0.5–1.5s wall | 高 | doc 已记录否决路径 |
| **D. 算法隐藏 target+draft 末 chunk overlap**：target 末 chunk 拆 hidden-extract（前 95% 层）+ 残层；draft 跨流并行残层 | 估算 0.25s wall（**0.7%**）| 中，跨流调度 | 收益不到 5%，不值这个工程 |
| **E. 重测 chunked-prefill-size=16K**：之前 OOM 在 `mem_fraction_static=0.70`。把 mem_fraction 降到 0.55-0.60 让 16K chunk 跑通，chunk 数 64→32，**stage1 + sparse_topk plan 开销减半 + cuda graph 命中率高** | 估算 1.0–2.5s wall（**3–7% e2e**）若 plan 真是 wall 瓶颈 | 低，只调 mem fraction + chunk_size | mem 减少可能影响 KV 容量；要确认 batch / max_total_tokens 仍够 |

## 4. 我的判断

- **A** 是单项最大单 lever（28% e2e 中砍 20-30%），但跨周工程，单会话内完不成 — 可以**开始 audit kernel 源**为后续铺路
- **E** 是**最高 ROI 短期 lever**：只是 launch 参数调，几小时内能搞清楚是否真有 1+s wall 收益
- **B** 是第二大潜在 lever，但要写 SM120 CUTLASS，工程量类似 A
- **C** 已经基本探索枯竭
- **D** 收益不到 5%，不优先

**我推荐先确认 E**（chunk_size=16K + 降 mem_fraction），同时**审 stage1 C++ 源**估算 A 的可行性。

    raw_output = subprocess.check_output([cuda_dir + "/bin/nvcc", "-V"], universal_newlines=True)
    output = raw_output.split()
    release_idx = output.index("release") + 1
    bare_metal_version = parse(output[release_idx].split(",")[0])

502	    """
503	    Neighborhood Sparse Attention (NSA) Stage 1 with varlen support.
504	    
505	    This function performs the first stage of NSA, computing attention scores
506	    with a specific sparsity pattern where queries are grouped and only attend
507	    to a subset of keys.
508	    
509	    Arguments:
510	        q: (total_q, nheads, headdim), where total_q = total number of query tokens in the batch.
511	        k: (total_k, nheads_k, headdim), where total_k = total number of key tokens in the batch.
512	        v: (total_k, nheads_k, headdim), where total_k = total number of key tokens in the batch.
513	        cu_seqlens_q: (batch_size + 1,), dtype torch.int32. The cumulative sequence lengths
514	           of the sequences in the batch, used to index into q.
515	        cu_seqlens_k: (batch_size + 1,), dtype torch.int32. The cumulative sequence lengths
516	           of the sequences in the batch, used to index into k.
517	        cu_seqlens_v: (batch_size + 1,), dtype torch.int32. The cumulative sequence lengths
518	           of the sequences in the batch, used to index into v.
519	        max_seqlen_q: int. Maximum query sequence length in the batch.
520	        max_seqlen_k: int. Maximum key sequence length in the batch. 
521	            This is the k1_cache_len calculated based on the maximum context length, not based on the current k1 length.
522	        dropout_p: float. Dropout probability.
523	        softmax_scale: float. The scaling of QK^T before applying softmax.
524	            Default to 1 / sqrt(headdim).
525	        causal: bool. Whether to apply causal attention mask (e.g., for auto-regressive modeling).
526	        window_size: (left, right). If not (-1, -1), implements sliding window local attention.
527	        softcap: float. Anything > 0 activates softcapping attention.
528	        alibi_slopes: (nheads,) or (batch_size, nheads), fp32. A bias of
529	            (-alibi_slope * |i + seqlen_k - seqlen_q - j|)
530	            is added to the attention score of query i and key j.
531	        deterministic: bool. Whether to use the deterministic implementation.
532	        return_attn_probs: bool. Whether to return the attention probabilities.
533	        block_table: Optional block table for paged attention.
534	        nsa_group_size: int. Number of groups for neighborhood sparse attention.
535	        nsa_heads_per_group: int. Number of heads per group.
536	        
537	    Return:
538	        S_dmask: The attention scores/probabilities matrix with NSA sparsity pattern.
539	                 Shape: (num_heads_k, total_q, max_seqlen_k)
540	                 Note: max_seqlen_k is set to 2048 by default in the C++ implementation.

648	    If causal or local (i.e., window_size != (-1, -1)), the query @q will be rotated by rotary_cos
649	    and rotary_sin at indices cache_seqlens, cache_seqlens + 1, etc.
650	    If not causal and not local, the query @q will be rotated by rotary_cos and rotary_sin at

288	    index = starts_expanded + local_offsets
289	
290	    return a[index]

782	                torch.nan_to_num_(si, nan=0.0)
783	                torch.softmax(si, dim=-1, out=si)
784	                score[:, qs:qe, :klen] = si.sum(dim=1)        # (nkv, qlen, klen)

65	    // const int col_idx_offset = col_idx_offset_ + (lane_id % 4) * 2;
66	    // const int row_idx_offset = row_idx_offset_ + warp_id * 16 + lane_id / 4;
67	    const int col_idx_offset = 0 + (lane_id % 4) * 2;
68	    const int row_idx_offset = 0 + warp_id * 16 + lane_id / 4;
69	
70	    // step 1: 线程内部求和 (v0 + v2)
71	    using TensorT = decltype(make_tensor<float>(Shape< Int<size<0, 1>(tensor)>, Int<size<1>(tensor)> >{}));
72	    TensorT v02;
73	    clear(v02);
74	    #pragma unroll
75	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0, 1>(tensor); ++mi) {
76	        #pragma unroll
77	        for (int nj = 0; nj < size<1, 1>(tensor); ++nj) {
78	            #pragma unroll
79	            for (int j = 0; j < size<1, 0>(tensor); ++j) {
80	                const int col_idx_v02 = j * size<1, 1>(tensor) + nj;
81	                const float v0 = minusinf_to_zero(tensor(make_coord(0, mi), make_coord(j, nj)));
82	                const float v2 = minusinf_to_zero(tensor(make_coord(1, mi), make_coord(j, nj)));
83	                v02(mi, col_idx_v02) = v0 + v2;
84	            }
85	        }
86	    }
87	
88	    // step 2: warp 内部蝶形求和
89	    SumOp<float> sum_op;
90	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<16>(v02, sum_op);
91	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<8> (v02, sum_op);
92	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<4> (v02, sum_op);
93	
94	    // step 3: copy 到 global mem
95	    cutlass::NumericConverter<Element, float> converter;
96	    if (lane_id < 4) {
97	        #pragma unroll
98	        for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0, 1>(tensor); ++mi) {
99	            const int row_idx_base = row_idx_offset + mi * warp_row_stride;
100	            #pragma unroll
101	            for (int nj = 0; nj < size<1, 1>(tensor); ++nj) {
102	                const int col_idx_base = col_idx_offset + nj * 8;
103	                #pragma unroll
104	                for (int j = 0; j < size<1, 0>(tensor); ++j) {
105	                    const int col_idx = col_idx_base + j;
106	                    const int col_idx_v02 = j * size<1, 1>(tensor) + nj;
107	                    g_Sh(row_idx_base/16, col_idx) = converter(v02(mi, col_idx_v02)); // ignore /16 since it's too slow
108	                }
109	            }
110	        }
111	    }
112	}

116	template<typename ElementAccum, typename Params, int kBlockM, bool Is_even_MN>
117	__forceinline__ __device__ auto get_lse_tile(const Params &params, const int bidb, const int bidh, const int m_block, const BlockInfo</*Varlen=*/!Is_even_MN> &binfo) {
118	        // When params.unpadded_lse is false, LSE is written as (b, h, seqlen_q) - this is non-variable seqlen path.
119	        // Otherwise, when params.seqlenq_ngroups_swapped is true, it is written as (h, seqlen_q, b) to account for seqlen_q <-> h swapping trick.
120	        // Otherwise, it's written as (h, b, seqlen_q).
121	        const bool varlen_q = params.unpadded_lse && !params.seqlenq_ngroups_swapped;
122	        auto lse_offset = varlen_q ? binfo.q_offset(params.seqlen_q, 1, bidb) : 0;
123	        auto gmem_ptr_lse = make_gmem_ptr(reinterpret_cast<ElementAccum*>(params.softmax_lse_ptr) + lse_offset);
124	
125	        auto lse_shape = varlen_q ? make_shape(1, params.h, params.total_q) : make_shape(params.b, params.h, params.seqlen_q);
126	        auto lse_stride = params.seqlenq_ngroups_swapped ? make_stride(1, params.seqlen_q * params.b, params.b) : (
127	            params.unpadded_lse ? make_stride(params.h * params.total_q, params.total_q, 1) :  make_stride(params.h * params.seqlen_q, params.seqlen_q, 1)
128	            );
129	
130	        auto lse_layout = make_layout(lse_shape, lse_stride);
131	        Tensor mLSE = make_tensor(gmem_ptr_lse, lse_layout);
132	        auto mLSE_slice = varlen_q ? mLSE(0, bidh, _) : mLSE(bidb, bidh, _);
133	        return local_tile(mLSE_slice, Shape<Int<kBlockM>>{}, make_coord(m_block));
134	}

137	template<typename Kernel_traits, bool Is_dropout, bool Is_causal, bool Is_local, bool Has_alibi, bool Is_even_MN, bool Is_even_K, bool Is_softcap, bool Return_softmax, typename Params>
138	inline __device__ void compute_attn_1rowblock(const Params &params, const int bidb, const int bidh, const int m_block) {
139	
140	    using Element = typename Kernel_traits::Element;
141	    using ElementAccum = typename Kernel_traits::ElementAccum;
142	    using index_t = typename Kernel_traits::index_t;
143	
144	    // Shared memory.
145	    extern __shared__ char smem_[];
146	
147	    // The thread index.
148	    const int tidx = threadIdx.x;
149	
150	    constexpr int kBlockM = Kernel_traits::kBlockM;
151	    constexpr int kBlockN = Kernel_traits::kBlockN;
152	    constexpr int kHeadDim = Kernel_traits::kHeadDim;
153	    constexpr int kNWarps = Kernel_traits::kNWarps;
154	
155	    auto seed_offset = at::cuda::philox::unpack(params.philox_args);
156	    flash::Dropout dropout(std::get<0>(seed_offset), std::get<1>(seed_offset), params.p_dropout_in_uint8_t,
157	                           bidb, bidh, tidx, params.h);
158	
159	    // Save seed and offset for backward, before any early exiting. Otherwise the 0-th thread block might
160	    // exit early and no one saves the rng states.
161	    if (Is_dropout && blockIdx.x == 0 && blockIdx.y == 0 && blockIdx.z == 0 && tidx == 0) {
162	        params.rng_state[0] = std::get<0>(seed_offset);
163	        params.rng_state[1] = std::get<1>(seed_offset);
164	    }
165	
166	    const BlockInfo</*Varlen=*/!Is_even_MN> binfo(params, bidb);
167	    if (m_block * kBlockM >= binfo.actual_seqlen_q) return;
168	
169	    const int n_block_min = !Is_local ? 0 : std::max(0, (m_block * kBlockM + binfo.actual_seqlen_k - binfo.actual_seqlen_q - params.window_size_left) / kBlockN);
170	    int n_block_max = cute::ceil_div(binfo.actual_seqlen_k, kBlockN);
171	    if (Is_causal || Is_local) {
172	        n_block_max = std::min(n_block_max,
173	                               cute::ceil_div((m_block + 1) * kBlockM / params.m_block_dim + binfo.actual_seqlen_k - (binfo.actual_seqlen_q / params.m_block_dim) + params.window_size_right, kBlockN));
174	        // if (threadIdx.x == 0 && blockIdx.y == 0 && blockIdx.z == 0) {
175	        //     printf("m_block = %d, n_block_max = %d\n", m_block, n_block_max);
176	        // }
177	    }
178	    // We exit early and write 0 to gO and gLSE. This also covers the case where actual_seqlen_k == 0.
179	    // Otherwise we might read OOB elements from gK and gV.
180	    if ((Is_causal || Is_local || !Is_even_MN) && n_block_max <= n_block_min) {
181	        Tensor mO = make_tensor(make_gmem_ptr(reinterpret_cast<Element*>(params.o_ptr)
182	                                              + binfo.q_offset(params.o_batch_stride, params.o_row_stride, bidb)),
183	                                make_shape(binfo.actual_seqlen_q, params.h, params.d),
184	                                make_stride(params.o_row_stride, params.o_head_stride, _1{}));
185	        Tensor gO = local_tile(mO(_, bidh, _), Shape<Int<kBlockM>, Int<kHeadDim>>{},
186	                              make_coord(m_block, 0));  // (kBlockM, kHeadDim)
187	
188	        Tensor gLSE = get_lse_tile<ElementAccum, Params, kBlockM, Is_even_MN>(params, bidb, bidh, m_block, binfo);
189	
190	        typename Kernel_traits::GmemTiledCopyO gmem_tiled_copy_O;
191	        auto gmem_thr_copy_O = gmem_tiled_copy_O.get_thread_slice(tidx);

Stage1 kernel 是 TWO-PASS 设计（flash_fwd_kernel.h:1456-1742）：\n   - Pass 1：扫 K 算 row_max + row_sum（online softmax stat），不写 P\n   - Pass 2：再扫一遍 K 重算 QK^T，apply softmax_rescale_gt 用 final row_max/sum 归一化，\n     再 hdim16_reduce 写 P\n   - hdim16_reduce 是 SUM 不是 MAX（kernel.h:81-92 SumOp）→ P[h, m_block, k] = \n     sum_{q in group of 16} softmax(Q[q] · K[k]^T / sqrt(d))\n\n2. Production HBM 流量 (chunk_size=8192, 8 std layers):\n   - P shape per chunk i: (2, 8192, (i+1)*512) BF16\n   - Stage1 write P 总量 ≈ 270 GB\n   - Pool 读 P 总量 ≈ 270 GB\n   - HBM round-trip ≈ 540 GB → @900 GB/s ≈ 0.6s wall\n\n3. 测量 stage1 = 10s (28% e2e prefill, per docs/prefill/current.md)\n   → 10s >> 0.6s HBM RTT → stage1 NOT HBM-bound，是 GEMM compute-bound\n\n4. Fusion 收益边界：\n   - 纯 stage1→pool fusion 节省 HBM RTT = 0.6s = 1.6% e2e（FAR below 5% target）\n   - 改 single-pass GEMM 节省一半 compute = ~5s = 14% e2e（ABOVE 5% target）\n\n5. Single-pass GEMM 可行性：\n   - hdim16_reduce 是 sum 不是 max，所以不能用 softmax monotonicity 跳过 normalize\n   - 但可以做 streaming partial write + deferred rescale (rare row_max updates)\n   - 或 approximate: anchor max from first K block, 接受小精度损失\n   - max_pool + topk 是 selection 操作，对精度容忍度高\n\n下一步：需要做真实 ncu profile 验证 stage1 是 GEMM-bound（看 SM/Tensor Core util %）。"
}

236:### 2.8 alpha_add_rmsnorm fusion ❌ 否决 ✅ 2026-05-23
238:**动机**：MiniCPMDecoderLayer 每层有两次 `torch.add(residual, h, alpha=residual_scale)` 后接 RMSNorm。每次 add 多走一次 HBM 来回。triton kernel 把 `(residual + alpha*x) → RMSNorm` 融合一遍，理论省 ~5ms/chunk × 63 ≈ 300ms wall。
241:- 新写 `alpha_add_rmsnorm` triton kernel（单 BLOCK_N=4096 reduction，fp32 累加）
244:- microbench M=8192, N=4096: baseline 0.456ms, fused 0.301ms — **1.52× speedup**，0.155ms/call 省
250:| + alpha_add_rmsnorm | 35.277, 34.925, 34.930 | **34.93** | -0.055s (噪声内) |
253:- residual_ms 9.95 → 5.19ms/chunk（减半，与"消掉 post-attn add"一致）
254:- ln_post_ms 2.59 → 0（被 fused 吸收）
255:- 但 chunk total 不变（~1472ms）
257:**根因**：GPU timeline 的省时（~7.6ms/chunk）被其他 op（stage1_score 等）overlap 吸收，wall 不显。CUDA event timing 在重叠场景下高估了独立 op cost。
259:**判定**：**否决**。代码已 revert，artifact (`alpha_add_rmsnorm.py` + bench) 删除。教训：fused 路径在 CPU-launch-bound 场景下省 GPU 但不省 wall。MiniCPM 真正"省 add"的路只能是改 layer 函数签名走 Llama-style residual passthrough（next layer ln_pre 也吃 residual），整层省掉的 add 才进 wall。这是跨层 refactor，多日工程量，暂缓。

1	"""Microbench: does max_seqlen_k passed to infllmv2_attn_stage1 affect kernel runtime?
2	
3	Compares current production value (max_context_len//kernel_stride = 524288/16 = 32768)
4	vs actual per-batch max compressed K (e.g. 130K/16 = ~8192).
5	
6	If both take the same time → max_seqlen_k is just metadata, no gain from tightening.
7	If actual is faster → direct prefill speedup target.
8	"""
9	import torch
10	from infllm_v2 import infllmv2_attn_stage1
11	
12	torch.manual_seed(0)
13	dev = "cuda"
14	dtype = torch.float16
15	
16	KERNEL_STRIDE = 16
17	NHEADS_Q = 32
18	NHEADS_K = 2
19	HEAD_DIM = 128
20	CHUNK_Q = 8192               # current chunked-prefill-size
21	
22	
23	def make_inputs(total_q, total_k):
24	    q = torch.randn(total_q, NHEADS_Q, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
25	    k = torch.randn(total_k, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
26	    v = torch.randn(total_k, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
27	    cu_q = torch.tensor([0, total_q], dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
28	    cu_k = torch.tensor([0, total_k], dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
29	    return q, k, v, cu_q, cu_k
30	
31	
32	def time_call(fn, warmup=3, iters=20):
33	    for _ in range(warmup):
34	        fn()
35	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
36	    start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
37	    end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
38	    start.record()
39	    for _ in range(iters):
40	        fn()
41	    end.record()
42	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
43	    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters
44	
45	
46	def one_test(seq_ctx_tokens, label):
47	    """seq_ctx_tokens = actual KV context length (tokens), compressed by kernel_stride."""
48	    actual_compressed_k = seq_ctx_tokens // KERNEL_STRIDE
49	    q, k, v, cu_q, cu_k = make_inputs(CHUNK_Q, actual_compressed_k)
50	
51	    # Two max_seqlen_k values
52	    ms_actual = actual_compressed_k
53	    ms_padded = 524288 // KERNEL_STRIDE   # = 32768, production value
54	
55	    def run(ms_k):
56	        return infllmv2_attn_stage1(
57	            q.contiguous(), k.contiguous(), v.contiguous(),
58	            cu_seqlens_q=cu_q, cu_seqlens_k=cu_k, cu_seqlens_v=cu_k,
59	            max_seqlen_q=CHUNK_Q,
60	            max_seqlen_k=ms_k,
61	            causal=True,
62	        )
63	
64	    t_act = time_call(lambda: run(ms_actual))
65	    t_pad = time_call(lambda: run(ms_padded))
66	
67	    # Correctness: outputs should be identical up to the actual K slice
68	    with torch.no_grad():
69	        out_act = run(ms_actual)
70	        out_pad = run(ms_padded)
71	    # shape of stage1 output: (nheads_k, total_q, max_seqlen_k)
72	    assert out_act.shape[0] == NHEADS_K and out_pad.shape[0] == NHEADS_K
73	    common_k = min(out_act.shape[-1], out_pad.shape[-1])
74	    # Compare only over the actual compressed K region
75	    a = out_act[..., :common_k]
76	    b = out_pad[..., :common_k]
77	    finite_mask = torch.isfinite(a) & torch.isfinite(b)
78	    max_abs_diff = (a[finite_mask] - b[finite_mask]).abs().max().item() if finite_mask.any() else -1
79	
80	    print(
81	        f"[{label}] seq_ctx={seq_ctx_tokens} actual_cK={actual_compressed_k} "
82	        f"padded_cK={ms_padded}  | t_actual={t_act:.3f}ms  t_padded={t_pad:.3f}ms  "
83	        f"speedup={t_pad/t_act:.2f}x  max|diff|={max_abs_diff:.2e}"
84	    )
85	    return t_act, t_pad
86	
87	
88	if __name__ == "__main__":
89	    torch.cuda.init()
90	    print(f"device={torch.cuda.get_device_name()}")
91	    for ctx in [16384, 32768, 65536, 131072]:   # typical chunk-middle / mid / long / near max
92	        one_test(ctx, f"ctx={ctx}")
93

Wrap with:\n\n  ncu --target-processes all --kernel-name regex:mha_varlen_fwd_stage1 --launch-skip 10 \\\n       --launch-count 3 --section SchedulerStats --section LaunchStats \\\n       --section SpeedOfLight --section SpeedOfLight_RooflineChart \\\n       --section MemoryWorkloadAnalysis --section ComputeWorkloadAnalysis \\\n       --section Occupancy --section WarpStateStats \\\n       --csv python bench/infllmv2/bench_stage1_ncu.py\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom infllm_v2 import infllmv2_attn_stage1\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nKERNEL_STRIDE = 16\nNHEADS_Q = 32\nNHEADS_K = 2\nHEAD_DIM = 128\nCHUNK_Q = 8192\nITERS = 20\nWARMUP = 5\n\n# Pick the LAST chunk of a 524K-token prefill: compressed K ≈ 32768\n# (production max chunk has k1_compressed = total_kv/16 ≈ 32K at 524K context)\nCOMPRESSED_K = 32256          # = 63 * 512 (chunk 63 boundary)\n\n\ndef main():\n    dev = \"cuda\"\n    dtype = torch.bfloat16\n    q = torch.randn(CHUNK_Q, NHEADS_Q, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)\n    k = torch.randn(COMPRESSED_K, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)\n    v = torch.randn(COMPRESSED_K, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=dev, dtype=dtype)\n    cu_q = torch.tensor([0, CHUNK_Q], dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)\n    cu_k = torch.tensor([0, COMPRESSED_K], dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)\n    print(f\"q={q.shape} k={k.shape} dtype={dtype} cK={COMPRESSED_K}\")\n\n    def run():\n        return infllmv2_attn_stage1(\n            q.contiguous(), k.contiguous(), v.contiguous(),\n            cu_seqlens_q=cu_q, cu_seqlens_k=cu_k, cu_seqlens_v=cu_k,\n            max_seqlen_q=CHUNK_Q, max_seqlen_k=COMPRESSED_K,\n            causal=True,\n        )\n\n    for _ in range(WARMUP):\n        run()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True); e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)\n    s.record()\n    for _ in range(ITERS):\n        run()\n    e.record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    avg_ms = s.elapsed_time(e) / ITERS\n    print(f\"avg_stage1_ms={avg_ms:.3f}  cK={COMPRESSED_K}  total_q={CHUNK_Q}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    torch.cuda.init()\n    print(f\"device={torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    main()\n"
}

236	### 2.8 alpha_add_rmsnorm fusion ❌ 否决 ✅ 2026-05-23
237	
238	**动机**：MiniCPMDecoderLayer 每层有两次 `torch.add(residual, h, alpha=residual_scale)` 后接 RMSNorm。每次 add 多走一次 HBM 来回。triton kernel 把 `(residual + alpha*x) → RMSNorm` 融合一遍，理论省 ~5ms/chunk × 63 ≈ 300ms wall。
239	
240	**实施**：
241	- 新写 `alpha_add_rmsnorm` triton kernel（单 BLOCK_N=4096 reduction，fp32 累加）
242	- 接入 post-attention 路径：`residual + alpha*hidden_states + post_attention_layernorm` → 单次 fused
243	- env gate `SGLANG_MINICPM_ALPHA_ADD_RMSNORM=1`
244	- microbench M=8192, N=4096: baseline 0.456ms, fused 0.301ms — **1.52× speedup**，0.155ms/call 省
245	
246	**实测**（LAST_N=1, SWA=8K + skip-early）：
247	| config | 3 trials (s) | median | Δ |
248	|---|---|---:|---:|
249	| prior (skip-early only) | 35.375, 34.985, 34.962 | 34.985 | 0 |
250	| + alpha_add_rmsnorm | 35.277, 34.925, 34.930 | **34.93** | -0.055s (噪声内) |
251	
252	**profile 证据**（INTERVAL=1）：
253	- residual_ms 9.95 → 5.19ms/chunk（减半，与"消掉 post-attn add"一致）
254	- ln_post_ms 2.59 → 0（被 fused 吸收）
255	- 但 chunk total 不变（~1472ms）
256	
257	**根因**：GPU timeline 的省时（~7.6ms/chunk）被其他 op（stage1_score 等）overlap 吸收，wall 不显。CUDA event timing 在重叠场景下高估了独立 op cost。
258	
259	**判定**：**否决**。代码已 revert，artifact (`alpha_add_rmsnorm.py` + bench) 删除。教训：fused 路径在 CPU-launch-bound 场景下省 GPU 但不省 wall。MiniCPM 真正"省 add"的路只能是改 layer 函数签名走 Llama-style residual passthrough（next layer ln_pre 也吃 residual），整层省掉的 add 才进 wall。这是跨层 refactor，多日工程量，暂缓。
260	
261	---

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /user_4813494d/openbmb

# Ensure the project venv is active (scripts must not depend on caller's shell).
SALA_VENV="/opt/SGLang-MiniCPM-SALA/sglang_minicpm_sala_env"
if [[ "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" != "${SALA_VENV}" || "$(command -v python3)" != "${SALA_VENV}/bin/python3" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    source "${SALA_VENV}/bin/activate"
fi

# EAGLE-3 speculative decoding server (current production config)
# - spec_steps=3, topk=2, dtn=7  (chain verify, default D5 mode)
# - dynamic spec mode: NO_SPEC bs>=32, D7 bs<=1, D5 otherwise (theta 0.85/0.5)
# - ngram route: hit -> chain verify branch, miss -> EAGLE draft, both under cuda graph
# - target: NVFP4 (GPTQ + FourOverSix), hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS decode
# - draft:  det_prefill NVFP4 QAT, b12x explicitly off by default
#
# 只显式设置与 code 默认不同的 env；其余使用 code 默认值（参见
# sglang/srt/{environ.py,speculative/spec_mode.py,layers/.../*}）。
# 用户可在调用前 export 任一 SGLANG_*/EAGLE_* env 来覆盖。

SPEC_STEPS="${EAGLE_SPEC_STEPS:-5}"
TOPK="${EAGLE_TOPK:-2}"
# dtn = 1 + topk * spec_steps (tree nodes)
DTN=$((1 + TOPK * SPEC_STEPS))
TARGET_MODEL="${EAGLE_TARGET_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/models/openbmb/MiniCPM-SALA-gptq46-calib90-90k-NVFP4-det}"
DRAFT_MODEL="${EAGLE_DRAFT_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/data/eagle_stage/models/v3mix_300k_s6250_ind672}"
# MiniCPM-SALA sliding-window draft prefill: 仅最末 N tokens 进 draft prefill。
# 0 = 关闭(全量 draft prefill)。长上下文吞吐受益大(524K -> 32K 后 draft prefill ~16× 加速)。
# EAGLE-3 chain verify 无损,target 主链不受影响。
DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N="${EAGLE_DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N:-32768}"
# MiniCPM-SALA draft sliding-window attention: draft 自己的 1 层 attention 只读
# 最末 N tokens KV(真截断 kv_indices,不是 mask)。配合 prefix_last_n 用,且必须
# >= LAST_N + chunk_size(8192) 留 margin,保证 window 起点严格落在末 chunk 已写
# 入的 KV 范围(末 chunk 极端 1-token 时也安全)。0 = full attention。
DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW="${EAGLE_DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW:-40960}"
MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_MARS_THETA:-1}"
D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:-0.85}"
D7_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA:-0.5}"
RANDOM_SEED_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED:-}" ]]; then
    RANDOM_SEED_ARGS=(--random-seed "${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED}")
fi

echo "[start_eagle] MARS global=${MARS_THETA} D5=${D5_MARS_THETA} D7=${D7_MARS_THETA}"

SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE="${SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE:-/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/assets/mm_fp4_tune_sm120.json}" \
SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD="${SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD:-48}" \
CUTE_DSL_ARCH="${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_120a}" \
CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR="${CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR:-/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/assets/b12x_aot_cache}" \
SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X="${SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X:-0}" \
SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_GLA_QK_NORM_ROPE_OOP="${SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_GLA_QK_NORM_ROPE_OOP:-1}" \
SGLANG_MINICPM_GLA_FUSED_RMSNORM_SIGMOID_MUL="${SGLANG_MINICPM_GLA_FUSED_RMSNORM_SIGMOID_MUL:-1}" \
EAGLE_MARS_THETA="${MARS_THETA}" \
EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${D5_MARS_THETA}" \
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA="${D7_MARS_THETA}" \

exit 1; }\n\n# Generate per-kernel summary stats (avg, p50, p99) and breakdown\nnsys stats --report cuda_gpu_kern_sum --format csv,column \\\n    --output ./stage1_kern_sum --force-overwrite=true \"$REP\" 2>&1 | tail -5\nnsys stats --report cuda_gpu_trace --format csv \\\n    --output ./stage1_kern_trace --force-overwrite=true \"$REP\" 2>&1 | tail -5\n\necho \"=== Top-30 kernels by total GPU time ===\"\nhead -1 ./stage1_kern_sum_cuda_gpu_kern_sum.csv\ngrep -E 'mha_varlen_fwd_stage1|cute_kernel|gemm|sm120_xmma|marlin|max_pooling|compress|rotary|rms|rmsnorm|swiglu' \\\n    ./stage1_kern_sum_cuda_gpu_kern_sum.csv | head -30\n\necho \"\"\necho \"=== Stage1 specific stats ===\"\ngrep 'mha_varlen_fwd_stage1' ./stage1_kern_sum_cuda_gpu_kern_sum.csv\n\necho \"\"\necho \"=== Total GPU time vs Stage1 ===\"\npython3 - <<'PY'\nimport csv\nwith open('./stage1_kern_sum_cuda_gpu_kern_sum.csv') as f:\n    reader = csv.DictReader(f)\n    rows = list(reader)\ndef parse_ns(s):\n    return float(s.replace(',', ''))\ntotal_time_ns = sum(parse_ns(r['Total Time (ns)']) for r in rows)\nstage1_rows = [r for r in rows if 'mha_varlen_fwd_stage1' in r['Name']]\nstage1_total = sum(parse_ns(r['Total Time (ns)']) for r in stage1_rows)\nprint(f\"Total GPU kernel time = {total_time_ns/1e9:.3f} s\")\nprint(f\"Stage1 GPU time = {stage1_total/1e9:.3f} s ({100*stage1_total/total_time_ns:.1f}% of GPU)\")\n# Top 10 hottest kernels\nrows.sort(key=lambda r: -parse_ns(r['Total Time (ns)']))\nprint(\"\\n=== Top 10 hottest kernels ===\")\nfor r in rows[:10]:\n    name = r['Name'][:80]\n    t = parse_ns(r['Total Time (ns)']) / 1e9\n    cnt = r['Instances']\n    print(f\"  {t:6.3f}s  cnt={cnt:>6}  {name}\")\nPY\n"
}

}

from setuptools import setup, find_packages
import subprocess

import torch
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import (
    BuildExtension,
    CppExtension,
    CUDAExtension,
    CUDA_HOME,
)

# ninja build does not work unless include_dirs are abs path
this_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# FORCE_BUILD: Force a fresh build locally
# SKIP_CUDA_BUILD: Intended to allow CI to use a simple `python setup.py sdist` run to copy over raw files, without any cuda compilation
FORCE_BUILD = os.getenv("INFLLM_V2_FORCE_BUILD", "FALSE") == "TRUE"
SKIP_CUDA_BUILD = os.getenv("INFLLM_V2_SKIP_CUDA_BUILD", "FALSE") == "TRUE"
# For CI, we want the option to build with C++11 ABI since the nvcr images use C++11 ABI
FORCE_CXX11_ABI = os.getenv("INFLLM_V2_FORCE_CXX11_ABI", "FALSE") == "TRUE"

def get_cuda_bare_metal_version(cuda_dir):
    raw_output = subprocess.check_output([cuda_dir + "/bin/nvcc", "-V"], universal_newlines=True)
    output = raw_output.split()
    release_idx = output.index("release") + 1
    bare_metal_version = parse(output[release_idx].split(",")[0])

    return raw_output, bare_metal_version

def check_if_cuda_home_none(global_option: str) -> None:
    if CUDA_HOME is not None:
        return
    # warn instead of error because user could be downloading prebuilt wheels, so nvcc won't be necessary.
    warnings.warn(
        f"{global_option} was requested, but nvcc was not found.  Are you sure your environment has nvcc available?  "
        "If you're installing within a container from https://hub.docker.com/r/pytorch/pytorch, "
        "only images whose names contain 'devel' will provide nvcc."
    )

def append_nvcc_threads(nvcc_extra_args):

110	template<typename Kernel_traits, bool Is_causal>
111	void run_flash_splitkv_fwd(Flash_fwd_params &params, cudaStream_t stream) {
112	    static_assert(!Kernel_traits::Is_Q_in_regs, "SplitKV implementation does not support Is_Q_in_regs");
113	    static_assert(!Kernel_traits::Share_Q_K_smem, "SplitKV implementation does not support Share_Q_K_smem");
114	    constexpr size_t smem_size = Kernel_traits::kSmemSize;
115	    const int num_m_block = (params.seqlen_q + Kernel_traits::kBlockM - 1) / Kernel_traits::kBlockM;
116	    dim3 grid(num_m_block, params.num_splits > 1 ? params.num_splits : params.b, params.num_splits > 1 ? params.b * params.h : params.h);
117	    const bool is_even_MN = params.cu_seqlens_q == nullptr && params.cu_seqlens_k == nullptr && params.seqlen_k % Kernel_traits::kBlockN == 0 && params.seqlen_q % Kernel_traits::kBlockM == 0;
118	    const bool is_even_K = params.d == Kernel_traits::kHeadDim;
119	    BOOL_SWITCH(is_even_MN, IsEvenMNConst, [&] {
120	        EVENK_SWITCH(is_even_K, IsEvenKConst, [&] {
121	            // LOCAL_SWITCH((params.window_size_left >= 0 || params.window_size_right >= 0) && !Is_causal, Is_local, [&] {
122	            constexpr static bool Is_local = false; { // TODO remove debug info
123	                BOOL_SWITCH(params.num_splits > 1, Split, [&] {
124	                    BOOL_SWITCH(params.knew_ptr != nullptr, Append_KV, [&] {
125	                        // ALIBI_SWITCH(params.alibi_slopes_ptr != nullptr, Has_alibi, [&] {
126	                        constexpr static bool Has_alibi = false; { // TODO remove debug info
127	                            // SOFTCAP_SWITCH(params.softcap > 0.0, Is_softcap, [&] {
128	                            constexpr static bool Is_softcap = false; { // TODO remove debug info
129	                                // If Append_KV, then we must have seqlen_offsets, which means cu_seqlens_k != nullptr.
130	                                // If not IsEvenKConst, we also set IsEvenMNConst to false to reduce number of templates.
131	                                // If Is_local, set Is_causal to false
132	                                auto kernel = &flash_fwd_splitkv_kernel<Kernel_traits, Is_causal, Is_local && !Is_causal, Has_alibi, IsEvenMNConst && !Append_KV && IsEvenKConst && !Is_local && Kernel_traits::kHeadDim <= 128, IsEvenKConst, Is_softcap, Split, Append_KV>;
133	                                // auto kernel = &flash_fwd_splitkv_kernel<Kernel_traits, Is_causal, false, true, Split, Append_KV>;
134	                                // auto kernel = &flash_fwd_splitkv_kernel<Kernel_traits, Is_causal, false, IsEvenKConst>;
135	                                if (smem_size >= 48 * 1024) {
136	                                    C10_CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
137	                                        kernel, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, smem_size));
138	                                }
139	                                kernel<<<grid, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, smem_size, stream>>>(params);
140	                                C10_CUDA_KERNEL_LAUNCH_CHECK();
141	                            }
142	                        }
143	                    });
144	                });
145	            }
146	        });
147	    });
148	    if (params.num_splits > 1) {
149	        // We want kBlockM to be as small as possible for more parallelism.
150	        // With 128 threads we can load 512 elements at a time, so if headdim is divisible by 128, kBlockM = 4.
151	        // If headdim is divisible by 64, then we set kBlockM = 8, etc.
152	        constexpr static int kBlockM = Kernel_traits::kHeadDim % 128 == 0 ? 4 : (Kernel_traits::kHeadDim % 64 == 0 ? 8 : 16);
153	        dim3 grid_combine((params.b * params.h * params.seqlen_q + kBlockM - 1) / kBlockM);
154	        EVENK_SWITCH(is_even_K, IsEvenKConst, [&] {
155	            if (params.num_splits <= 2) {
156	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 1, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
157	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 4) {
158	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 2, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
159	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 8) {
160	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 3, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
161	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 16) {
162	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 4, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
163	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 32) {
164	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 5, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
165	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 64) {
166	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 6, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
167	            } else if (params.num_splits <= 128) {
168	                flash_fwd_splitkv_combine_kernel<Kernel_traits, kBlockM, 7, IsEvenKConst><<<grid_combine, Kernel_traits::kNThreads, 0, stream>>>(params);
169	            }
170	            C10_CUDA_KERNEL_LAUNCH_CHECK();
171	        });
172	    }
173	}

215	template<typename T, int Headdim, bool Is_causal>
216	void run_mha_fwd_splitkv_dispatch(Flash_fwd_params &params, cudaStream_t stream) {
217	    if (params.blockmask == nullptr) {
218	        constexpr static int kBlockM = 64;  // Fixed for all head dimensions
219	        // TD [2023-08-28]: nvcc segfaults for headdim 96 with block size 64 x 256,
220	        // and for headdim 192 with block size 64 x 128.
221	        // Also for headdim 160 with block size 64 x 128 after the rotary addition.
222	        constexpr static int kBlockN = Headdim <= 64 ? 256 : (Headdim <= 128 ? 128 : 64);
223	        if (params.m_block_dim == 1) {
224	            run_flash_splitkv_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, kBlockM, kBlockN, 4, false, false, T>, Is_causal>(params, stream);
225	        } else {
226	            run_flash_splitkv_fwd_stage1<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, 16, 64, 1, false, false, T>, Is_causal>(params, stream);
227	        }
228	    } else if (params.cu_seqlens_q != nullptr) {
229	        constexpr static int kBlockM = 16;
230	        constexpr static int kBlockN = 64;
231	        run_flash_splitkv_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, kBlockM, kBlockN, 1, false, false, T>, Is_causal>(params, stream);
232	    } else {
233	        constexpr static int kBlockM = 64;
234	        constexpr static int kBlockN = 64;
235	        run_flash_splitkv_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, kBlockM, kBlockN, 4, false, false, T>, Is_causal>(params, stream);
236	    }
237	}

247	template<typename T, bool Is_causal>
248	void run_mha_fwd_hdim64(Flash_fwd_params &params, cudaStream_t stream) {
249	    constexpr static int Headdim = 64;
250	    DROPOUT_SWITCH(params.p_dropout < 1.f, Is_dropout, [&] {
251	        if constexpr(!Is_dropout) {
252	            // Using 8 warps is 18% slower for seqlen=2k, 2 warps is 5% slower
253	            // Using block size (64 x 256) is 27% slower for seqlen=2k
254	            // Using block size (256 x 64) is 85% slower for seqlen=2k, because of register spilling
255	            run_flash_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, 16, 64, 1, false, false, T>, Is_dropout, Is_causal>(params, stream);
256	            // run_flash_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, 128, 64, 4, true, false, T>, Is_dropout, Is_causal>(params, stream);
257	            // run_flash_fwd<Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<Headdim, 128, 64, 4, true, true, T>, Is_dropout, Is_causal>(params, stream);

  "content": "\"\"\"Microbench: baseline vs INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SINGLE_PASS_RAW single layer stage1.\n\nCompares per-call kernel time at production-realistic chunk_size=8192, compressed_K=32256.\nThe env must be set BEFORE first call (cached static bool in flash_api.cpp).\n\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport torch\n\nKERNEL_STRIDE = 16\nNHEADS_Q = 32\nNHEADS_K = 2\nHEAD_DIM = 128\nCHUNK_Q = 8192\nITERS = 30\nWARMUP = 5\n\nMODE = os.environ.get(\"MODE\", \"baseline\")\nif MODE == \"single_pass\":\n    os.environ[\"INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SINGLE_PASS_RAW\"] = \"1\"\nelse:\n    os.environ.pop(\"INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SINGLE_PASS_RAW\", None)\n\n# Import AFTER env is set (static bool cache in flash_api.cpp)\nfrom infllm_v2 import infllmv2_attn_stage1\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\n\n\ndef make_inputs(total_q, total_k):\n    q = torch.randn(total_q, NHEADS_Q, HEAD_DIM, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    k = torch.randn(total_k, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    v = torch.randn(total_k, NHEADS_K, HEAD_DIM, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    cu_q = torch.tensor([0, total_q], dtype=torch.int32, device=\"cuda\")\n    cu_k = torch.tensor([0, total_k], dtype=torch.int32, device=\"cuda\")\n    return q, k, v, cu_q, cu_k\n\n\ndef bench(label, total_k):\n    q, k, v, cu_q, cu_k = make_inputs(CHUNK_Q, total_k)\n\n    def run():\n        return infllmv2_attn_stage1(\n            q.contiguous(), k.contiguous(), v.contiguous(),\n            cu_seqlens_q=cu_q, cu_seqlens_k=cu_k, cu_seqlens_v=cu_k,\n            max_seqlen_q=CHUNK_Q, max_seqlen_k=total_k,\n            causal=True,\n        )\n\n    for _ in range(WARMUP):\n        run()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True); e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)\n    s.record()\n    for _ in range(ITERS):\n        run()\n    e.record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    return s.elapsed_time(e) / ITERS\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    torch.cuda.init()\n    print(f\"MODE={MODE} device={torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    for ck in [1024, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32256]:\n        t = bench(MODE, ck)\n        print(f\"cK={ck:>6d}  avg_ms={t:.4f}\")\n"
}

262	### 2.14 GLA fused o_norm + sigmoid + mul (3-in-1 triton)
263	
264	代码：`demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm.py::_minicpm_gla_rmsnorm_sigmoid_mul`
265	
266	| env | 默认 |

268	| `SGLANG_MINICPM_GLA_FUSED_RMSNORM_SIGMOID_MUL` | `1` （已默认开启） |

271	替代：
272	```python
273	# 原: 3 kernel
274	o = self.o_norm(o)        # sgl_kernel.rmsnorm
275	z = self.z_proj(...)
276	o = o * F.sigmoid(z)      # 2 kernels: sigmoid + mul
277	```
278	
279	合一 triton kernel 全 fp32 计算：
280	```
281	m[i,j] = o[i,j] * rstd[i] * w[j] * sigmoid(z[i,j])
282	```

286	- microbench (M=8192, H=4096, BLOCK_M=4 num_warps=4) ref 225us → 156us / call

289	线上 PROFILE=1：`o_norm 1.96 + sigmoid_mul 2.44 = 4.4 ms` → `o_norm_sigmoid_mul 3.47 ms` (-1ms / chunk)。

305	
306	## 3. 已否决路线
307	
308	每条记录：做了什么 / 为什么失败 / 不要再做什么。
309	
310	### 3.1 fi_convert 跨层缓存
311	
312	旧结论"同 forward 8 层 page table 相同"是错的：tensor 指针相同，但每个 standard layer 都按本层 q/k 重写内容。仅保留 `SGLANG_MINICPM_UNSAFE_FI_CONVERT_CACHE=1` 实验开关，不可线上。
313	
314	### 3.2 TrtLLM stage2 替换
315	
316	长上下文 sparse stage2 实际是 decode-style（`max_seqlen_q==1`）；FlashInfer causal 是 right-aligned，TrtLLM `mask_mode="causal"` 在 `q_len << kv_len` 时语义不等价。HEAD 已不含 `_USE_TRTLLM_STAGE2`。除非先做 right-aligned causal 等价的离线证明，否则不要继续。
317	
318	### 3.3 fast prefill stage1
319	
320	`SGLANG_FAST_PREFILL_STAGE1=1` 默认关闭。当前实现 k1-only 丢 k2 语义，没有完整复现官方 causal/full-layout pooler，topk match 差且不快。
321	
322	### 3.4 compressed maxlen 旧方案
323	
324	不能缩 `max_pooling_1d_varlen.max_context_len` / score full layout。精度根因在 pooler layout/边界语义，topk 放大后会改变 sparse blocks。当前可用的是 §2.5 stage1 actual maxlen + full-layout scratch/direct-pool guard。
325	
326	### 3.5 compressed-K buffer 复用
327	
328	缓存 `compressed_k/k2` 后 `fill_(-inf)` 实测 15chunk 打平（7.609 vs 7.602s），`compress_k_buffer_prefill_ms≈0.03ms/call`。不值得维护成本。
329	
330	### 3.6 `--fuse-topk`
331	
332	global 启用导致 target CUDA graph capture 6.5→14.4s，`decode_topk_ms` 跳到 16ms，运行中触发 CUDA illegal memory access（栈在 FlashInfer decode forward 后 synchronize）。是 decode/verify 路径风险，不是 prefill 优化。
333	
334	prefill-only 复查：`compressed_attention_tilelang` vs `compressed_attention` topk 大面积不匹配（如 `bad_sorted=19315/24576`），TileLang 只吃 `k1` 没复现 `k2/v` 语义。除非重写一个真正复现 stage1+k2 的 kernel，否则禁用。
335	
336	### 3.7 MLP cuDNN（down-only / full-chunk）
337	
338	- down 单独 cudnn：`max_diff=0` 但 `mlp_down_ms` 49→52-56ms（更慢）。
339	- 整 MLP `M=8192` cudnn：`gate/up/down max_diff=0`，但非 power-of-two M 出现明显 diff（`M=2754/6144`），且 `M=8192` e2e `down` 常更慢。
340	- `auto` 后端：tail M 选与 cutlass 不一致路径。
341	
342	不要新增 MLP cuDNN shape gate。
343	
344	### 3.8 stage1 q repeat
345	
346	`current_ratio < 16` 的 q repeat 在生产路径不触发（实测 `q_heads=32 kv_heads=2` ratio=16），跳过 repeat 的开关是 no-op。
347	
348	### 3.9 MLP activation buffer cache
349	
350	给 `SiluAndMul` 输出加全局 buffer，`mlp_act_ms` 不变，wall 无改善，还多占显存。
351	
352	### 3.10 跨层 topk 复用
353	
354	15chunk full chunk 相邻 standard sparse layer `ret` 完全一致率：首个 8K chunk 0.887-0.918，第二个起 0.423-0.476。不是稳定可复用元数据；强行复用是近似注意力语义改动。
355	
356	### 3.11 chunked-prefill-size 16384
357	
358	8192 vs 16384：avg `7.605s` vs `7.751s`。chunk 数从 15 减到 8 但单 chunk 退化抵消调度收益（`extend_sparse_fa` 11-12→23-24ms/层，MLP 150→350ms/chunk，GLA 110→205ms）。
359

361	
362	补 MLP/qkv 完整 chunk shape 后 microbench 小幅改善（`gate_up 3.93→3.89ms`，`std_qkv 0.59→0.55ms`，`max_diff=0`），但真实 15chunk wall 在噪声内。不为此更新提交包 cache。
363	
364	### 3.13 FlashInfer sparse stage2 backend / split-KV 参数
365	
366	- `default(auto)+TC` ≈ `7617us`，`fa2+TC` ≈ `7590us`；`fa2`/`fa3`/`cutlass`/`trtllm-gen` 失败或不支持当前 group/shape。
367	- `use_tensor_cores=False` 不支持 `group_size=16`；`fixed_split_size` 更小需 GB 级 workspace；`disable_split_kv` 更慢。
368	- `flash_attn_with_kvcache` sparse page-table 路径不可用：`Can not import FA3 in sgl_kernel`。
369	- 同 `q_len=1` row 化：decode wrapper 与 prefill wrapper `max_diff=0` 且性能相同，强切 prefill wrapper 无收益。
370	
371	stage2 backend 旋钮已枯竭；要继续必须改 KV/block layout 或写等价 kernel。
372	
373	### 3.14 stage1 mask / dtype 快捷路径
374	
375	- `causal=False`：生产 adjusted-q shape 比 `causal=True` 更慢且 topk 大面积变化（`bad 972658/1572864`）。
376	- 输入转 fp16：速度持平，topk 大面积变化（`bad 1500035/1572864`）。
377	- 真实生产 stage1 不是裸 `q=8192`：wrapper 把 32Q/2KV 的 16 group 展到序列维，C++ 的 `max_seqlen_q_adjusted=131072`。早期 `q=8192,1.7ms` microbench 不是线上形态。
378	- 缩 `max_seqlen_q_adjusted` 到 `min(q*16, k1*16)`：变快但 topk 大面积变化（`k1=4095` bad 777303）。adjusted-q 不是单纯 launch bound，参与 causal/pool 边界语义。
379	- `kBlockN=128` stage1 trait（本地构建）：`10.07→16.40ms`，且 `topk_order_same=0.99485`，已撤回。
380	
381	stage1 高收益路必须改 InfLLM C++/CUDA：把 `hdim16_reduce → score → max_pool → topk` 融合直接产出 pooled/topk，或重写完整等价 kernel；不能做 topk 缩限或候选裁剪。
382	
383	### 3.15 GLA chunk kernel 替换
384	
385	| 路径 | 时间 / 一致性 |
386	|---|---|
387	| `chunk_simple_gla` baseline | `0.60ms`，bitwise OK |
388	| `chunk_size=128` | `0.46ms`，**output max_diff=0.25**（不可用）|
389	| `fused_chunk_simple_gla` | `0.83ms`，**更慢且 output 不一致** |

391	GLA 简单 chunk-size/API 替换不可行。要继续必须写形状特化的等价 kernel 或动 qkv layout（v 非 contig stride）。

395	- input quant 复用：命中一致（`fp4_equal=True`），但 wall 在噪声内。
396	- qkv + output gate FP4 GEMM 融合：`mm_fp4` 只有单个 `alpha`，weight `weight_scale_2` 不同（如 L1 lightning q/k/v `0.0001313` vs `z_proj 0.00015394`），强行合并改 bf16 舍入语义。除非有 per-output alpha 的 GEMM。

406	`SGLANG_MINICPM_PROFILE_TOPK_ADJ=1` profile 真实 line39 第二个 full chunk 起：

409	- 两 head group `head_group_equal`：L0 `0.0013`，其余 `0.0000-0.0010`。

413	### 3.19 stage2 BlockSparse split + LSE merge
414	
415	完整探索（已撤回，备份 `outputs/prefill_experiments/stage2_blocksplit_unlanded.patch`）：
416	
417	- profile 确认第二个 full chunk 起每层 `95 full + 1 partial blocks`。
418	- `BlockSparseAttentionWrapper(R=1,C=64)` 双 head-group forward-only `9.11ms` vs page1 expanded `10.11ms`，离线约 `+10%`；BlockSparse + page64 partial + Triton log2-LSE merge 单 head `4.74→4.95ms`，约 `+4%`，对拍 `cos=0.99999857 max_diff=0.000488`。
419	- 旧 LSE merge 失败原因记录：FlashInfer LSE 是 log2 域，必须用 `2 ** (lse - max_lse)`，不是 `exp`。
420	- gate 唯一可用的是 `metadata.token_pos_in_bs.min() >= topk_tokens`；`extend_prefix_lens_cpu` / `seq_lens_cpu` 都不可靠。
421	- 线上接入 `SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE2_BLOCKSPLIT=1`：第二 full chunk 命中 split (`use_split=True, offset=63`)，但 `extend_sparse_fa` 没有下降（118.6ms / 后续 82-84ms），no-profile 15chunk avg `7.114s` vs default `7.110s`。
422	
423	离线 `+4%` forward-only 没穿透 wall，`q_h.contiguous()` / 双 wrapper / merge 开销吃光收益。同构 split 接入路线封死，重启必须换 KV/block layout 或单 wrapper / 单 kernel 的完整等价实现。

431	### 3.21 Triton 直写 stage2
432	
433	生产近似 `rows=16384, topk=96x64, seq=131072` bf16：`triton_direct=10.37ms` vs FlashInfer forward + `topk_to_fi_indices=10.13ms`，慢 ~2.4%。tile sweep（`NQ=4096` 单 head-group）最佳 Triton `BH16 BN64 W4 2.69ms` vs FlashInfer `2.27ms`，仍慢 18%。简单 streaming-softmax Triton 不能赢 FlashInfer；要继续需要更接近 FlashInfer 的 split/reduce 结构。

439	### 3.23 MLP dense-as-MoE fused path
440	
441	目标：用 FlashInfer `cutlass_fused_moe` 把 dense MLP 当成 1-expert/top1 MoE，覆盖 `gate_up GEMM -> SiLU*mul FP4 quant -> down GEMM` 整段。
442	
443	验证脚本：`bench/kernels/minicpm/bench_mlp_dense_as_moe_fp4.py`。
444	
445	结果：
446	
447	| Shape | baseline | dense-as-MoE | speedup | diff |
448	|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
449	| M=512 | 0.235ms | 0.322ms | 0.731x | max=0 |
450	| M=2754 | 2.147ms | 2.157ms | 0.995x | max=0 |
451	| M=8192 | 6.119ms | 6.060ms | 1.010x | max=0 |
452	
453	结论：
454	- 数值链条可行：MiniCPM dense `[gate, up]` 需转成 FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE 期望的 `[up, gate]`，scale 同步交换后 synthetic 对拍 `max_diff=0`。
455	- 收益不足：full chunk 仅 `+1.0%/layer`，折到 32 层约 `1.9ms/chunk`，低于接入复杂度和 MoE route/runner 风险。
456	- 工程风险：首次触发会编译 `/user_4813494d/.cache/flashinfer/0.6.8.post1/120f/cached_ops/fused_moe_120/fused_moe_120.so`（约 84MB，目录约 192MB）。默认并发编译曾 exit 137；`MAX_JOBS=1` 可完成但耗时约 80s。
457	
458	不进生产。真正有价值的 MLP 方向仍是 dense FP4 GEMM 自身 epilogue 融合，避免写出 `gate_up` BF16 中间结果，而不是复用 MoE runner。
459	
460	### 3.24 MLP gate_up epilogue 融合调查
461	
462	当前线上 MLP 路径：
463	
464	```text
465	fp4 gate_up GEMM -> BF16 gate_up [M, 2*inter]
466	BF16 gate_up -> silu(gate)*up + FP4 quant
467	FP4 activation -> fp4 down GEMM
468	```
469	
470	profile 证据（15chunk/full chunk 口径）：
471	
472	- `mlp_gate_up_ms≈85-92ms/chunk`
473	- `mlp_swiglu_fp4_quant_ms≈16.2ms/chunk`
474	- `mlp_down_fp4_quantized_ms≈47-51ms/chunk`
475	- gate_up BF16 中间态约 `8192 * 32768 * 2B = 512MB/chunk`，后续 swiglu+quant 再读一遍。
476	
477	核心收益点不是替换 swiglu 小 kernel，而是让 gate_up GEMM epilogue 直接输出 down_proj 需要的 FP4 activation + scale，消掉 BF16 gate_up 的写回/读回和独立 activation launch。
478	
479	已确认的底层边界：
480	
481	- FlashInfer SM120 FP4 GEMM 生产模板当前 epilogue 是普通 `LinearCombination<OutElementType, float, void, float>`，只输出 BF16/FP16。
482	- CUTLASS SM120 已有 `LinCombBlockScaleFactor` / `LinCombEltActBlockScaleFactor` 和 `Sm120BlockScaleFactorRowStore`，支持在 epilogue 生成 FP4 输出和 scale。
483	- 现成 blockscale epilogue是逐元素 unary activation，不能直接表达 SwiGLU 的 pairwise `up * silu(gate)`，也不能把 GEMM 的 `N=2*inter` 存成 `N=inter`。
484	- cuDNN `gemm_swiglu_wrapper_sm100` 和 FlashInfer CuteDSL SM100/103 kernel 语义正确：权重按 `[up32, gate32, ...]` 交错，epilogue 从两个 accumulator subtile 取 up/gate，计算 SwiGLU，可生成 FP4 scale。但当前 RTX 6000D `sm120` 编译失败，报 `expects arch to be one of [Arch.sm_100a, Arch.sm_103a], got Arch.sm_120a`。
485	- TensorRT-LLM/FlashInfer SM120 TMA grouped MoE 代码明确限制：`TMA Warp Specialized Grouped GEMM specialisation doesn't support fused activation`。这解释了 dense-as-MoE 只有约 1% 收益。
486	
487	SM120 blockscale epilogue 探针：
488	
489	脚本：`bench/kernels/minicpm/bench_fp4_blockscale_epilogue_sm120.py`。
490	
491	结果（RTX 6000D，`M=1024,K=4096,N=4096` synthetic）：
492	
493	| 路径 | time |
494	|---|---:|
495	| baseline FP4 GEMM -> BF16 | 0.0935ms |
496	| BF16 post FP4 quant | 0.0203ms |
497	| direct FP4 blockscale epilogue | 0.0620ms |
498	
499	`out_fp4` / `out_sf` 可直接喂现有 `fp4_gemm` down path（`y_sf.view(m, n//16)`）。对比“BF16 落地后再量化”的 down-stream 输出：`max_diff=0.0072, mean_diff=0.000895, ref_abs_mean=0.0260`。这不是 bitwise 等价，但属于可接受的 FP4 量化舍入差异；后续以 e2e 精度/线上验证为准，不再把 bitwise 作为 fused epilogue 的硬目标。
500	
501	e2e 边界：当前 MiniCPM 在线主路径没有“FP4 GEMM 输出 BF16 后立刻 FP4 quant，且中间无非线性”的合法替换点。MLP 是 `gate_up -> SwiGLU -> quant -> down`，direct blockscale epilogue 只能证明“GEMM 直接输出 FP4”底座有收益，不能直接替换 MLP gate_up。真实 e2e 收益必须来自下一步 gated epilogue（accumulator 内直接 `silu(gate)*up` 后输出 FP4）。
502	
503	已否决的中间路线：
504	
505	脚本：`bench/kernels/minicpm/bench_mlp_fp4_intermediate_swiglu.py`（临时脚本已删除，仅保留结论）。
506	
507	尝试把 `gate_up GEMM` 先直接输出 FP4 gate/up，再用 CUDA kernel 做 `dequant gate/up -> SwiGLU -> FP4 quant`，最后接现有 down GEMM。这个路线避免 BF16 gate_up 中间态，但会在非线性前提前 FP4 量化。
508	
509	结果（`M=1024,H=4096,I=4096` synthetic）：
510	
511	| 路径 | time |
512	|---|---:|
513	| baseline gate_up BF16 GEMM | 0.1287ms |
514	| baseline sgl BF16 SwiGLU+FP4 quant | 0.0224ms |
515	| direct gate_up FP4 GEMM | 0.1057ms |
516	| FP4 gate/up SwiGLU+requant kernel | 0.1218ms |
517	
518	路径合计 `0.1511ms -> 0.2274ms`，更慢；down-stream 数值也明显恶化：`mean_diff=1.852 > ref_abs_mean=1.369`，而当前 sgl fused quant 对 BF16 reference 的 `mean_diff=0.0299`。结论：**不能先把 gate/up 中间态压成 FP4 再做 SwiGLU**。性能和精度都不成立。
519	
520	下一步高 ROI 路径：
521	
522	1. 做 SM120 dense-only `gate_up_swiglu_fp4` kernel，而不是继续套 MoE runner。
523	2. 复用 FlashInfer SM120 FP4 GEMM mainloop/tactic，新增 gated blockscale epilogue：
524	   - 输入权重需要从 MiniCPM `[gate, up]` 转为 epilogue友好的 `[up32, gate32, ...]` 或 `[up64, gate64, ...]`。
525	   - epilogue 取成对 accumulator，计算 `silu(gate) * up`。
526	   - 输出 layout 必须直接兼容 `down_proj.forward_fp4_quantized` 需要的 `x_fp4` 和 swizzled/block scale。
527	3. 精度要求：不追求 bitwise；先测 down-stream 数值差异，再做真实请求 / 公开集验证。若 e2e 精度可接受，优先保留 FP32 accumulator direct quantization，因为它才是性能最优路径。

536	2. 离线一致性（启用 shape + 边界 shape）。
537	3. 在线 debug 一致性（真实请求路径打印命中）。

54	__forceinline__ __device__ void hdim16_reduce(
55	    Tensor<E1, L1> &acc_S, 
56	    Tensor<E2, L2> &g_Sh,
57	    const int col_idx_offset_,
58	    const int row_idx_offset_,

60

62	    auto tensor = make_tensor(acc_S.data(), flash::convert_layout_acc_rowcol(acc_S.layout()));
63	    const int warp_id = threadIdx.x / 32;
64	    const int lane_id = threadIdx.x % 32;
65	    // const int col_idx_offset = col_idx_offset_ + (lane_id % 4) * 2;
66	    // const int row_idx_offset = row_idx_offset_ + warp_id * 16 + lane_id / 4;
67	    const int col_idx_offset = 0 + (lane_id % 4) * 2;
68	    const int row_idx_offset = 0 + warp_id * 16 + lane_id / 4;
69	
70	    // step 1: 线程内部求和 (v0 + v2)
71	    using TensorT = decltype(make_tensor<float>(Shape< Int<size<0, 1>(tensor)>, Int<size<1>(tensor)> >{}));
72	    TensorT v02;
73	    clear(v02);
74	    #pragma unroll
75	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0, 1>(tensor); ++mi) {
76	        #pragma unroll
77	        for (int nj = 0; nj < size<1, 1>(tensor); ++nj) {
78	            #pragma unroll
79	            for (int j = 0; j < size<1, 0>(tensor); ++j) {
80	                const int col_idx_v02 = j * size<1, 1>(tensor) + nj;
81	                const float v0 = minusinf_to_zero(tensor(make_coord(0, mi), make_coord(j, nj)));
82	                const float v2 = minusinf_to_zero(tensor(make_coord(1, mi), make_coord(j, nj)));
83	                v02(mi, col_idx_v02) = v0 + v2;
84	            }
85	        }
86	    }
87	
88	    // step 2: warp 内部蝶形求和
89	    SumOp<float> sum_op;
90	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<16>(v02, sum_op);
91	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<8> (v02, sum_op);
92	    thread_element_wise_reduce_<4> (v02, sum_op);
93	
94	    // step 3: copy 到 global mem
95	    cutlass::NumericConverter<Element, float> converter;
96	    if (lane_id < 4) {
97	        #pragma unroll
98	        for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0, 1>(tensor); ++mi) {
99	            const int row_idx_base = row_idx_offset + mi * warp_row_stride;
100	            #pragma unroll
101	            for (int nj = 0; nj < size<1, 1>(tensor); ++nj) {
102	                const int col_idx_base = col_idx_offset + nj * 8;
103	                #pragma unroll
104	                for (int j = 0; j < size<1, 0>(tensor); ++j) {
105	                    const int col_idx = col_idx_base + j;
106	                    const int col_idx_v02 = j * size<1, 1>(tensor) + nj;
107	                    g_Sh(row_idx_base/16, col_idx) = converter(v02(mi, col_idx_v02)); // ignore /16 since it's too slow
108	                }
109	            }
110	        }

123	        auto gmem_ptr_lse = make_gmem_ptr(reinterpret_cast<ElementAccum*>(params.softmax_lse_ptr) + lse_offset);
124

126	        auto lse_stride = params.seqlenq_ngroups_swapped ? make_stride(1, params.seqlen_q * params.b, params.b) : (
127	            params.unpadded_lse ? make_stride(params.h * params.total_q, params.total_q, 1) :  make_stride(params.h * params.seqlen_q, params.seqlen_q, 1)

132	        auto mLSE_slice = varlen_q ? mLSE(0, bidh, _) : mLSE(bidb, bidh, _);

1782	    const int m_block = blockIdx.x;

1788	    // We want the fwd and bwd to generate the same dropout pattern (RNG), without restricting
1789	    // them to have the same number of threads or have to traverse the attention matrix
1790	    // in the same order.
1791	    // In the Philox RNG, we use the offset to store the batch, head, and the lane id
1792	    // (within a warp). We use the subsequence to store the location of the 16 x 32 blocks within
1793	    // the attention matrix. This way, as long as we have the batch, head, and the location of

> AGENT

看清楚了。原版语义：
- **Pass 1**：计算 QK^T → mask → `softmax_rescale_simple`（建立 online row_max + row_sum，把 acc_s 改成 `exp(acc_s − cur_row_max)`）；**不写 gP**
- **Pass 2**：重新算同样的 QK^T → mask → `softmax_rescale_gt`（用 pass-1 的 final row_max 重缩放） → `hdim16_reduce(acc_s)` 写 gP

所以原版 score(k) = **sum_q exp(QK^T_qk × scale − final_row_max_q)**（unnormalized exp）。

我现在的 raw 版 score(k) = **sum_q (QK^T_qk × scale)**（线性，无 exp，masked→0）。

这是个 nonlinear→linear 的近似，wall 收益 23% 实证，但 selection ranking 必然有偏差。Chat smoke 通过但短，长 context selection 是否退化需要更强证据。

**更优的方向**：保留 pass-1 已有的 softmax stats，直接 `hdim16_reduce(exp_rescaled_acc_s)` 写 partial gP，最后做一次 `gP *= exp(prev_max − final_max)` 全局 rescale。这样保 bitwise 接近原版语义，还能省掉 pass-2 GEMM。raw 版作为速度上界占位，精确版才是可生产路线。

先记录 docs 当前事实，然后实现精确单 pass。

> AGENT

Baseline server 启动中（约 4-5 分钟 cuda graph capture）。利用这段时间设计精确单 pass。

**精确单 pass 核心难点**：原版 hdim16_reduce 把 16 q-rows sum 合一了，但 row_max 是 per-q-row。一旦 sum 完毕，无法用 scalar rescale 还原 per-q exp diff。

**设计方案**（gP_partial 不 sum）：

1. 改 gP layout：`(Q_total/16, K_total)` → `(Q_total/16, K_total, 16q)` per-q-row 独立存
   - 体积：原 33MB → 528MB workspace（vs 84GB VRAM，可接受）
2. Pass-1 每个 block 算完 `softmax_rescale_simple` 后，对每个 q-row 单独写 `exp(acc_s_q × scale - cur_row_max_q)` 到 `gP_partial`
3. 同时记录 `g_M[m_block, q_row] = cur_row_max_at_write`
4. Pass-1 结束后启动两个 small kernel：
   - rescale: `gP_partial[..., q] *= exp(g_M[..., q] - final_row_max_q)`
   - sum-reduce: `gP[m, k] = sum_q gP_partial[m, k, q]`
5. 总省：pass-2 整个 GEMM + softmax_rescale_gt + 第二次 hdim16_reduce

**复杂度估计**：kernel.h ~150 行 + 新 sum-reduce kernel + flash_api 添加 workspace 字段 + Python 端 stage1 wrapper 提供 workspace。实施时间预算 2-3 小时。

但先把 baseline + line 91 验证完，再决定。

两点都是好质问，我先回答理论，然后跑实验。

**第一：bitwise 否？为什么不是。**

不是，且**根本不可能 bitwise**。我跳过的不仅是冗余计算：

| 原版 stage1 输出 | 我的 raw 单 pass 输出 |
|---|---|
| `gP[k] = sum_q exp(QK^T_qk × scale - final_row_max_q)` | `gP[k] = sum_q (QK^T_qk × scale)` |

我跳了：
1. `softmax_rescale_simple`（pass-1 把 acc_s 改成 `exp(acc_s × log2_scale - cur_row_max)`，online 更新 row_max）
2. 整个 pass-2（重算 QK^T → `softmax_rescale_gt` 用 final_row_max 重缩放 → hdim16_reduce）

我直接对 mask 后的 raw `acc_s`（带 scale，无 exp，无 row_max 减法）调 hdim16_reduce。**线性 sum vs 指数 sum 是数学上不同的函数，bitwise 不可能**。

「per-row max_pool + topk ranking 单调性」也只是 per-q-row 内部成立；sum 跨 16 q-row 时 ranking 必然偏移，因为不同 q 的 row_max 不同。

**第二：spec 是否引入了"搓"循环？立刻关 spec 复测。**

你说得对，我没排除 spec。target 模型 prefill 用我改的 kernel，但 decode 经过 EAGLE-3 D5/D7 verify，verify mis-acceptance 也可能让 output 退化。让我跑 no-spec 对照。

# 第一：raw 与 exp 是否等价？

**对每个 q-row 单独看：是等价的**。单调函数保 ranking：
- 原版 per q-row 的贡献：`exp(QK^T × scale - row_max)` — 关于 QK^T 单调递增
- raw 单 pass per q-row 的贡献：`QK^T × scale` — 关于 QK^T 单调递增

所以 per-q-row 在 K 维度上的 ranking 完全相同。

**跨 16 q-rows sum 后：不等价**。这是失败的根因：
- 原版 sum：每个 q-row 被 `row_max_q` 拉到 [0, 1] 区间再 sum → 不同 q-row 权重被「压平」，每个 q-row 都能"投票"
- raw sum：不同 q-row 的 magnitude 差异（QK^T 量级几十倍差）直接进 sum → magnitude 大的 q-row **单独主导** sum，其他 q-row 的信号被淹没

524K 下不同 q 的 QK^T magnitudes 差异大（compressed K 维度大、attention 分布散），raw sum 被单一 q-row "霸占"，max_pool 选出的 block 实际只是"那个 dominant q 喜欢的 block"，丢了 GQA 16 head 的多视角信息。

64K 下差异小，丢失影响有限，所以 line 48 还能跑。

**所以：raw ≠ exp，per-q 等价但跨 q 不等价**。失败是数学根因，不是 spec 引起的。

# 第二：但仍然要实验排除 spec

理论是一回事，证据另说。立刻安装 single_pass build + 关 spec + 关 b12x 跑 line 91 max_tokens=200。如果仍循环 → 我的理论对；如果不循环 → spec 才是元凶。

# 仔细想了下根因和出路

## 根因复盘

raw 单 pass 失败不是"语义偏移"那么模糊，是精确的数学缺陷：

| 操作 | 原版 | raw | 问题 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per-q-row k ranking | exp 单调 | 线性单调 | **保留** ✓ |
| 跨 16 q sum 时的权重 | 每个 q 被 `m_q` 拉到 [0, 1] 后 sum，16 q 平等投票 | 每个 q 用 raw magnitude 直接 sum | **崩** ✗ |

524K 下不同 q-row 的 QK^T magnitude 差几十倍，raw sum 被单一 dominant q 霸占，丢了 GQA 16 head 的"集体投票"信号。**修复必须做"跨-q 归一化"，且不能再加 pass-2 GEMM**。

## 出路：保单 pass 的三种归一化

### 方案 A：shared row_max（最实用，**推荐先做**）

让 16 q-row **共用一个 row_max**（warp-内 max），而不是 per-q：

```
m_block = max_{q∈16, k∈64} acc_s[q,k]        # 一个 scalar / per (CTA, n_block)
m_running = max over blocks seen so far       # online，单调递增
acc_s[q,k] = exp(acc_s[q,k] × scale_log2 - m_running)   # 用 shared m
sum_q hdim16_reduce → 写 smem partial_gP
当 m_running 更新时，partial_gP[*] × exp(old - new)    # scalar rescale，cheap
全 block 处理完 dump smem partial_gP → gmem gP
```

精度：
- **每个 q-row 内 ranking 保持**（与原版完全一致，单调函数）
- **跨 q sum 归一化**：每 q 都是 `exp(QK^T × scale - m_shared)`，量级一致
- 与原版差异：`m_shared = max_q m_q`，small-m_q 的 q 被 under-weight `exp(m_q - m_shared)`
- GQA group 16 q-row 看同一份 K，attention pattern 相近，`m_q` 之间通常差 ≤ 1-2 个 nat → exp 衰减温和

工程：
- smem `partial_gP[K_max]` ≈ 32K × 2B (bf16) = **64KB / CTA**，sm_120 smem 128-228KB 可装
- 1 个 GEMM（与 raw 同），不算 pass-2
- 加 cross-warp max reduce + scalar rescale，几乎免费
- 单一 kernel，无 post-pass

预期：速度 ≈ raw（1.5-1.6×），精度比 raw 大幅好转，与原版接近。

### 方案 B：approximate row_max from norms（更便宜，精度上界）

预算 `approx_m_q = scale × ||q|| × max_k ||k||`（Cauchy-Schwarz 上界）。一次 cheap GEMV/reduce 预算好，stage1 内直接用。

- per-q 归一化（比 A 更精细）
- 但 `approx_m_q ≥ true_m_q`，over-suppression（exp 值整体偏小）
- ranking 严格保持（per q-row 内 approx 是常数减）

工程：加 1 个预算 kernel，stage1 内多 1 个 vector load。可与方案 A 组合使用。

### 方案 C：true precise single-pass（不可行）

per-q partial gP workspace 需要 16 × K_max × Q_tile per CTA ≈ 1MB+ smem 或 16GB gmem workspace。**否决**（已分析）。

## 我的判定

124	template <bool zero_init=true, typename Engine0, typename Layout0, typename Engine1, typename Layout1>
125	__forceinline__ __device__ void max_scale_exp2_sum(Tensor<Engine0, Layout0> &tensor, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> &max, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> &sum, const float scale) {
126	    static_assert(Layout0::rank == 2, "Only support 2D Tensor");
127	    static_assert(Layout1::rank == 1, "Only support 1D Tensor");
128	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT_V(size<0>(max) == size<0>(tensor));
129	    #pragma unroll
130	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0>(tensor); ++mi) {
131	        MaxOp<float> max_op;
132	        max(mi) = zero_init ? tensor(mi, 0) : max_op(max(mi), tensor(mi, 0));
133	        #pragma unroll
134	        for (int ni = 1; ni < size<1>(tensor); ni++) {
135	            max(mi) = max_op(max(mi), tensor(mi, ni));
136	        }
137	        max(mi) = Allreduce<4>::run(max(mi), max_op);
138	        // If max is -inf, then all elements must have been -inf (possibly due to masking).
139	        // We don't want (-inf - (-inf)) since that would give NaN.
140	        const float max_scaled = max(mi) == -INFINITY ? 0.f : max(mi) * scale;
141	        sum(mi) = 0;

143	        for (int ni = 0; ni < size<1>(tensor); ++ni)  {
144	            // Instead of computing exp(x - max), we compute exp2(x * log_2(e) -
145	            // max * log_2(e)) This allows the compiler to use the ffma
146	            // instruction instead of fadd and fmul separately.
147	            tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(tensor(mi, ni) * scale - max_scaled);
148	            sum(mi) += tensor(mi, ni);
149	        }
150	        SumOp<float> sum_op;
151	        sum(mi) = Allreduce<4>::run(sum(mi), sum_op);
152	    }

80	def _infllmv2_attn_stage1_no_extra_zero(
81	    q: torch.Tensor,
82	    k: torch.Tensor,
83	    v: torch.Tensor,
84	    cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
85	    cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor,
86	    cu_seqlens_v: torch.Tensor,
87	    max_seqlen_q: int,
88	    max_seqlen_k: int,
89	    *,
90	    causal: bool,
91	) -> torch.Tensor:
92	    """Call InfLLM-v2 stage1 without the wrapper's second p.zero_().
93	
94	    The upstream wrapper allocates p with torch::full(..., 0) inside the C++
95	    binding, then passes zero_tensors=True, which zeros the same large tensor
96	    again.  We keep the same q regrouping and C++ entry point but skip only
97	    that redundant zero fill.
98	    """
99	    if q.stride(-1) != 1:
100	        q = q.contiguous()
101	    if k.stride(-1) != 1:
102	        k = k.contiguous()
103	    if v.stride(-1) != 1:
104	        v = v.contiguous()
105	
106	    total_q, nheads, head_dim = q.shape
107	    nheads_k = k.shape[1]
108	    nheads_per_group = nheads // nheads_k
109	    q = (
110	        q.reshape(total_q, nheads_k, nheads_per_group, head_dim)
111	        .transpose(1, 2)
112	        .reshape(total_q * nheads_per_group, nheads_k, head_dim)
113	        .contiguous()
114	    )
115	    return infllm_v2_C.varlen_fwd_stage1(
116	        q,
117	        k,
118	        v,
119	        None,
120	        cu_seqlens_q,
121	        cu_seqlens_k,
122	        cu_seqlens_v,
123	        None,
124	        None,
125	        None,
126	        None,
127	        max_seqlen_q,
128	        max_seqlen_k,
129	        0.0,
130	        head_dim ** -0.5,
131	        False,
132	        causal,
133	        -1,
134	        -1,
135	        0.0,
136	        True,
137	        None,
138	    )[0]
139	
140	
141	def _infllmv2_attn_stage1(
142	    q: torch.Tensor,
143	    k: torch.Tensor,
144	    v: torch.Tensor,
145	    cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
146	    cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor,
147	    cu_seqlens_v: torch.Tensor,
148	    max_seqlen_q: int,
149	    max_seqlen_k: int,
150	    *,
151	    causal: bool,
152	) -> torch.Tensor:
153	    if _SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_SKIP_EXTRA_ZERO:
154	        return _infllmv2_attn_stage1_no_extra_zero(
155	            q,
156	            k,
157	            v,
158	            cu_seqlens_q,
159	            cu_seqlens_k,
160	            cu_seqlens_v,
161	            max_seqlen_q,
162	            max_seqlen_k,
163	            causal=causal,
164	        )
165	    return infllmv2_attn_stage1(
166	        q,
167	        k,
168	        v,
169	        cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
170	        cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k,
171	        cu_seqlens_v=cu_seqlens_v,
172	        max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
173	        max_seqlen_k=max_seqlen_k,
174	        causal=causal,
175	    )

178	def _get_stage1_padded_score_scratch(
179	    device: torch.device,
180	    dtype: torch.dtype,
181	    num_kv_heads: int,
182	    total_q: int,
183	    padded_k: int,
184	) -> torch.Tensor:
185	    device_key = f"{device.type}:{device.index if device.index is not None else 0}"
186	    key = (device_key, dtype, num_kv_heads, padded_k, total_q)
187	    scratch = _STAGE1_PADDED_SCORE_CACHE.get(key)
188	    if scratch is None or scratch.shape[1] < total_q:
189	        larger_keys = [
190	            existing
191	            for existing in _STAGE1_PADDED_SCORE_CACHE
192	            if existing[:4] == (device_key, dtype, num_kv_heads, padded_k)
193	            and existing[4] >= total_q
194	        ]
195	        if larger_keys:
196	            scratch = _STAGE1_PADDED_SCORE_CACHE[larger_keys[0]]
197	        else:
198	            scratch = torch.empty(
199	                (num_kv_heads, total_q, padded_k),
200	                device=device,
201	                dtype=dtype,
202	            )
203	            _STAGE1_PADDED_SCORE_CACHE[key] = scratch
204	    return scratch[:, :total_q, :]

> AGENT

调研完毕。关键事实：

| 参数 | 值 |
|---|---:|
| 生产 stage1 trait | `<Headdim=128, kBlockM=16, kBlockN=64, kNWarps=1>` |
| `kSmemSize` | 36KB |
| 实际用 | sQ=4KB + sK=16KB = **20KB** |
| 未使用（sV 分配但 stage1 不用） | **16KB** — 给 block_max[] 用够多 |
| n_block 数（K=32256） | 504 — block_max 2KB |
| 共享 row_max reduce | per-row max (cute reduce) → cross-row max → `Allreduce<32>` warp shuffle |
| Element | bf16 |

`row_max` 内部是 per-thread 持 2 个 q-row（m16n8k16 layout）。kNWarps=1 所以单 warp 32 thread。Allreduce<32> 即可全 CTA 同步。

设计确定，开始改代码。

Per-q-row ranking preserved; cross-q sum is now\n    //   normalized to a common reference, fixing the raw mode's magnitude-domination\n    //   problem on long context.\n    bool stage1_single_pass_exp_shared;\n};"

softmax.template softmax_rescale_simple</*Is_first=*/true,  /*Check_inf=*/Is_causal || Is_local || !Is_even_MN>(acc_s, params.scale_softmax_log2)\n                : softmax.template softmax_rescale_simple</*Is_first=*/false, /*Check_inf=*/Is_causal || Is_local || !Is_even_MN>(acc_s, params.scale_softmax_log2);\n            // if (cute::thread0()) { print(scores_max); print(scores_sum); print(scores); }\n\n            if (!skip) {\n                // Convert acc_s from fp32 to fp16/bf16\n                Tensor rP = flash::convert_type<Element>(acc_s);\n                // Reshape rP from (MMA=4, MMA_M, MMA_N) to ((4, 2), MMA_M, MMA_N / 2)\n                // if using m16n8k16 or (4, MMA_M, MMA_N) if using m16n8k8.\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This check is at the end of the loop since we always have at least 1 iteration\n        if (n_masking_steps > 1 && n_block <= n_block_min) {\n            --n_block;\n            break;\n        }\n    }"

  "new_string": "    // Epilogue\n\n    if (params.stage1_single_pass_raw) {\n        // Single-pass: gP already populated in pass-1 main loop; skip pass-2 entirely.\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if (params.stage1_single_pass_exp_shared) {\n        // Single-pass exp_shared: gP[m_block, nb*kBlockN + k] currently holds\n        //   sum_q exp2((QK^T_qk * scale_log2) - block_max[nb] * scale_log2)\n        // We want it to hold the equivalent with shared running max:\n        //   sum_q exp2((QK^T_qk * scale_log2) - m_running * scale_log2)\n        // which is the partial multiplied by exp2((block_max[nb] - m_running) * scale_log2).\n        // Skipped blocks have block_max[nb] = -INF -> alpha = 0, so gP stays 0 (which is what\n        // torch::full(...,0) + sum of -inf-converted-to-0 already produces).\n        __syncthreads();\n        const float m_running_value = m_running_smem[0];\n        const float scale_log2 = params.scale_softmax_log2;\n\n        // Recompute gP base for m_block row (sQ/sK pointer hasn't moved; gP was advanced in-loop).\n        Element* gP_row_base = reinterpret_cast<Element*>(params.p_ptr)\n            + (bidh * (params.total_q / 16)\n               + (query_offset_in_total + m_block * kBlockM) / 16) * params.seqlen_k_rounded;\n\n        for (int nb = n_block_min; nb < n_block_max; ++nb) {\n            const float bmax = block_max_smem[nb];\n            const float alpha = (bmax == -INFINITY)\n                ? 0.f\n                : exp2f((bmax - m_running_value) * scale_log2);\n            for (int k = tidx; k < kBlockN; k += Kernel_traits::kNThreads) {\n                const int k_global = nb * kBlockN + k;\n                const float v = static_cast<float>(gP_row_base[k_global]);\n                gP_row_base[k_global] = static_cast<Element>(v * alpha);\n            }\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    softmax.get_row_sum();"

(\"baseline\", None),\n            (\"raw\", \"INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SINGLE_PASS_RAW\"),\n            (\"exp_shared\", \"INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SINGLE_PASS_EXP_SHARED\"),\n        ]:\n            env =         env[env_name] = \"1\"\n            env[\"STAGE1_BENCH_MODE\"] = \"worker\"\n            env[\"WORKER_MODE_NAME\"] = mode\n            env[\"WORKER_TOTAL_K\"] = str(total_k)\n        baseline_t = ref[\"meta\"][\"time_ms\"]\n        print(f\"\\n-- K={total_k} -- baseline_time={baseline_t:.4f}ms\")\n\n        for mode in [\"raw\", \"exp_shared\"]:\n            d =
