gemm，gemm 自然就 hide 掉大部分 transfer 时间，只剩 ~10-30 ns/iter 的 issue dispatch 本身。\n2. **profile 归因揭示的 hotspot ≠ 可优化幅度**。占比是 wall 投影，里面已隐含原代码无意中达到的 overlap；naive \"重排让 overlap 更早\" 在原代码已经接近最优时无收益。\n3. **pass-2 no-mask 在 sm_120 stage1 (kbn=16) 上的 software pipelining 已经基本最优**。下一步只有：(a) 更激进的多 stage K ring buffer（需要 ≥3 个 K slot，但 stage1 当前 SMEM 用 sV+sK，多 stage 需要 layout 全改）；(b) 跳出指令重排，做算法层（lever 4 真 bound、三核融合）。\n4. **sV slot 复用为 sK_alt 不引入精度/语义风险**（stage1 不读 V），但 mma layout 一致也无法换来 perf 时，这条 trick 本身没有继承价值，仅记教训。\n\n### Lever 12 (in-kernel clock64 stall profile，方法论修正) — 2026-05-23\n\n**动机**：Lever 8/9/10 的 profile-skip 把 sub-op 去掉测 wall，但 \"去掉 op\" 同时也 \"断开 pipeline 依赖\"，给出的\"占比\"被污染（详见 Lever 8/9/10 段的方法论说明）。需要测**每个 sub-op 真实占用的 cycles**，且不打断 pipeline。\n\n**实现**：`flash_fwd_kernel.h` pass-2 no-mask 内层循环植入 6 个 `clock64()` 时间戳，per-thread 5 个 cycle-diff 寄存器累加，CTA 末由 tidx==0 写到 device buffer (`params.pass2_stall_buf`)。`flash_api.cpp` 在 `mha_varlen_fwd_stage1` 入口按 env `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_STALL_PROFILE=1` 分配 buffer + kernel 后 sync 读回 + 打印 per-iter 平均 cycles。`flash.h` 加两字段（buffer 指针 + 容量）。源码已 `git checkout HEAD --` 清空（probe-only，不进生产）。\n\n**测量结果**（524K microbench，active_ctas=1024，iters_sum=33,551,842）：\n\n| sub-op | per-iter cycles | % |\n|---|---:|---:|\n| **wait1**（cp_async_wait 等 K(n+1)） | **601.9** | **35.58%** |\n| gemm（TC work） | 483.3 | 28.57% |\n| wait2（gemm 后冗余 wait） | **6.4** | **0.38%** |\n| issue（cp_async dispatch + fence） | 198.2 | 11.72% |\n| post（mask+softmax+hdim16_reduce+store） | 402.0 | 23.76% |\n| total | 1691.7 | 100% |\n\nA/B instrumentation overhead：prod 30.64 ms vs L12 .so（env 未设）31.79 ms = **+3.74%**（clock64 reads + diff accumulation 不免费，所以源码 rollback，不进生产）。\n\n**关键发现**：\n1. **wait2 = 0.38% 已确认是噪声**，正面验证 Lever 7（删除冗余 wait）的 wash 结论——NVCC 已经把它编译成 no-op。\n2. **issue 真实占 11.72%**，不是 profile-skip 报告的 24.57%。Lever 11 拿 11.72% 的 issue 做 ping-pong 预测顶值 5-8% 左右，实测 0.54% 与此一致（reorder 命中率低于完全重叠的理论上限）。\n3. **wait1 = 35.58% 是显式 stall 区间**，但 clock64 不能区分 \"SM 真空闲\" vs \"本 warp 等内存、别的 warp 仍在跑\"。在 21 CTAs/SM × 44% occupancy 下，wait1 大部分大概率是后者，不会被 reorder 释放。\n4. **可摘上限的真分母不是 wait1 而是\"warp 全等待时 SM 也空\"的子集**——sm_120 上 ncu 锁 warp_stall_reasons，无法直接测。结构性结论：**pipeline 级 reorder 已达极限**，再雕指令不会触动 wall。\n\n**Round 决策**：profile-only round，无优化产物。源码 rollback，数据/方法论入 docs，build artifact 不入 venv。这个工具（clock64 仪表）在未来跨 lever 需要\"先量 stall 再设计\"时可重启。\n\n**方法论 lesson（写入未来 lever 起步前必读）**：\n- profile-skip = 测\"如果 op 消失\"；clock64 = 测\"op 占用 wall 多少\"；warp_stall_reasons = 测\"SM 真因这 op 空多少\"。三者数字一般差一个数量级，前两者是后者的上限。\n- 任何 \"pipeline-level reorder\" 类 lever，必须先用 clock64 看 wait/issue/gemm/post **真实周期分布**，估算 best-case 再决定是否实现；profile-skip 给的占比绝对不能直接当 reorder 上限。\n- 攻击面优先级永远先看 throughput-bound vs latency-bound：cycles 里 252	### 3.1 fi_convert 跨层缓存
253	"同 forward 8 层 page table 相同"是错的：tensor 指针相同但每层按本层 q/k 重写内容。仅保留 `SGLANG_MINICPM_UNSAFE_FI_CONVERT_CACHE=1` 实验开关。
254	
255	### 3.2 TrtLLM stage2 替换
256	sparse stage2 实际是 decode-style（`max_seqlen_q==1`）；FlashInfer causal right-aligned vs TrtLLM `mask_mode="causal"` 在 `q_len << kv_len` 时不等价。要重启需先证明 right-aligned causal 等价。
257	
258	### 3.3 fast prefill stage1
259	`SGLANG_FAST_PREFILL_STAGE1=1` 默认关闭：k1-only 丢 k2 语义，topk match 差且不快。
260	
261	### 3.4 compressed maxlen 旧方案
262	不能缩 `max_pooling_1d_varlen.max_context_len`：pooler layout/边界语义。当前替代是 §2.5。

265	`compress_k_buffer_prefill_ms≈0.03ms/call`，15chunk 打平。不值得维护。

Captures at most _GP_PROBE_MAX dumps,\n# writes to /tmp/stage1_gp_probe_<idx>.pt. Restricted to is_prefilling.\n_SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_GP_PROBE = (\n    os.environ.get(\"SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_GP_PROBE\", \"0\") == \"1\"\n)\n_GP_PROBE_MAX = int(os.environ.get(\"SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_GP_PROBE_MAX\", \"8\"))\n_GP_PROBE_DIR = os.environ.get(\"SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_GP_PROBE_DIR\", \"/tmp/gp_probe\")\n_GP_PROBE_COUNT = 0\n\n\ndef _gp_probe_dump(score: torch.Tensor, max_seqlen_k_arg: int, cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor):\n    \"\"\"Capture per-row block-score distribution for Lever 4 feasibility.\n\n    score shape: (nkv, total_q_with_grp, n_blocks)\n    For each row, compute row_max, then histogram block scores normalized by row_max.\n    Saves small tensors only (no raw scores).\n    \"\"\"\n    global _GP_PROBE_COUNT\n    if _GP_PROBE_COUNT >= _GP_PROBE_MAX:\n        return\n    try:\n        os.makedirs(_GP_PROBE_DIR, exist_ok=True)\n        # Score may be padded full layout; use cu_seqlens to find actual k length.\n        actual_k = int((cu_seqlens_k[1:] - cu_seqlens_k[:-1]).max().item())\n        valid_blocks = min(score.shape[-1], actual_k)\n        s = score[..., :valid_blocks].float()  # (nkv, total_q, valid_blocks)\n        # Mask out -inf / nan; treat as 0 so they don't skew max.\n        s = torch.nan_to_num(s, nan=0.0, neginf=0.0, posinf=0.0)\n        # Per-row max across blocks.\n        row_max = s.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)  # (nkv, total_q, 1)\n        # Skip rows with row_max == 0 (padding / causal-suppressed rows).\n        nonzero_mask = (row_max.squeeze(-1) > 0)\n        # Normalized score: gP / row_max in [0, 1] when row is valid.\n        eps = torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny\n        norm = s / row_max.clamp(min=eps)  # (nkv, total_q, valid_blocks)\n        # Thresholds: count of blocks BELOW each fraction of row_max.\n        thresholds = [0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05, 0.01, 0.001, 1e-6]\n        below = torch.tensor(\n            [(norm < t).float().mean().item() for t in thresholds]\n        )\n        # Histogram of norm values in 20 bins on log-spaced scale.\n        log_norm = torch.log10(norm.clamp(min=1e-10))  # in [-10, 0]\n        bins = torch.linspace(-10.0, 0.0, 21, device=norm.device)\n        hist = torch.histc(log_norm.flatten(), bins=20, min=-10.0, max=0.0).cpu()\n        # Per-row max of norm (should be 1.0), per-row second-max for top-1-vs-rest.\n        topk_vals, _ = norm.topk(k=min(8, valid_blocks), dim=-1)\n        topk_vals = topk_vals.cpu()\n        # Save small summary file.\n        out = {\n            \"shape\": tuple(score.shape),\n            \"valid_blocks\": valid_blocks,\n            \"actual_k\": actual_k,\n            \"nonzero_rows\": int(nonzero_mask.sum().item()),\n            \"total_rows\": int(nonzero_mask.numel()),\n            \"thresholds\": thresholds,\n            \"below_frac\": below,  # fraction of (row, block) pairs with norm < t\n            \"hist_log10_bins\": bins.cpu(),\n            \"hist_counts\": hist,\n            \"topk_norm\": topk_vals,  # (nkv, total_q, 8) top-8 normalized scores per row\n        }\n        path = os.path.join(_GP_PROBE_DIR, f\"stage1_gp_probe_{_GP_PROBE_COUNT:03d}.pt\")\n        torch.save(out, path)\n        _GP_PROBE_COUNT += 1\n        logger.warning(\n            \"[GP_PROBE] dumped %s: shape=%s valid_blocks=%d nonzero_rows=%d/%d below_0.01=%.3f below_0.001=%.3f\",\n            path, out[\"shape\"], valid_blocks, out[\"nonzero_rows\"], out[\"total_rows\"],\n            float(below[4]), float(below[5]),\n        )\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.exception(\"[GP_PROBE] dump failed: %s\", e)"
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	set -euo pipefail
3	
4	cd /user_4813494d/openbmb
5	
6	# Ensure the project venv is active (scripts must not depend on caller's shell).
7	SALA_VENV="/opt/SGLang-MiniCPM-SALA/sglang_minicpm_sala_env"
8	if [[ "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" != "${SALA_VENV}" || "$(command -v python3)" != "${SALA_VENV}/bin/python3" ]]; then
9	    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
10	    source "${SALA_VENV}/bin/activate"
11	fi
12	
13	# EAGLE-3 speculative decoding server (current production config)
14	# - spec_steps=3, topk=2, dtn=7  (chain verify, default D5 mode)
15	# - dynamic spec mode: NO_SPEC bs>=32, D7 bs<=1, D5 otherwise (theta 0.85/0.5)
16	# - ngram route: hit -> chain verify branch, miss -> EAGLE draft, both under cuda graph
17	# - target: NVFP4 (GPTQ + FourOverSix), hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS decode
18	# - draft:  det_prefill NVFP4 QAT, b12x explicitly off by default
19	#
20	# 只显式设置与 code 默认不同的 env；其余使用 code 默认值（参见
21	# sglang/srt/{environ.py,speculative/spec_mode.py,layers/.../*}）。
22	# 用户可在调用前 export 任一 SGLANG_*/EAGLE_* env 来覆盖。
23	
24	SPEC_STEPS="${EAGLE_SPEC_STEPS:-5}"
25	TOPK="${EAGLE_TOPK:-2}"
26	# dtn = 1 + topk * spec_steps (tree nodes)
27	DTN=$((1 + TOPK * SPEC_STEPS))
28	TARGET_MODEL="${EAGLE_TARGET_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/models/openbmb/MiniCPM-SALA-gptq46-calib90-90k-NVFP4-det}"
29	DRAFT_MODEL="${EAGLE_DRAFT_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/data/eagle_stage/models/v3mix_300k_s6250_ind672}"
30	# MiniCPM-SALA sliding-window draft prefill: 仅最末 N tokens 进 draft prefill。
31	# 0 = 关闭(全量 draft prefill)。长上下文吞吐受益大(524K -> 32K 后 draft prefill ~16× 加速)。
32	# EAGLE-3 chain verify 无损,target 主链不受影响。
33	DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N="${EAGLE_DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N:-32768}"
34	# MiniCPM-SALA draft sliding-window attention: draft 自己的 1 层 attention 只读
35	# 最末 N tokens KV(真截断 kv_indices,不是 mask)。配合 prefix_last_n 用,且必须
36	# >= LAST_N + chunk_size(8192) 留 margin,保证 window 起点严格落在末 chunk 已写
37	# 入的 KV 范围(末 chunk 极端 1-token 时也安全)。0 = full attention。
38	DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW="${EAGLE_DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW:-40960}"

{
  "file_path": "/tmp/lever4_analyze.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Lever 4 data feasibility analyzer.\n\nReads /tmp/gp_probe/stage1_gp_probe_*.pt produced by the production probe.\nFor each dump (one chunk × one stage1 call) reports:\n  - shape, valid_blocks, nonzero_rows\n  - skip_rate ceiling per margin threshold (fraction of (row, block) below margin*row_max)\n  - per-row distribution stats (median, p90, p99 of top-2 ratio = 2nd-max / 1st-max)\n  - histogram of log10(gP / row_max) buckets\n\nDecision rule (from task description):\n  - if ceiling skip_rate (e.g., margin=0.01) >= 30%, Lever 4 worth pursuing\n  - if < 10%, pivot to 三核融合 (three-kernel fusion)\n\"\"\"\nimport glob, os, sys\nimport torch\n\nDIR = \"/tmp/gp_probe\"\nfiles = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DIR, \"stage1_gp_probe_*.pt\")))\nif not files:\n    print(f\"no dumps found in {DIR}\")\n    sys.exit(1)\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(files)} dump(s).\\n\")\n\n# Aggregate\nagg_below = None\nagg_hist = None\nagg_topk = []\ntotal_pairs = 0\n\nfor f in files:\n    d = torch.load(f, weights_only=False)\n    shape = d[\"shape\"]\n    vb = d[\"valid_blocks\"]\n    nz = d[\"nonzero_rows\"]\n    tot = d[\"total_rows\"]\n    ths = d[\"thresholds\"]\n    below = d[\"below_frac\"]\n    hist = d[\"hist_counts\"]\n    topk = d[\"topk_norm\"]  # (nkv, total_q, 8)\n\n    print(f\"=== {os.path.basename(f)} ===\")\n    print(f\"  score shape: {shape}, valid_blocks: {vb}, nonzero_rows: {nz}/{tot} ({100*nz/max(tot,1):.1f}%)\")\n    print(f\"  skip ceiling (frac of (row,block) below margin × row_max):\")\n    for t, b in zip(ths, below.tolist()):\n        print(f\"    margin {t:8.4f}: {100*b:6.2f}%\")\n\n    # Per-row top-2 ratio: 2nd-max / 1st-max (across blocks).\n    if topk.shape[-1] >= 2:\n        top1 = topk[..., 0]\n        top2 = topk[..., 1]\n        # Note topk normalized by row_max, so top1 should be 1.0.\n        # We want: how isolated is the peak? Lower top2/top1 = more peaky = better skip.\n        ratio = (top2 / top1.clamp(min=1e-10)).flatten()\n        # Filter nonzero rows\n        mask = (top1.flatten() > 0)\n        if mask.any():\n            r = ratio[mask].float()\n            r_sorted = r.sort().values\n            n = r.numel()\n            print(f\"  top2/top1 distribution (nonzero rows only, n={n}):\")\n            print(f\"    median: {r_sorted[n//2].item():.4f}\")\n            print(f\"    p10:    {r_sorted[max(0, n//10)].item():.4f}\")\n            print(f\"    p25:    {r_sorted[max(0, n//4)].item():.4f}\")\n            print(f\"    p75:    {r_sorted[min(n-1, 3*n//4)].item():.4f}\")\n            print(f\"    p90:    {r_sorted[min(n-1, 9*n//10)].item():.4f}\")\n            print(f\"    p99:    {r_sorted[min(n-1, 99*n//100)].item():.4f}\")\n\n    print(f\"  log10(gP/row_max) histogram (bins [-10..0], 20 buckets):\")\n    hist_n = hist.sum().item()\n    if hist_n > 0:\n        for i, c in enumerate(hist.tolist()):\n            lo, hi = -10 + 0.5 * i, -10 + 0.5 * (i + 1)\n            bar = \"#\" * int(50 * c / max(hist.max().item(), 1))\n            print(f\"    [{lo:6.2f}, {hi:6.2f}): {int(c):>10d} {100*c/hist_n:5.1f}%  {bar}\")\n    print()\n\n    # Aggregate\n    if agg_below is None:\n        agg_below = torch.zeros_like(below)\n        agg_hist = torch.zeros_like(hist)\n    agg_below += below\n    agg_hist += hist\n    total_pairs += 1\n\n# Summary\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(f\"AGGREGATE across {total_pairs} dumps\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\navg_below = agg_below / total_pairs\nprint(f\"  avg skip ceiling (frac of (row,block) below margin × row_max):\")\nfor t, b in zip(d[\"thresholds\"], avg_below.tolist()):\n    print(f\"    margin {t:8.4f}: {100*b:6.2f}%\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nAggregate log10(gP/row_max) histogram:\")\nhist_n = agg_hist.sum().item()\nif hist_n > 0:\n    for i, c in enumerate(agg_hist.tolist()):\n        lo, hi = -10 + 0.5 * i, -10 + 0.5 * (i + 1)\n        bar = \"#\" * int(50 * c / max(agg_hist.max().item(), 1))\n        print(f\"    [{lo:6.2f}, {hi:6.2f}): {int(c):>10d} {100*c/hist_n:5.1f}%  {bar}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"DECISION\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nceiling_01 = avg_below[4].item()  # margin 0.01\nceiling_001 = avg_below[5].item()  # margin 0.001\nprint(f\"  ceiling at margin=0.01:  {100*ceiling_01:.2f}%\")\nprint(f\"  ceiling at margin=0.001: {100*ceiling_001:.2f}%\")\nif ceiling_01 >= 0.30:\n    print(f\"  -> Lever 4 worth pursuing (>= 30% ceiling at margin 0.01)\")\nelif ceiling_01 < 0.10:\n    print(f\"  -> KILL Lever 4, pivot to 三核融合 (< 10% ceiling at margin 0.01)\")\nelse:\n    print(f\"  -> AMBIGUOUS ({100*ceiling_01:.1f}% at margin 0.01). Read distribution carefully.\")\n"
}

159	### 算法结构（2026-05-23 复读源码 + cubin 实测）
160	
161	双 pass 在不同 K tensor 上跑：
162	- **pass-1**：`tKgK` 从 `gC = params.v_ptr (= k2)` partition。k2 = stride-64 coarse（kernel_size=128），长度 ≈ k1_len / 4。524K 末段 k2_len ≈ 8189，n_block_max_c ≈ 128
163	- **pass-2**：`tKgK` 从 `gK = params.k_ptr (= k1)` partition。k1 = stride-16 fine，是真正用来产 gP 的。524K 末段 k1_len=32760，n_block_max = 512（pass-1 的 4×）
164	- 输出：`gP[k] = sum_q exp(QK^T_qk × scale - final_row_max_q)`（unnormalized exp）
165	
166	**Production kernel 资源**（venv `.so` 当前 `46d797a2`，stage1 派发到 `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel<128, 16, 16, 1, ...>`，cubin sm_120）：

170	| `Lb1Lb0Lb0Lb0Lb1Lb0Lb0Lb0` (Is_even_MN=0) | 96 (kbn=64) | 1024 B | 0 |
171	
172	CTAs/SM kbn=64 ≈ 21（warp occupancy 44%）。kbn=32 ≈ 25+（50%+）。kbn=16 进一步提升占用率，是当前 sweet spot。

184	**store 不是 lever**（0.3%）。任何"stage1→pool/topk exact fusion 消掉 gP 物化"的旧估算都基于错误假设。**pass-2 是大头，但单 pass + bitwise 物理上不可达**（要 per-q-row final_row_max rescale，partial gP / m_running 表 / per-q workspace 全部爆 SMEM 或 VRAM；GQA group=16 / k=32768 / Blackwell sm_120 228KB SMEM 是结构性硬约束）。

191	
192	机理：stage1 是 occupancy/latency-bound，不是 TC-bound。kBlockN 下行减小 per-CTA reg state，CTAs/SM 提升，latency hiding 改善胜过 per-iter overhead 增加。

241	
242	**方法**：`flash_api.cpp:mha_varlen_fwd_stage1` 加 env gate `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_NOOP=1`，若设置则 gP 张量保留 zero，跳过 `run_mha_fwd(params, ...)`，整个 kernel work=0。topk 后续会选前 N blocks，attention 输出 garbage，但 524K wall 测的是 "stage1 完全免费时 e2e 上限"。源码已 revert（probe-only round）。

251	**含义**：
252	1. **Stage1 在 524K e2e 关键路径上占 21.3%**（与 §1 profile `stage1_score 7.706s / leaf 32.45s = 23.7%` 几乎一致）。**未来任何 stage1 优化的 ROI 上限是 21.3% wall**——这是足够大的攻击面，stage1 仍是顶级 surface。
253	2. **Lever 29 没传导的真因**：CTAs/SM +57% 让 stage1 单独跑变快，但在 prefill chain 里 stage1 早被 mlp/gla/compress_k 的 stream pipeline 部分重叠 → CTAs 多了反而抢 HBM/scheduler，对冲掉 -8% 微 bench 收益。**"消单核 wall" 不等于 "消 critical-path wall"**。
254	3. **结论 / 路线分歧**：未来 stage1 lever 必须走 **"消 work" 而不是 "提速 work"**——前者直接砍 critical-path，后者只动单核 wall。
255	   - "消 work" = Lever 4 跳块（直接砍 gemm cycles 28.57%）或三核融合（直接砍 gP 物化 256 MB/chunk HBM + max_pool/topk）
256	   - "提速 work" = pipeline reorder / occupancy / instruction tweak（Lever 7/11/14/29/30 全 wash 系列）

258	**剩余攻击面（multi-day，结构性"消 work"）**：
259	1. **三核融合**（stage1 + max_pool + topk 同时融，消 gP 物化）：max_pool 仅占 e2e 0.92%、topk 1.51%、stage1 22%；融三段省 gP 256 MB/chunk HBM + 三段独立 kernel launch。单融 max_pool 已 Lever 13a 证伪需带 gP 物化和 topk 一起。
260	2. **Lever 4 真 per-k1-block bound 跳块**：compress_k 多输出 k1_max_score → stage1 pass-2 GEMM 前真 bound 跳低分块。跳率 30-50% → stage1 内 gemm 28.57% 砍同比 → e2e 约 -2-3%。前置需修 compress_k kernel。
261	
262	**probe 工具**：env gate `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_NOOP=1` 已 revert，未来 critical-path 类 probe 需重新加（参考 Lever 12 clock64 probe 模式）。一份 5 行的 env-gated `if (noop) { p.zero_(); } else { run_mha_fwd(...) }` 在 `flash_api.cpp` 即可。

{

  "content": "\"\"\"Lever 4 predictor validation.\n\nLoads /tmp/gp_probe/stage1_raw_*.pt (Q/k1/k2/score dumps).\nFor each dump, simulates several predictors and measures top-K=64 recall.\n\nPredictor A: Q @ k2 (per (row, k2_block)). Use as candidate score for pool topK.\nPredictor B: Q @ k2 (softmaxed per row) — proper probability mass.\nPredictor C: ||Q|| * ||k1_block_max|| — Cauchy-Schwarz upper bound (already known to fail).\n\nTruth = max_pool(gP) → block_score → topK=64.\nFor each predictor, compute fraction of true top-K=64 captured by predictor's top-K=64.\n\"\"\"\nimport os, sys, glob, json\nimport torch\n\nDIR = \"/tmp/gp_probe\"\nfiles = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DIR, \"stage1_raw_*.pt\")))\nif not files:\n    print(f\"no raw dumps in {DIR}\")\n    sys.exit(1)\n\nTOPK = 64  # production topk\nKERNEL_STRIDE = 16  # k1 stride\nK2_STRIDE = 64  # k2 stride (= block_size)\nBLOCK_SIZE = 64\nPOOL_RATIO = K2_STRIDE // KERNEL_STRIDE  # 4\n\ndevice = \"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\"\n\n\ndef block_score_from_gp(gp: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Match production max_pool_1d_varlen: max over 4 adjacent gP blocks.\n\n    gp shape: (nkv, total_q, n_gp_blocks). We do max over (4) adjacent blocks\n    with kernel_size = POOL_RATIO + 1 = 5 (matches max_pooling_1d_varlen with padding=1).\n    Actually the production max-pool uses kernel_size=5, stride=4, padding=1.\n    For simplicity we use stride=4, kernel_size=4 (close approximation).\n    \"\"\"\n    nkv, tq, nb = gp.shape\n    pad = (POOL_RATIO - nb % POOL_RATIO) % POOL_RATIO\n    if pad:\n        gp = torch.nn.functional.pad(gp, (0, pad), value=0.0)\n    gp = gp.view(nkv, tq, -1, POOL_RATIO).amax(dim=-1)\n    return gp  # (nkv, tq, n_pool_blocks)\n\n\ndef predictor_qk2(q: torch.Tensor, k2: torch.Tensor,\n                  cu_q_adj: torch.Tensor, cu_k2: torch.Tensor,\n                  scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Q @ k2 dot products per (row, k2_block).\n\n    q shape: (total_q, nh_q, d) where total_q is already pre-repeated (nq * 16).\n    k2 shape: (total_k2, nkv, d).\n    cu_q_adj: cumulative seqlens for the q (already × 16-grouped).\n    Returns: (nkv, total_q_orig, n_k2_blocks) — same shape as score.\n\n    For single-batch: total_q_orig = q.shape[0] / 16, nkv = k2.shape[1].\n    \"\"\"\n    total_q_full, nh, d = q.shape\n    nkv = k2.shape[1]\n    grp = nh // nkv\n    # Q is (total_q_full, nh_q, d); reshape to (nkv, total_q_orig, grp, d)\n    # but stage1 sums over grp via softmax, so we sum/max over grp for predictor too.\n    # Per stage1, gP[nkv, total_q_orig, n_blocks] aggregates queries within group.\n    # For predictor, take max over grp queries (matches \"most-active query in group\").\n    total_q_orig = total_q_full // grp\n    q_rs = q.view(total_q_orig, nkv, grp, d).permute(1, 0, 2, 3).contiguous()  # (nkv, tq, grp, d)\n    k2_t = k2.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()  # (nkv, total_k2, d)\n    # Compute Q @ k2.T per (nkv head) and reduce over grp.\n    # Score: (nkv, tq, grp, total_k2)\n    sc = torch.einsum(\"hqgd,hkd->hqgk\", q_rs.float(), k2_t.float()).mul_(scale)\n    # Reduce: max across grp (peakiest query in the group)\n    sc_max = sc.amax(dim=2)  # (nkv, tq, total_k2)\n    sc_sum = sc.sum(dim=2)   # (nkv, tq, total_k2)\n    return sc_max, sc_sum  # return both for comparison\n\n\ndef topk_recall(pred_score: torch.Tensor, true_block_score: torch.Tensor, k: int,\n                cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Top-K recall: fraction of true topK pool-blocks captured in predictor's topK.\"\"\"\n    # Both have shape (nkv, total_q, n_pool_blocks).\n    nkv, tq, npb = true_block_score.shape\n    # For each (head, row), compute topK indices in true and pred, return intersection / K.\n    # Restrict to valid pool blocks (causal: pool_block <= row // pool_size).\n    # For simplicity, ignore causal mask in this analysis (false positives in blocked-out\n    # region are equally penalized for both predictor and true).\n    pred_topk = pred_score.topk(k=min(k, npb), dim=-1).indices  # (nkv, tq, K)\n    true_topk = true_block_score.topk(k=min(k, npb), dim=-1).indices  # (nkv, tq, K)\n    # Compute set intersection per (nkv, tq).\n    # Use sorted approach for efficiency.\n    pred_set = pred_topk.sort(dim=-1).values\n    true_set = true_topk.sort(dim=-1).values\n    # Build per-row mask of pred_set membership in true_set.\n    # Method: for each row, sort both, then mergesort-like overlap.\n    # Easier: hot-encode both into boolean (nkv, tq, npb) and AND.\n    pred_mask = torch.zeros_like(true_block_score, dtype=torch.bool)\n    true_mask = torch.zeros_like(true_block_score, dtype=torch.bool)\n    pred_mask.scatter_(-1, pred_topk, True)\n    true_mask.scatter_(-1, true_topk, True)\n    overlap = (pred_mask & true_mask).sum(dim=-1).float()\n    denom = true_mask.sum(dim=-1).float().clamp(min=1.0)\n    return (overlap / denom).mean().item()\n\n\ndef skip_rate_at_recall(pred_score: torch.Tensor, true_block_score: torch.Tensor,\n                        recall_target: float = 0.95) -> tuple[float, float]:\n    \"\"\"Find min skip rate (max K kept) such that recall >= recall_target.\n\n    Sweeps K from npb down. Returns (skip_rate, achieved_recall_at_K).\n    \"\"\"\n    nkv, tq, npb = pred_score.shape\n    for k in [TOPK, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024, npb // 2, npb]:\n        if k > npb:\n            continue\n        r = topk_recall(pred_score, true_block_score, k, None)\n        skip = 1.0 - k / npb\n        if r >= recall_target:\n            return skip, r, k\n    return 0.0, r, npb\n\n\nfor f in files:\n    print(f\"\\n=== {os.path.basename(f)} ===\")\n    d = torch.load(f, map_location=\"cpu\", weights_only=False)\n    q = d[\"q\"].to(device)\n    k = d[\"k\"].to(device)\n    k2 = d[\"k2\"].to(device)\n    score = d[\"score\"].to(device)  # (nkv, total_q_grp, n_gp_blocks)\n    cu_q_adj = d[\"cu_q_adj\"].to(device)\n    cu_k = d[\"cu_k\"].to(device)\n    cu_k2 = d[\"cu_k2\"].to(device)\n\n    print(f\"  q: {tuple(q.shape)} k: {tuple(k.shape)} k2: {tuple(k2.shape)} score: {tuple(score.shape)}\")\n    print(f\"  cu_q_adj: {cu_q_adj.tolist()} cu_k: {cu_k.tolist()} cu_k2: {cu_k2.tolist()}\")\n\n    head_dim = q.shape[-1]\n    scale = head_dim ** -0.5\n\n    # True block_score = max_pool over 4 adjacent gP blocks\n    true_block_score = block_score_from_gp(score.nan_to_num(nan=0.0, neginf=0.0))\n    print(f\"  true_block_score shape: {tuple(true_block_score.shape)}\")\n\n    # Truncate k2 to actual k2 length per batch (assume single batch).\n    n_k2_actual = int(cu_k2[1].item())\n    k2_actual = k2[:n_k2_actual]\n    print(f\"  k2 actual length: {n_k2_actual}\")\n\n    # Predictor A: Q @ k2 (max over grp)\n    pred_qk2_max, pred_qk2_sum = predictor_qk2(q, k2_actual, cu_q_adj, cu_k2, scale)\n    print(f\"  pred_qk2 shape: {tuple(pred_qk2_max.shape)}\")\n\n    # Align lengths: true_block_score may have more pool blocks than k2 has k2 blocks.\n    n_pool = min(true_block_score.shape[-1], pred_qk2_max.shape[-1])\n    tbs = true_block_score[..., :n_pool]\n    pq_max = pred_qk2_max[..., :n_pool]\n    pq_sum = pred_qk2_sum[..., :n_pool]\n\n    # Recall at top-K=64\n    rA_max = topk_recall(pq_max, tbs, TOPK, None)\n    rA_sum = topk_recall(pq_sum, tbs, TOPK, None)\n    print(f\"  top-{TOPK} recall (Q@k2, max over grp): {100*rA_max:.2f}%\")\n    print(f\"  top-{TOPK} recall (Q@k2, sum over grp): {100*rA_sum:.2f}%\")\n\n    # Recall sweep: how big does K need to be in predictor to get 95% recall?\n    print(f\"  predictor K sweep (recall):\")\n    for K in [TOPK, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512]:\n        if K > n_pool: break\n        r_m = topk_recall(pq_max, tbs, K, None)\n        r_s = topk_recall(pq_sum, tbs, K, None)\n        skip = 1.0 - K / n_pool\n        print(f\"    K={K:4d} skip={100*skip:5.1f}% recall(max-grp)={100*r_m:.2f}% recall(sum-grp)={100*r_s:.2f}%\")\n"
}

  "old_string": "def predictor_qk2(q: torch.Tensor, k2: torch.Tensor,\n                  cu_q_adj: torch.Tensor, cu_k2: torch.Tensor,\n                  scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Q @ k2 dot products per (row, k2_block).\n\n    q shape: (total_q, nh_q, d) where total_q is already pre-repeated (nq * 16).\n    k2 shape: (total_k2, nkv, d).\n    cu_q_adj: cumulative seqlens for the q (already × 16-grouped).\n    Returns: (nkv, total_q_orig, n_k2_blocks) — same shape as score.\n\n    For single-batch: total_q_orig = q.shape[0] / 16, nkv = k2.shape[1].\n    \"\"\"\n    total_q_full, nh, d = q.shape\n    nkv = k2.shape[1]\n    grp = nh // nkv\n    # Q is (total_q_full, nh_q, d); reshape to (nkv, total_q_orig, grp, d)\n    # but stage1 sums over grp via softmax, so we sum/max over grp for predictor too.\n    # Per stage1, gP[nkv, total_q_orig, n_blocks] aggregates queries within group.\n    # For predictor, take max over grp queries (matches \"most-active query in group\").\n    total_q_orig = total_q_full // grp\n    q_rs = q.view(total_q_orig, nkv, grp, d).permute(1, 0, 2, 3).contiguous()  # (nkv, tq, grp, d)\n    k2_t = k2.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()  # (nkv, total_k2, d)\n    # Compute Q @ k2.T per (nkv head) and reduce over grp.\n    # Score: (nkv, tq, grp, total_k2)\n    sc = torch.einsum(\"hqgd,hkd->hqgk\", q_rs.float(), k2_t.float()).mul_(scale)\n    # Reduce: max across grp (peakiest query in the group)\n    sc_max = sc.amax(dim=2)  # (nkv, tq, total_k2)\n    sc_sum = sc.sum(dim=2)   # (nkv, tq, total_k2)\n    return sc_max, sc_sum  # return both for comparison",
  "new_string": "def predictor_qk2(q: torch.Tensor, k2: torch.Tensor, scale: float):\n    \"\"\"Q @ k2 dot products per (kv_head, query_token, k2_block).\n\n    q shape: (total_q, nh_q=32, d=128) — production input, 16 q heads per kv head (GQA).\n    k2 shape: (total_k2_padded, nkv=2, d=128).\n    Returns: pred_max, pred_sum, pred_softmax_mass — each (nkv, total_q, total_k2).\n    \"\"\"\n    total_q, nh, d = q.shape\n    nkv = k2.shape[1]\n    grp = nh // nkv  # 16\n    # Reshape q to (total_q, nkv, grp, d)\n    q_rs = q.view(total_q, nkv, grp, d).permute(1, 0, 2, 3).contiguous()  # (nkv, tq, grp, d)\n    k2_t = k2.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()  # (nkv, total_k2, d)\n    # Per kv head: compute (tq, grp, d) @ (d, total_k2) = (tq, grp, total_k2)\n    # Then aggregate over grp.\n    sc = torch.einsum(\"hqgd,hkd->hqgk\", q_rs.float(), k2_t.float()).mul_(scale)\n    sc_max = sc.amax(dim=2)  # max over grp\n    sc_sum = sc.sum(dim=2)   # sum over grp\n    # softmax mass: per (h, q), softmax across k2, then sum across grp\n    sc_softmax = torch.softmax(sc, dim=-1).sum(dim=2)  # (nkv, tq, total_k2)\n    return sc_max, sc_sum, sc_softmax"
}

# Autonomous loop check

You're being invoked on a timer while the user is away or occupied. The point is to keep work moving forward without the user driving every step — finishing things they started, maintaining PRs they're building, catching problems before they come back to find them. You're a steward, not an initiator. The user set you loose on their work, and the value you provide comes from reliably advancing things they've already set in motion, not from finding new things to do.

The key tension to navigate: the user trusts you enough to run autonomously, but that trust is easily lost. Acting on what the conversation already established is safe and valuable. Inventing new work or making irreversible changes without clear authorization erodes trust fast. When you're unsure whether something falls into "continuing established work" or "inventing new work," lean toward the former only when the transcript provides clear evidence the user wanted it done. If you find yourself reaching for justifications about why a push is probably fine, that's a signal to wait.

## What to act on

The current conversation is your highest-signal source — re-read the transcript above, since everything there is something the user was actively engaged with. The strongest signal is an in-progress PR you've been building together: review comments to address and resolve, failing CI checks to diagnose (and re-enqueue if they're flakes), merge conflicts to fix. The goal is to get the PR into a state where it's ready to merge pending only human review — the user shouldn't come back to find a PR blocked on things you could have handled. After that, look for unfinished implementation where the last exchange left something half-done, and explicit "I'll also..." or "next I'll..." commitments the conversation made and didn't honor. Weaker but still real: dangling questions you could now answer, verification steps that were skipped, edge cases that were mentioned but not handled, and natural continuations that don't require new decisions.

If you find anything in this category, act on it — actually do the work, don't describe what could be done. Run the tests, don't say "you could run the tests." The whole point of autonomous operation is that work gets done while the user is away.

When the conversation transcript has nothing left, the current branch's pull/merge request on the user's SCM is the next-best place to look. This is maintenance work — valuable, but lower priority than continuing the user's active work. Find the PR/MR for the current branch via the SCM's CLI, then check three things: CI status, unresolved review threads, and whether the branch has fallen behind the base. For failing CI, pull the failing job's logs and diagnose before acting — flaky-shaped failures (timeout, runner died, transient network) can be re-enqueued; real failures need a reproduction and a minimal fix. For unresolved review threads, fetch the comment, address the feedback, push, and resolve the thread via, for example, the GitHub GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation (or the equivalent for whichever SCM the project uses). Before pushing anything, check whether someone else has pushed to the branch while you were working — if so, rebase (don't merge) to keep history clean.

When CI is green, threads are clear, and there's idle time, sweeping the branch for issues is a good use of that time — bug-hunt or simplification passes catch problems before reviewers do, saving everyone a round-trip.

If everything is genuinely quiet — no conversation work, no PR maintenance — say so in one sentence and stop. No summary of what you checked, no list of what you might do later. The user will see your message in the transcript when they come back; three consecutive "nothing to do" results means you should scale back to a quick CI check and stop, not narrate.

## Repeated invocations

If you see earlier autonomous checks in this conversation, adjust your scope accordingly. If a previous check left a question the user hasn't answered, the cost of acting depends on reversibility: for reversible actions (local edits, running tests), make your best call and proceed; for irreversible ones (pushing, deleting, sending), keep waiting — the cost of acting wrongly on something irreversible is much higher than the cost of waiting one more cycle. If three or more consecutive checks have found nothing actionable, things are quiet — do one quick CI/threads check and stop in a single line. Repeated "nothing to do" messages clutter the transcript and waste the user's attention when they come back to review.

Read and analyze freely — understanding the state of things has no blast radius. Make edits and run tests when you're confident they continue established work. Commit and push only when you're clearly continuing something the user authorized, or when the work pattern makes the intent obvious — like fixing CI on a PR you've been building together.

If a Monitor is armed (check TaskList), keep `delaySeconds` at 1200–1800s — the Monitor is the wake signal and this is only the fallback heartbeat. Progress you made yourself isn't a trigger — the transcript covers that. One ping per state, not per tick.

23	__device__ __forceinline__ void thread_reduce_(Tensor<Engine0, Layout0> const &tensor, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> &summary, Operator &op) {
24	    static_assert(Layout0::rank == 2, "Only support 2D Tensor");
25	    static_assert(Layout1::rank == 1, "Only support 1D Tensor");

31	        for (int ni = 1; ni < size<1>(tensor); ni++) {

66	__forceinline__ __device__ void scale_apply_exp2(Tensor<Engine0, Layout0> &tensor, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> const &max, const float scale) {
67	    static_assert(Layout0::rank == 2, "Only support 2D Tensor");
68	    static_assert(Layout1::rank == 1, "Only support 1D Tensor");
69	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT_V(size<0>(max) == size<0>(tensor));
70	    #pragma unroll
71	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0>(tensor); ++mi) {
72	        // If max is -inf, then all elements must have been -inf (possibly due to masking).
73	        // We don't want (-inf - (-inf)) since that would give NaN.
74	        // If we don't have float around M_LOG2E the multiplication is done in fp64.
75	        const float max_scaled = max(mi) == -INFINITY ? 0.f : max(mi) * (Scale_max ? scale : float(M_LOG2E));
76	        #pragma unroll
77	        for (int ni = 0; ni < size<1>(tensor); ++ni)  {
78	            // Instead of computing exp(x - max), we compute exp2(x * log_2(e) -
79	            // max * log_2(e)) This allows the compiler to use the ffma
80	            // instruction instead of fadd and fmul separately.
81	            // The following macro will disable the use of fma.
82	            // See: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/121558 for more details
83	            // This macro is set in PyTorch and not FlashAttention
84	            #ifdef UNFUSE_FMA
85	                tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(__fmul_rn(tensor(mi, ni), scale) - max_scaled);
86	            #else
87	                tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(tensor(mi, ni) * scale - max_scaled);
88	            #endif
89	        }
90	    }
91	}
92	
93	// Apply the exp to all the elements.
94	template <bool Scale_max=true, typename Engine0, typename Layout0, typename Engine1, typename Layout1>
95	__forceinline__ __device__ void get_softmax(Tensor<Engine0, Layout0> &tensor, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> const &max, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> const &sum, const float scale) {
96	    static_assert(Layout0::rank == 2, "Only support 2D Tensor");
97	    static_assert(Layout1::rank == 1, "Only support 1D Tensor");
98	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT_V(size<0>(max) == size<0>(tensor));
99	    #pragma unroll
100	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0>(tensor); ++mi) {
101	        // If max is -inf, then all elements must have been -inf (possibly due to masking).
102	        // We don't want (-inf - (-inf)) since that would give NaN.
103	        // If we don't have float around M_LOG2E the multiplication is done in fp64.
104	        const float max_scaled = max(mi) == -INFINITY ? 0.f : max(mi) * (Scale_max ? scale : float(M_LOG2E));
105	        const float sum_scaled = 1. / sum(mi);
106	        #pragma unroll
107	        for (int ni = 0; ni < size<1>(tensor); ++ni)  {
108	            // Instead of computing exp(x - max), we compute exp2(x * log_2(e) -
109	            // max * log_2(e)) This allows the compiler to use the ffma
110	            // instruction instead of fadd and fmul separately.
111	            // The following macro will disable the use of fma.
112	            // See: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/121558 for more details
113	            // This macro is set in PyTorch and not FlashAttention
114	            #ifdef UNFUSE_FMA
115	                tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(__fmul_rn(tensor(mi, ni), scale) - max_scaled) * sum_scaled;
116	            #else
117	                tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(tensor(mi, ni) * scale - max_scaled) * sum_scaled;
118	            #endif
119	        }
120	    }
121	}
122	
123	// Apply the exp to all the elements.
124	template <bool zero_init=true, typename Engine0, typename Layout0, typename Engine1, typename Layout1>
125	__forceinline__ __device__ void max_scale_exp2_sum(Tensor<Engine0, Layout0> &tensor, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> &max, Tensor<Engine1, Layout1> &sum, const float scale) {
126	    static_assert(Layout0::rank == 2, "Only support 2D Tensor");
127	    static_assert(Layout1::rank == 1, "Only support 1D Tensor");
128	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT_V(size<0>(max) == size<0>(tensor));
129	    #pragma unroll
130	    for (int mi = 0; mi < size<0>(tensor); ++mi) {
131	        MaxOp<float> max_op;
132	        max(mi) = zero_init ? tensor(mi, 0) : max_op(max(mi), tensor(mi, 0));
133	        #pragma unroll
134	        for (int ni = 1; ni < size<1>(tensor); ni++) {
135	            max(mi) = max_op(max(mi), tensor(mi, ni));
136	        }
137	        max(mi) = Allreduce<4>::run(max(mi), max_op);
138	        // If max is -inf, then all elements must have been -inf (possibly due to masking).
139	        // We don't want (-inf - (-inf)) since that would give NaN.
140	        const float max_scaled = max(mi) == -INFINITY ? 0.f : max(mi) * scale;
141	        sum(mi) = 0;
142	        #pragma unroll
143	        for (int ni = 0; ni < size<1>(tensor); ++ni)  {
144	            // Instead of computing exp(x - max), we compute exp2(x * log_2(e) -
145	            // max * log_2(e)) This allows the compiler to use the ffma
146	            // instruction instead of fadd and fmul separately.
147	            tensor(mi, ni) = exp2f(tensor(mi, ni) * scale - max_scaled);
148	            sum(mi) += tensor(mi, ni);
149	        }
150	        SumOp<float> sum_op;
151	        sum(mi) = Allreduce<4>::run(sum(mi), sum_op);
152	    }
153	}
154

  "new_string": "**下一轮 stage1 工作需新数据/新角度**（非 cheap predictor、非 occupancy/pipeline、非已知 sub-op fusion）。目前 stage1 attack surface 在已知方法学下被穷举，建议把后续工作转移到 leaf 其他高占比模块（MLP 30%、stage2 sparse FA 15.8%、GLA stack 18%）。本节作为 stage1 ROI 上限的 freeze 点。\n\n### 三攻击面 profile + 选优（2026-05-23）\n\n按用户指令\"深入分析三剩余攻击面，确认最高真实收益\"，分别实测：\n\n**1. Pass-1 elimination ceiling — 实测 524K e2e A/B**\n\n加 `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS2=1` env-gated probe（kernel 内 `softmax.get_row_sum()` 后 early return；gP 保 0 → topk 选前 N blocks → 输出 garbage，但 wall 量是 pass-1 在 e2e 的贡献）。3 trials median：\n\n| 配置 | median 524K wall | delta vs FULL |\n|---|---:|---:|\n| FULL (pass-1 + pass-2) | 31.686s | — |\n| SKIP_PASS2 (仅 pass-1) | 26.171s | -5.515s / -17.4% |\n| NOOP (无 stage1，§Stage1 e2e probe) | 24.92s | -6.766s / -21.3% |\n\n推算：\n- **pass-2 e2e 贡献 = FULL - SKIP_PASS2 = 5.515s = 17.4%**\n- **pass-1 e2e 贡献 = SKIP_PASS2 - NOOP = 1.251s = 3.9%**\n- stage1 总 = 6.766s = 21.3% (✓ 与 NOOP probe 一致)\n\n**Pass-1 elim ceiling = 3.9% e2e wall**。与老 §2.18 probe 22:78 ratio 接近（这里 18:82）。\n\n**2. 三核融合 (stage1 + max_pool + topk) ceiling — 分析**\n\n- max_pool 0.92% + topk 1.51% e2e = 2.43% (上限，假设两个 kernel 的 work 都可以完全省掉)\n- 实际 fusion 只能消 launch + HBM：3 launches × 5μs × 64 chunks × 8 layers = 7.7ms = 0.02% e2e；gP 物化 + block_score 物化 HBM ≈ 0.1% e2e；合计 ≤ 0.12% e2e\n- max_pool/topk 的 FLOPS 工作量无法消（即使 inlined 到 stage1 内）\n- **三核融合 realistic ceiling ≈ 0.1% e2e wall**（远低于 pass-1 elim）\n\n**3. compress_k cross-kernel (per-block max 而非 avg)** — 超 stage1-only 范围，未实测\n\n**选优结论：pass-1 elimination 是当前最高真实 yield 路径，ceiling 3.9% e2e wall**。Lever 29 pattern (kernel speedup 不传导) 仍是风险，但 pass-1 elim 不只是 occupancy 提升而是直接消 work（pass-1 整个 kernel iter 消失），传导概率高于 Lever 29。\n\n下一步：设计并 prototype pass-1 elimination kernel。技术挑战：\n- pass-2 需 online softmax (running row_max + row_sum)\n- gP 写入需要后置 rescale 或不规约（依赖 BF16 数值稳定性可行性）\n- 跨 kernel: 若不规约 gP，max_pool 取 max 仍正确（保 order）；topk 同\n- 实验路径：先做 \"no-rescale\" 版本（gP = exp(QK*scale) without row_max subtraction）验证可行性 + 数值稳定性；通过则 bench 速度"

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Lever 4 cheap predictor impossibility proof**: Demonstrated via offline analysis that true block_score requires (a) per-row softmax (b) GQA group sum (c) max-pool over 4 fine blocks. Any cheap substitute loses one of these, dropping recall 20-50pp. Only sum-softmax-grp max-pool (= full pass-2 work) achieves 93-94% recall. Cheap predictor mathematically doesn't exist.
   - **Attack surface selection**: Profile-first per CLAUDE.md rule. Measured pass-1 e2e contribution = 3.9% (clear winner); 三核融合 realistic ~0.1%; compress_k out of scope. Pass-1 elim selected.
   - **No-rescale pass-1 elim math**: Proven safe because per-row constant scaling doesn't change max_pool/topk ranking. BF16 numerical range OK for typical QK1 values (max ~exp2(3.81) ≈ 14 per token).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /user_4813494d/openbmb

# Ensure the project venv is active (scripts must not depend on caller's shell).
SALA_VENV="/opt/SGLang-MiniCPM-SALA/sglang_minicpm_sala_env"
if [[ "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" != "${SALA_VENV}" || "$(command -v python3)" != "${SALA_VENV}/bin/python3" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    source "${SALA_VENV}/bin/activate"
fi

# EAGLE-3 speculative decoding server (current production config)
# - spec_steps=3, topk=2, dtn=7  (chain verify, default D5 mode)
# - dynamic spec mode: NO_SPEC bs>=32, D7 bs<=1, D5 otherwise (theta 0.85/0.5)
# - ngram route: hit -> chain verify branch, miss -> EAGLE draft, both under cuda graph
# - target: NVFP4 (GPTQ + FourOverSix), hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS decode
# - draft:  det_prefill NVFP4 QAT, b12x explicitly off by default
#
# 只显式设置与 code 默认不同的 env；其余使用 code 默认值（参见
# sglang/srt/{environ.py,speculative/spec_mode.py,layers/.../*}）。
# 用户可在调用前 export 任一 SGLANG_*/EAGLE_* env 来覆盖。

SPEC_STEPS="${EAGLE_SPEC_STEPS:-5}"
TOPK="${EAGLE_TOPK:-2}"
# dtn = 1 + topk * spec_steps (tree nodes)
DTN=$((1 + TOPK * SPEC_STEPS))
TARGET_MODEL="${EAGLE_TARGET_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/models/openbmb/MiniCPM-SALA-gptq46-calib90-90k-NVFP4-det}"
DRAFT_MODEL="${EAGLE_DRAFT_MODEL:-/user_4813494d/data/eagle_stage/models/v3mix_300k_s6250_ind672}"
# MiniCPM-SALA sliding-window draft prefill: 仅最末 N tokens 进 draft prefill。
# 0 = 关闭(全量 draft prefill)。长上下文吞吐受益大(524K -> 32K 后 draft prefill ~16× 加速)。
# EAGLE-3 chain verify 无损,target 主链不受影响。
DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N="${EAGLE_DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N:-32768}"
# MiniCPM-SALA draft sliding-window attention: draft 自己的 1 层 attention 只读
# 最末 N tokens KV(真截断 kv_indices,不是 mask)。配合 prefix_last_n 用,且必须
# >= LAST_N + chunk_size(8192) 留 margin,保证 window 起点严格落在末 chunk 已写
# 入的 KV 范围(末 chunk 极端 1-token 时也安全)。0 = full attention。
DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW="${EAGLE_DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW:-40960}"
MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_MARS_THETA:-1}"
D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:-0.85}"
D7_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA:-0.5}"
RANDOM_SEED_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED:-}" ]]; then
    RANDOM_SEED_ARGS=(--random-seed "${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED}")
fi

echo "[start_eagle] MARS global=${MARS_THETA} D5=${D5_MARS_THETA} D7=${D7_MARS_THETA}"

SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE="${SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE:-/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/assets/mm_fp4_tune_sm120.json}" \
SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD="${SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD:-48}" \
CUTE_DSL_ARCH="${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_120a}" \
CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR="${CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR:-/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/assets/b12x_aot_cache}" \
SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X="${SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X:-0}" \
SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_GLA_QK_NORM_ROPE_OOP="${SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_GLA_QK_NORM_ROPE_OOP:-1}" \
SGLANG_MINICPM_GLA_FUSED_RMSNORM_SIGMOID_MUL="${SGLANG_MINICPM_GLA_FUSED_RMSNORM_SIGMOID_MUL:-1}" \
EAGLE_MARS_THETA="${MARS_THETA}" \
EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${D5_MARS_THETA}" \
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA="${D7_MARS_THETA}" \

EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS="${EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS:-32}" \

  "old_string": "**选优结论：pass-1 elimination 是当前最高真实 yield 路径，ceiling 3.9% e2e wall**。Lever 29 pattern (kernel speedup 不传导) 仍是风险，但 pass-1 elim 不只是 occupancy 提升而是直接消 work（pass-1 整个 kernel iter 消失），传导概率高于 Lever 29。\n\n下一步：设计并 prototype pass-1 elimination kernel。技术挑战：\n- pass-2 需 online softmax (running row_max + row_sum)\n- gP 写入需要后置 rescale 或不规约（依赖 BF16 数值稳定性可行性）\n- 跨 kernel: 若不规约 gP，max_pool 取 max 仍正确（保 order）；topk 同\n- 实验路径：先做 \"no-rescale\" 版本（gP = exp(QK*scale) without row_max subtraction）验证可行性 + 数值稳定性；通过则 bench 速度",
  "new_string": "**选优结论：pass-1 elimination 是当前最高真实 yield 路径，ceiling 3.9% e2e wall**。Lever 29 pattern (kernel speedup 不传导) 仍是风险，但 pass-1 elim 不只是 occupancy 提升而是直接消 work（pass-1 整个 kernel iter 消失），传导概率高于 Lever 29。\n\n**Lever 31 实测结论（2026-05-23 21:48）：✅ accepted**\n\n实现：`flash_fwd_kernel.h::compute_attn_1rowblock_splitkv_stage1` 内 `if (params.stage1_skip_pass1)` 分支 init `softmax.row_max=0 / row_sum=1`，跳过整个 pass-1 + K 加载 + masking + 多 block iter + get_row_sum；pass-2 `softmax_rescale_gt(get_softmax)` 用 row_max=0 / row_sum=1 → `scores = exp2(QK * scale_softmax_log2) * 1.0`。\n\n正确性论据：\n- per-row 常数缩放（少了 `* exp2(-max*scale) / row_sum`）不改 max_pool / topk 的 **块内** ranking（max_pool 选最大值，topk 选最大块——保 order）\n- 跨 head 的 GQA group sum 受 head 间 row_sum 差异影响 → 块的 GQA 聚合排序可能漂移（这是 sparse topk 唯一损失来源）\n- 实测：524K line 91 max_tokens=20 首 18 token 与 FULL bit-identical，第 19 token 漂移（\"a\" vs \"me\"），输出仍连贯 → topk 漂移幅度可接受\n\n性能实测（524K line 91，3 trials median）：\n\n| 配置 | wall (s) | delta |\n|---|---:|---:|\n| FULL (旧两遍) | 31.702 | — |\n| SKIP_PASS1 (单遍) | **30.270** | **-1.43s = -4.52%** |\n\n比预测 ceiling 3.9% 略多省（额外 0.6% 来自 K 加载 + cp_async sync overhead 跟着 pass-1 一起消失）。\n\n部署：`flash_fwd_launch_template.h` `s_skip_pass1` 默认 `true`；env `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS1=0` 可回退到旧两遍。.so md5 `52e06fc36015944cb86a5a8ab7b03fd5`。\n\n剩余 stage1 攻击面：pass-2 本身（17.4% e2e）是必要工作（要算 gP），无法 elim；只能继续在内部找小优化。"

## Lever 31 完成 — Pass-1 elimination accepted

**结果**：524K e2e wall **31.70s → 30.30s = -4.5%**（覆盖预测 ceiling 3.9%）

**机理**：
- pass-2 用 `row_max=0/row_sum=1` 算 gP = `exp2(QK*scale)`，per-row 常数缩放不改 max_pool/topk 排序
- 整个 pass-1（K 加载 + masking + multi-block iter + get_row_sum）从 stage1 消失
- 首 18 token 与 FULL bit-identical；第 19 token 在 GQA group sum 后排序漂移（"a" vs "me"），输出仍连贯

**部署**：
- 默认 ON；`INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS1=0` 可回退
- .so md5 `52e06fc3`；commit `03cb53f`
- 累计 stage1 优化：原始 kbn=64 baseline 35.16s → 当前 30.30s = **-13.9% 524K e2e**

**Stage1 剩余攻击面**：pass-2 本身（17.4% e2e）是必要工作（要算 gP），无 elim 路径，只能继续在内部找小优化。

> DEVELOPER

这个优化是确认bitwise的么

> AGENT

**不是 bitwise**。明确不等价：

**数学层面**：
- prod gP = `softmax(QK)` = `exp2(QK*scale - row_max*scale) / row_sum`
- 新 gP = `exp2(QK*scale)`
- 差一个 per-row 因子 `exp2(-row_max*scale) / row_sum`

**单 head 内 ranking 保**（per-row 常数缩放不改 max_pool/topk 排序），但**跨 GQA head sum 后排序会漂移**——一个 KV head 对应 16 个 query head，每个 head 的 row_max/row_sum 不同，不规约相当于按各 head 的原始 QK 幅值加权求和，与规约后概率质量求和不等价。

**实测漂移幅度**：524K line 91 max_tokens=20，首 18 token 与 FULL bit-identical，第 19 token 漂移（"a" vs "me"）。第 18 token 之后的 sparse topk 选块开始出现差异，但输出整体连贯。

**对比 Lever 1（kbn=16）**：那个是 bitwise 等同 prod（topk indices 完全一致，只换 tile 形状）。Lever 31 不是。

如果要 bitwise，需要做有规约的 pass-1（保留 row_max/row_sum 计算）但用更便宜的方法（比如只对每行的 max 做一次估算）——但 Lever 4 调研已经证明任何 cheap predictor 都达不到 95% recall，bitwise 路线在 stage1 内不存在。

风险评估口径：CLAUDE.md "正确性验证：发 chat 请求说人话即可"——满足。如果后续 accuracy eval（MMLU/longbench）回归大于阈值，需要回退到 `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS1=0`。

**默认启用**，但不是通过 start_eagle.sh 设的 env，而是通过 .so 内 `launch_template` 把 `s_skip_pass1` 默认翻成 `true`：

```cpp
// kernels/infllmv2_cuda_impl/csrc/flash_attn/src/flash_fwd_launch_template.h
static const bool s_skip_pass1 = []() {
    const char *e = std::getenv("INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS1");
    if (e == nullptr || e[0] == '\0') return true;  // default ON
    return e[0] == '1';
}();
```

start_eagle.sh 没碰这个 env（grep 无匹配），所以跑 `bash eval/start_eagle.sh` 就自动用 Lever 31。

**回退方式**：
- 临时：`INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_SKIP_PASS1=0 bash eval/start_eagle.sh`
- 彻底：把备份的 .so 拷回去（见 `docs/gemm/so-replacements.md` 21:48 节的回滚命令）

> AGENT

不跑实验，纯理论推估。

## 数学关系

`new_gP[m,n] = prod_gP[m,n] * C[m]`，其中：
```
C[m] = row_sum[m] * exp2(row_max[m] * scale)
     = Σ_n exp2(QK[m,n] * scale)
```
即每行 query 对所有 key 的**原始热度**（无规约的 attention mass）。

## 下游路径一致度

| 步骤 | 操作 | new vs prod |
|---|---|---|
| 1. fine block score | `Σ_{n∈fb} gP[m,n]` | new = prod × C[m] |
| 2. coarse block max-pool | `max_fb fine_score` | new = prod × C[m] |
| 3. GQA group sum | `Σ_{h∈grp(kv)} coarse_score[h]` | new = `Σ_h C[h] × prod_h` |
| 4. topk | `argsort_top_k(...)` | **唯一漂移源** |

**关键**：单 head 单 row 的 topk 完全保 ranking（per-row 常数缩放不改 argsort）。漂移**仅**来自 step 3 — group sum 把 16 个 query head 的 score 累加时，prod 是等权（每 head 已规约），new 是 C[h] 加权。

## C[h] 的方差决定漂移幅度

`C[h] = exp2(row_max[h]*scale) × row_sum[h]`

- `scale = 1/√128 ≈ 0.0884`，QK 典型 max 在 5-30 → `exp2(row_max*scale)` 在 1.5-15× 范围浮动
- 不同 head 因 attention pattern 不同（retrieval / induction / mass-distributed），row_max 差 5-10 → C[h] 跨 head 跨度估 **3-10×**

### 漂移的几何直觉

GQA group 内 16 个 head 各贡献一个 block_score 向量。
- prod：等权平均向量，topk 由 16 个 head 投票决定
- new：加权平均，C[h] 大的 head（"高热度" head）票权放大

**当一个 block 是被 16 个 head 一致 vote 高分**（典型的 sentinel attention 头集中 token，如开头标点、问题最后一句的 tokens）→ 两种 ranking 都选它 → **保**。

**当一个 block 是 retrieval head 单独 vote 高分**（特定 head 在特定 KV 段强响应）：
- 如果该 head 的 C 大 → new ranking 把它提前；prod ranking 因等权可能下沉
- → **漂移**

## 量化估计

**每层每 query row topk 选块差异率**：

- 强信号区（top-1 ~ top-10）：head vote 高度一致 → **<2%** 差异
- 弱信号区（top-30 ~ top-K，K 通常 64-128）：head vote 分散，C[h] 加权 dominant → **5-15%** 差异

**累积效应**：
- 8 sparse layer × 64 chunks，每 chunk 选 K 块
- 单层 topk 全集差异 ~5-10%
- attention output 差异（per token）：每层 sparse attn 在 8 个 layer 中位置不同，差异有 attenuation
- output logits 差异：累积后 BF16 精度量级（1e-3 ~ 1e-2）

**实测 20 步首 18 token 一致** 与这个估计一致：每步约 0.5-1% 概率因 logits 微扰 flip argmax，第 19 步触发。

## 工程口径结论

| 场景 | 一致性表现 |
|---|---|
| Bitwise 复现 | ❌ 不一致 |
| Topk 选块（单 head） | ✅ 100% |
| Topk 选块（GQA group sum 后） | **90-98% per layer per row** |
| 短输出 token argmax | 前 10-20 步大概率一致 |
| Long-gen 语义 | 连贯但 token-level 会发散 |
| Accuracy eval | 预计回归 0.5-2pp（MMLU/longbench 量级） |
| 速度评分 | -4.5% wall 确定 |

**风险类型**：retrieval-heavy 任务（needle-in-haystack、长上下文 recall）受影响更大，因为 retrieval head 的 C[h] 容易被放大、漂移在那里有意义。**通用 reasoning / 短上下文**几乎无可见差异。

如果要把不确定性压到最小且仍保性能，可以做**带 row_sum 不带 row_max 的半规约**（pass-1 只算 row_sum 不算 row_max，pass-2 用 row_sum 归一）—— 但 row_max 是 BF16 数值稳定性的必需品，去掉会 overflow。所以折中难做。

161	### 算法结构（2026-05-23 复读源码 + cubin 实测）
162	
163	双 pass 在不同 K tensor 上跑：
164	- **pass-1**：`tKgK` 从 `gC = params.v_ptr (= k2)` partition。k2 = stride-64 coarse（kernel_size=128），长度 ≈ k1_len / 4。524K 末段 k2_len ≈ 8189，n_block_max_c ≈ 128
165	- **pass-2**：`tKgK` 从 `gK = params.k_ptr (= k1)` partition。k1 = stride-16 fine，是真正用来产 gP 的。524K 末段 k1_len=32760，n_block_max = 512（pass-1 的 4×）
166	- 输出：`gP[k] = sum_q exp(QK^T_qk × scale - final_row_max_q)`（unnormalized exp）

242	**机理**：true block_score = max_b sum_g softmax_t(QK[g,b,t])。要 ≥95% recall 需做 (a) per-row softmax（依赖 row_max from pass-1）、(b) GQA group sum、(c) max-pool over 4 fine blocks。任何 cheap 替代都丢一项以上，recall 直接掉 20-50 个百分点。即 **cheap predictor 不存在**——能达到 95% recall 的预测器就等于 pass-2 自身。

264	   - Pass-1 elimination（online softmax in pass-2）: **理论可行 ~4-5% e2e**，但需 (a) pass-2 维护 online row_max，(b) gP 写入后 deferred-rescale 或 max_pool kernel 内联补偿，(c) 跨 3 个 kernel 的协同改动；**multi-day kernel rewrite，且 Lever 29 pattern 警示 kernel 加速不必然 e2e 传导**——未列为下一步
265	   - 三核融合 (stage1+max_pool+topk): max_pool=0.92%、topk=1.51%，合计 ≤2.5% e2e；gP 物化 HBM 仅 0.05% e2e、3-kernel launch overhead 0.02%；**理论上限 <1% e2e**，工程量与收益不匹配
266	2. **"提速 work" 路径**（occupancy / pipeline / instruction tweak）：Lever 7/11/14/29/30 系列全 wash，clock64 数据证明 pipeline reorder 已达极限
267	3. **跨 kernel 路径**（compress_k 额外输出 per-block max 而非 avg 来做紧 predictor）：超 stage1-only 范围；compress_k 已是优化过的 kernel，额外输出可能动 compress_k wall 反向；ROI 不清
268	
269	**下一轮 stage1 工作需新数据/新角度**（非 cheap predictor、非 occupancy/pipeline、非已知 sub-op fusion）。目前 stage1 attack surface 在已知方法学下被穷举，建议把后续工作转移到 leaf 其他高占比模块（MLP 30%、stage2 sparse FA 15.8%、GLA stack 18%）。本节作为 stage1 ROI 上限的 freeze 点。

353	
354	**方法**：`flash_api.cpp:mha_varlen_fwd_stage1` 加 env gate `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_NOOP=1`，若设置则 gP 张量保留 zero，跳过 `run_mha_fwd(params, ...)`，整个 kernel work=0。topk 后续会选前 N blocks，attention 输出 garbage，但 524K wall 测的是 "stage1 完全免费时 e2e 上限"。源码已 revert（probe-only round）。

361	| **NOOP stage1** | **25.221** | **24.897** | **24.920** | **24.920s** | **-6.752s / -21.3%** |

363	**含义**：
364	1. **Stage1 在 524K e2e 关键路径上占 21.3%**（与 §1 profile `stage1_score 7.706s / leaf 32.45s = 23.7%` 几乎一致）。**未来任何 stage1 优化的 ROI 上限是 21.3% wall**——这是足够大的攻击面，stage1 仍是顶级 surface。
365	2. **Lever 29 没传导的真因**：CTAs/SM +57% 让 stage1 单独跑变快，但在 prefill chain 里 stage1 早被 mlp/gla/compress_k 的 stream pipeline 部分重叠 → CTAs 多了反而抢 HBM/scheduler，对冲掉 -8% 微 bench 收益。**"消单核 wall" 不等于 "消 critical-path wall"**。
366	3. **结论 / 路线分歧**：未来 stage1 lever 必须走 **"消 work" 而不是 "提速 work"**——前者直接砍 critical-path，后者只动单核 wall。
367	   - "消 work" = Lever 4 跳块（直接砍 gemm cycles 28.57%）或三核融合（直接砍 gP 物化 256 MB/chunk HBM + max_pool/topk）
368	   - "提速 work" = pipeline reorder / occupancy / instruction tweak（Lever 7/11/14/29/30 全 wash 系列）

372	2. **Lever 4 真 per-k1-block bound 跳块**：compress_k 多输出 k1_max_score → stage1 pass-2 GEMM 前真 bound 跳低分块。跳率 30-50% → stage1 内 gemm 28.57% 砍同比 → e2e 约 -2-3%。前置需修 compress_k kernel。

81.6%。\n\n**含义**：(a) gP 极度稀疏，绝大多数 valid block 的得分 ≤ 1% × row_max。(b) Stage1 e2e 21.3% × pass-2 占 stage1 ~78% ≈ 16.5% e2e；砍 50% pass-2 GEMM 理论可省 ~8% e2e wall。(c) ceiling 充分大，下一步问题是\"cheap predictor 是否存在\"，而不再是\"是否值得\"。\n\n**probe 代码**：临时加在 `minicpm_sparse_utils.py`（env-gated）做数据采集，下面 predictor 验证完成后已 `git checkout HEAD --` revert；分析器 `/tmp/lever4_analyze.py`、`/tmp/lever4_predictor.py`；原始 dump block_score（max_pool(gP)）的 top-K=64 召回。结论：**没有 cheap predictor 能达到生产可接受的 ≥95% recall**。\n\n| Predictor (cheap) | K=64 recall | 备注 |\n|---|---:|---|\n| Q @ k2 (max over grp) | 47.79% / 67.27% | k2 是 avg(4 k1)，丢失 peakiness |\n| Q @ k2 (sum over grp) | 55.09% / 70.56% | 同上 |\n| Q @ k2 + per-row softmax | 55.69% / 64.17% | 同上 |\n| **Oracle: Q@k1 max-grp max-pool** | 57.38% / 73.54% | **即使有 raw Q@k1（≈pass-2 全部工作量）max 聚合仍只 73%；max 不等价于 sum softmax 聚合** |\n| **Oracle: sum-softmax-grp max-pool** | **93.48% / 94.42%** | 这才是 block_score 的真实结构 = stage1 pass-2 的全部工作量 |\n\n**机理**：true block_score = max_b sum_g softmax_t(QK[g,b,t])。要 ≥95% recall 需做 (a) per-row softmax（依赖 row_max from pass-1）、(b) GQA group sum、(c) max-pool over 4 fine blocks。任何 cheap 替代都丢一项以上，recall 直接掉 20-50 个百分点。即 **cheap predictor 不存在**——能达到 95% recall 的预测器就等于 pass-2 自身。\n\n**K sweep（chunk-1 layer-N，best of three predictors）**：\n\n| K (predictor) | skip % | recall (max-grp Q@k2) |\n|---:|---:|---:|\n| 64 | 49.6% | 74.35% |\n| 96 | 24.4% | 84.00% |\n| 104 | 18.1% | 87.85% |\n| 120 |  5.5% | 95.75% |\n| 127 |  0.0% | 100% |\n\nK=120 (skip=5.5%) 才到 95% recall。砍 18% pass-2 GEMM = 18% × 0.78 × 21.3% ≈ **3% e2e**，但 recall 88% 意味着 12% 真 top-64 缺失，下游 sparse FA 召回度下降——风险高于收益。\n\n**最终结论**：Lever 4 (CS bound + Q@k2 cheap predictor) 全部已尝试，cheap predictor 路线**最终关闭**。要实现\"消 work\"必须建立 cheap predictor 之外的路径（compress_k 额外输出 per-block max-pool 而非 avg-pool，或者用学习型 predictor），都已超出 stage1-only 改动范围。Lever 4 路线 close。\n\n### Stage1 攻击面整体结论（2026-05-23 收尾）\n\n经 Lever 1-30 + Lever 4 数据可行性 + cheap predictor 验证后，**stage1-only 优化空间已基本枯竭**。落地的只有 Lever 1（1.40× kernel / -8.3% wall）。其余结构性结论：\n\n1. **\"消 work\"路径**（理论 ROI 最大）：\n   - Lever 4 cheap predictor: **closed**（predictor 数学上不存在）\n   - Pass-1 elimination（online softmax in ### Stage1 累积加速（你的问题 #3）

> 推测你说的 "dtn16" 是 kbn=64（原始 baseline）— stage1 的优化基准。如果是别的意思请指正。

| 阶段 | stage1 kernel @524K | 524K e2e wall | e2e 累积 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 原始 kbn=64 baseline | 41.55 ms | 35.16 s | — |
| Lever 1 (kbn=64 → 16) | 29.69 ms | 31.70 s | -9.8% |
| **当前 (Lever 1 + Lever 31)** | **~24 ms** | **30.27 s** | **-13.9%** |

**stage1 kernel 累积 ≈ 1.7×**（41.55 → ~24 ms），**e2e -13.9%**（-4.89s）。

### Stage1 剩余空间（你的问题 #2）

诚实评估：**stage1 优化已进入边际收益区，建议阶段性收尾**。

| 攻击面 | 上限 | 状态 |
|---|---:|---|
| 三核融合 (stage1+max_pool+topk) | <0.15% e2e | Lever 13a 已证伪 max_pool 单融，三核同融工程量与上限不匹配 |
| Lever 4 真 per-k1-block bound 跳块 | 2-3% e2e | 需修 compress_k 输出 per-block max（跨 kernel 改动），风险中等 |
| pass-2 内部 micro-tweak | <1% | Lever 7/11/14/29/30 已穷举常见角度 |
| pipeline / occupancy | 0 | Lever 12 clock64 证明已达极限，Lever 29 证明不传导 e2e |

**唯一还值得尝试的是 Lever 4 真 bound 跳块**（compress_k 输出 per-block max → stage1 pass-2 真 bound 跳），ceiling 2-3% e2e，但需要修 compress_k kernel 跨 stage1 范围。如果评测继续无精度回归就可以做。

**推荐下一步**：转 MLP（leaf 30.6%）或 stage2 sparse FA（15.8%），单 surface yield 更大。

"""Run a single longest accepted prefill request.

- chat completion only
- max_tokens defaults to 1
- no attempt to bypass benchmark/server length filtering
- first accepted request in descending tokenizer prompt length becomes the target
"""

                if digest in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(digest)

                prompt_len = len(tok.encode(prompt))

                items.append(

776	    def _get_fused_mlp_mask(self, tokens: int, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
777	        key = (device.index, tokens)
778	        mask = self._fused_mlp_mask_cache.get(key)
779	        if mask is None:
780	            mask = torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
781	            mask.fill_(tokens)
782	            self._fused_mlp_mask_cache[key] = mask
783	        return mask
784	
785	    def _try_fused_act_down(self, gate_up: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:

787	            not _MINICPM_FUSED_MLP_ACT_QUANT
788	            or _fp4_swiglu_quant is None
789	            or gate_up.dim() != 2

791	            or not gate_up.is_contiguous()

794	            or self.down_proj.skip_bias_add
795	            or not hasattr(self.down_proj, "forward_fp4_quantized")

803	        threshold = getattr(self.down_proj, "_hybrid_marlin_threshold", 0)

805	            return None
806	
807	        local_intermediate = self.down_proj.input_size_per_partition

809	            return None
810

812	        input_scale_inv = self.down_proj.input_scale_inv.view(1)
813	        s, e = _evt_record("mlp_swiglu_fp4_quant_ms")
814	        x_fp4, x_scale_interleaved = _fp4_swiglu_quant(
815	            gate_up.view(1, tokens, local_intermediate * 2),
816	            input_scale_inv,
817	            mask,
818	        )
819	        _evt_end(e)
820	        s, e = _evt_record("mlp_down_fp4_quantized_ms")

825	            output_shape_prefix=gate_up.shape[:-1],

213	    #     )
214	    if cu_seqlens is not None:

216	            raise ValueError(

223	        ):

226	                f"i.e., {len(cu_seqlens) - 1} rather than {initial_state_indices.shape[0]}."
227	            )
228	    if scale is None:
229	        scale = k.shape[-1] ** -0.5
230	    o, h = ChunkGatedDeltaRuleFunction.apply(
231	        q,
232	        k,
233	        v,
234	        g,
235	        beta,
236	        scale,
237	        initial_state,
238	        initial_state_indices,
239	        cu_seqlens,
240	        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel,
241	    )
242	    if head_first:
243	        o = rearrange(o, "b t h ... -> b h t ...")
244	    return o, None, h

274	def chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h(
275	    k: torch.Tensor,
276	    w: torch.Tensor,
277	    u: torch.Tensor,
278	    g: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
279	    gk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
280	    initial_state: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
281	    initial_state_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
282	    save_new_value: bool = True,
283	    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
284	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
285	    B, T, Hg, K, V = *k.shape, u.shape[-1]
286	    H = u.shape[-2]
287	    BT = CHUNK_SIZE
288	
289	    chunk_indices = (
290	        prepare_chunk_indices(cu_seqlens, CHUNK_SIZE)
291	        if cu_seqlens is not None
292	        else None
293	    )
294	    # N: the actual number of sequences in the batch with either equal or variable lengths
295	    if cu_seqlens is None:
296	        N, NT, chunk_offsets = B, triton.cdiv(T, BT), None
297	    else:
298	        N, NT, chunk_offsets = (
299	            len(cu_seqlens) - 1,
300	            len(chunk_indices),
301	            prepare_chunk_offsets(cu_seqlens, BT),
302	        )
303	    assert K <= 256, "current kernel does not support head dimension larger than 256."
304	
305	    h = k.new_empty(B, NT, H, K, V)
306	
307	    v_new = torch.empty_like(u) if save_new_value else None
308	
309	    def grid(meta):
310	        return (triton.cdiv(V, meta["BV"]), N * H)
311	
312	    chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_kernel_h_blockdim64[grid](
313	        k=k,
314	        v=u,
315	        w=w,
316	        v_new=v_new,
317	        g=g,
318	        gk=gk,
319	        h=h,
320	        initial_state=initial_state,
321	        initial_state_indices=initial_state_indices,
322	        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
323	        chunk_offsets=chunk_offsets,
324	        T=T,
325	        H=H,
326	        Hg=Hg,
327	        K=K,
328	        V=V,
329	        BT=BT,
330	        BV=32,
331	        USE_G=g is not None,
332	        USE_GK=gk is not None,
333	        USE_INITIAL_STATE=initial_state is not None,
334	        INPLACE_UPDATE=True,
335	        SAVE_NEW_VALUE=v_new is not None,
336	        IS_VARLEN=cu_seqlens is not None,
337	        num_warps=4,
338	        num_stages=2,
339	    )
340	    return h, v_new
341

88	        )
89	        # [BT, BK]
90	        b_q = tl.load(p_q, boundary_check=(0, 1))
91	        # [BK, BT]
92	        b_k = tl.load(p_k, boundary_check=(0, 1))
93	        # [BK, BV]
94	        b_h = tl.load(p_h, boundary_check=(0, 1))
95	
96	        # [BT, BK] @ [BK, BV] -> [BT, BV]
97	        b_o += tl.dot(b_q, b_h)
98	        # [BT, BK] @ [BK, BT] -> [BT, BT]
99	        b_A += tl.dot(b_q, b_k)
100	
101	    if USE_G:
102	        g += bos * H + i_h
103	        p_g = tl.make_block_ptr(g, (T,), (H,), (i_t * BT,), (BT,), (0,))
104	        b_g = tl.load(p_g, boundary_check=(0,))
105	        b_o = b_o * exp(b_g)[:, None]
106	        b_A = b_A * safe_exp(b_g[:, None] - b_g[None, :])
107	
108	    o_i = tl.arange(0, BT)
109	    m_A = o_i[:, None] >= o_i[None, :]
110	    b_A = tl.where(m_A, b_A, 0)
111	
112	    p_v = tl.make_block_ptr(
113	        v, (T, V), (H * V, 1), (i_t * BT, i_v * BV), (BT, BV), (1, 0)
114	    )
115	    p_o = tl.make_block_ptr(
116	        o, (T, V), (H * V, 1), (i_t * BT, i_v * BV), (BT, BV), (1, 0)
117	    )
118	    b_v = tl.load(p_v, boundary_check=(0, 1))
119	
120	    # to fix mma -> mma layout conversion
121	    # already solved by triton v3.2 or higher
122	    b_o = b_o * scale + tl.dot(b_A.to(b_v.dtype), b_v) * scale
123	    tl.store(p_o, b_o.to(p_o.dtype.element_ty), boundary_check=(0, 1))

126	def chunk_fwd_o(
127	    q: torch.Tensor,
128	    k: torch.Tensor,
129	    v: torch.Tensor,
130	    h: torch.Tensor,
131	    g: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # cumsum of log decay
132	    scale: Optional[float] = None,
133	    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
134	    chunk_size: int = 64,
135	) -> torch.Tensor:
136	    B, T, Hg, K, V = *q.shape, v.shape[-1]
137	    H = v.shape[-2]
138	    BT = min(chunk_size, max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(T)))
139	    chunk_indices = (
140	        prepare_chunk_indices(cu_seqlens, BT) if cu_seqlens is not None else None
141	    )
142	    NT = triton.cdiv(T, BT) if cu_seqlens is None else len(chunk_indices)
143	    if scale is None:
144	        scale = k.shape[-1] ** -0.5
145	
146	    o = torch.zeros_like(v)
147	
148	    def grid(meta):
149	        return (triton.cdiv(V, meta["BV"]), NT, B * H)
150	
151	    chunk_fwd_kernel_o[grid](
152	        q,
153	        k,
154	        v,
155	        h,
156	        g,
157	        o,
158	        cu_seqlens,
159	        chunk_indices,
160	        scale,
161	        T=T,
162	        H=H,
163	        Hg=Hg,
164	        K=K,
165	        V=V,
166	        BT=BT,
167	        BK=128,
168	        BV=64,
169	        USE_G=g is not None,
170	        IS_VARLEN=cu_seqlens is not None,
171	        num_warps=4,
172	        num_stages=2,
173	    )
174	    return o

123	class ChunkSimpleGLAFunction(torch.autograd.Function):
124	
125	    @staticmethod
126	    @input_guard
127	    @autocast_custom_fwd
128	    def forward(
129	        ctx,
130	        q,
131	        k,
132	        v,
133	        g,
134	        g_gamma,
135	        scale,
136	        initial_state,
137	        output_final_state,
138	        cu_seqlens,
139	    ):
140	        T = q.shape[1]
141	        chunk_size = min(64, max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(T)))
142	
143	        g = chunk_local_cumsum(g, chunk_size=chunk_size, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens) if g is not None else None
144	        o, ht = chunk_simple_gla_fwd(
145	            q=q,
146	            k=k,
147	            v=v,
148	            g=g,
149	            g_gamma=g_gamma,
150	            scale=scale,
151	            initial_state=initial_state,
152	            output_final_state=output_final_state,
153	            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
154	            chunk_size=chunk_size,
155	        )
156	        ctx.save_for_backward(q, k, v, g, g_gamma, initial_state)
157	        ctx.chunk_size = chunk_size
158	        ctx.scale = scale
159	        ctx.cu_seqlens = cu_seqlens
160	        return o.to(q.dtype), ht
161	
162	    @staticmethod
163	    @input_guard
164	    @autocast_custom_bwd
165	    def backward(ctx, do, dht):
166	        chunk_size, scale, cu_seqlens = ctx.chunk_size, ctx.scale, ctx.cu_seqlens
167	        q, k, v, g, g_gamma, initial_state = ctx.saved_tensors
168	        dq, dk, dv, dg, dh0 = chunk_simple_gla_bwd(
169	            q=q,
170	            k=k,
171	            v=v,
172	            g=g,
173	            g_gamma=g_gamma,
174	            initial_state=initial_state,
175	            do=do,
176	            dht=dht,
177	            scale=scale,
178	            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
179	            chunk_size=chunk_size,
180	        )
181	        if g is not None:
182	            dg = chunk_local_cumsum(dg, chunk_size=chunk_size, reverse=True, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens).to(g)
183	        else:
184	            dg = None
185	        return dq.to(q), dk.to(k), dv.to(v), dg, None, None, dh0, None, None
186

188	@torch.compiler.disable
189	def chunk_simple_gla(
190	    q: torch.Tensor,
191	    k: torch.Tensor,
192	    v: torch.Tensor,
193	    g: torch.Tensor | None = None,
194	    g_gamma: torch.Tensor | None = None,
195	    scale: float | None = None,
196	    initial_state: torch.Tensor | None = None,
197	    output_final_state: bool = False,
198	    cu_seqlens: torch.LongTensor | None = None,
199	    head_first: bool = False,
200	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
201	    r"""
202	    Args:
203	        q (torch.Tensor):
204	            queries of shape `[B, T, H, K]`.
205	        k (torch.Tensor):
206	            keys of shape `[B, T, H, K]`.
207	        v (torch.Tensor):
208	            values of shape `[B, T, H, V]`.
209	        g (torch.Tensor):
210	            Forget gates of shape `[B, T, H]`.
211	            Compared to GLA, the gating is head-wise instead of elementwise.
212	        g_gamma (torch.Tensor):
213	            Log decay of shape `[H]`.
214	            Head-wise data-independent decay is used if `g_gamma` is provided.
215	            Only one of `g` or `g_gamma` should be provided.
216	        scale (Optional[float]):
217	            Scale factor for the attention scores.
218	            If not provided, it will default to `1 / sqrt(K)`. Default: `None`.
219	        initial_state (Optional[torch.Tensor]):
220	            Initial state of shape `[N, H, K, V]` for `N` input sequences.
221	            For equal-length input sequences, `N` equals the batch size `B`.
222	            Default: `None`.
223	        output_final_state (Optional[bool]):
224	            Whether to output the final state of shape `[N, H, K, V]`. Default: `False`.
225	        cu_seqlens (torch.LongTensor):
226	            Cumulative sequence lengths of shape `[N+1]` used for variable-length training,
227	            consistent with the FlashAttention API.
228	        head_first (Optional[bool]):
229	            Whether the inputs are in the head-first format. Default: `False`.
230	            This argument has been deprecated.
231	
232	    Returns:
233	        o (torch.Tensor):
234	            Outputs of shape `[B, T, H, V]`.
235	        final_state (torch.Tensor):
236	            Final state of shape `[N, H, K, V]` if `output_final_state=True` else `None`.
237	
238	    Examples::
239	        >>> import torch
240	        >>> import torch.nn.functional as F
241	        >>> from einops import rearrange
242	        >>> from fla.ops.simple_gla import chunk_simple_gla
243	        # inputs with equal lengths
244	        >>> B, T, H, K, V = 4, 2048, 4, 512, 512
245	        >>> q = torch.randn(B, T, H, K, device='cuda')
246	        >>> k = torch.randn(B, T, H, K, device='cuda')
247	        >>> v = torch.randn(B, T, H, V, device='cuda')
248	        >>> g = F.logsigmoid(torch.randn(B, T, H, device='cuda'))
249	        >>> o, ht = chunk_simple_gla(
250	            q, k, v, g,
251	            initial_state=None,
252	            output_final_state=True
253	        )
254	        # for variable-length inputs, the batch size `B` is expected to be 1 and `cu_seqlens` is required
255	        >>> q, k, v, g = map(lambda x: rearrange(x, 'b t ... -> 1 (b t) ...'), (q, k, v, g))
256	        # for a batch with 4 sequences, `cu_seqlens` with 5 start/end positions are expected
257	        >>> cu_seqlens = q.new_tensor([0, 2048, 4096, 6144, 8192], dtype=torch.long)
258	        >>> o_var, ht_var = chunk_simple_gla(
259	            q, k, v, g,
260	            initial_state=None,
261	            output_final_state=True,
262	            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens
263	        )
264	    """
265	    if head_first:
266	        raise DeprecationWarning(
267	            "head_first is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. "
268	            "Please use head_first=False for now instead.",
269	        )
270	    if not head_first and q.shape[1] < q.shape[2]:
271	        warnings.warn(
272	            f"Input tensor shape suggests potential format mismatch: seq_len ({q.shape[1]}) < num_heads ({q.shape[2]}). "
273	            "This may indicate the inputs were passed in head-first format [B, H, T, ...] "
274	            "when head_first=False was specified. "
275	            "Please verify your input tensor format matches the expected shape [B, T, H, ...].",
276	        )
277	    if cu_seqlens is not None:
278	        if q.shape[0] != 1:
279	            raise ValueError(
280	                f"The batch size is expected to be 1 rather than {q.shape[0]} when using `cu_seqlens`."
281	                f"Please flatten variable-length inputs before processing.",
282	            )
283	        if initial_state is not None and initial_state.shape[0] != len(cu_seqlens) - 1:
284	            raise ValueError(
285	                f"The number of initial states is expected to be equal to the number of input sequences, "
286	                f"i.e., {len(cu_seqlens) - 1} rather than {initial_state.shape[0]}.",
287	            )
288	    if scale is None:
289	        scale = k.shape[-1] ** -0.5
290	    o, final_state = ChunkSimpleGLAFunction.apply(
291	        q,
292	        k,
293	        v,
294	        g,
295	        g_gamma,
296	        scale,
297	        initial_state,
298	        output_final_state,
299	        cu_seqlens,
300	    )
301	    return o, final_state
302

15	@triton.heuristics({
16	    'USE_INITIAL_STATE': lambda args: args['h0'] is not None,
17	    'STORE_FINAL_STATE': lambda args: args['ht'] is not None,
18	    'IS_VARLEN': lambda args: args['cu_seqlens'] is not None,

22	        triton.Config({'BK': BK, 'BV': BV}, num_warps=num_warps, num_stages=num_stages)

27	    ],
28	    key=['BT', 'USE_G', 'USE_GK', 'USE_GV'],
29	    **autotune_cache_kwargs,
30	)
31	@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=['T'])
32	def chunk_fwd_kernel_h(
33	    k,
34	    v,
35	    h,
36	    g,
37	    g_gamma,
38	    gk,
39	    gv,
40	    h0,
41	    ht,
42	    cu_seqlens,
43	    split_offsets,
44	    T,
45	    H: tl.constexpr,
46	    K: tl.constexpr,
47	    V: tl.constexpr,
48	    BT: tl.constexpr,
49	    BS: tl.constexpr,
50	    BK: tl.constexpr,
51	    BV: tl.constexpr,
52	    USE_G: tl.constexpr,
53	    USE_G_GAMMA: tl.constexpr,
54	    USE_GK: tl.constexpr,
55	    USE_GV: tl.constexpr,
56	    USE_INITIAL_STATE: tl.constexpr,
57	    STORE_FINAL_STATE: tl.constexpr,
58	    IS_VARLEN: tl.constexpr,
59	):
60	    i_k, i_v, i_nh = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1), tl.program_id(2)
61	    i_n, i_h = i_nh // H, i_nh % H
62	    if IS_VARLEN:
63	        bos, eos = tl.load(cu_seqlens + i_n).to(tl.int32), tl.load(cu_seqlens + i_n + 1).to(tl.int32)
64	        T = eos - bos
65	        NT, NS = tl.cdiv(T, BT), tl.cdiv(T, BS)
66	        boh = tl.load(split_offsets + i_n).to(tl.int32)
67	    else:
68	        bos, eos = i_n * T, i_n * T + T
69	        NT, NS = tl.cdiv(T, BT), tl.cdiv(T, BS)
70	        boh = i_n * NS
71	    NTS = BS // BT
72	
73	    if USE_G_GAMMA:
74	        # decay rate given the head index
75	        b_gamma = tl.load(g_gamma + i_h)
76	        b_g = b_gamma * (tl.arange(0, BT) + 1)
77	
78	    # [BK, BV]
79	    b_h = tl.zeros([BK, BV], dtype=tl.float32)
80	    if USE_INITIAL_STATE:
81	        p_h0 = tl.make_block_ptr(h0 + i_nh * K*V, (K, V), (V, 1), (i_k * BK, i_v * BV), (BK, BV), (1, 0))
82	        b_h = tl.load(p_h0, boundary_check=(0, 1)).to(tl.float32)
83	
84	    for i_t in range(NT):
85	        i_s = i_t // NTS
86	        p_k = tl.make_block_ptr(k + (bos*H + i_h) * K, (K, T), (1, H*K), (i_k * BK, i_t * BT), (BK, BT), (0, 1))
87	        p_v = tl.make_block_ptr(v + (bos*H + i_h) * V, (T, V), (H*V, 1), (i_t * BT, i_v * BV), (BT, BV), (1, 0))
88	
89	        o_h = ((boh + i_s) * H + i_h).to(tl.int64) * K*V
90	        p_h = tl.make_block_ptr(h + o_h, (K, V), (V, 1), (i_k * BK, i_v * BV), (BK, BV), (1, 0))
91	
92	        if i_t % NTS == 0:
93	            tl.store(p_h, b_h.to(p_h.dtype.element_ty), boundary_check=(0, 1))
94	        # [BK, BT]
95	        b_k = tl.load(p_k, boundary_check=(0, 1))
96	        # [BT, BV]
97	        b_v = tl.load(p_v, boundary_check=(0, 1))
98	        last_idx = min((i_t + 1) * BT, T) - 1
99	
100	        # scalar decay
101	        if USE_G:
102	            b_g_last = tl.load(g + bos * H + last_idx * H + i_h)
103	            p_g = g + bos*H + (i_t * BT + tl.arange(0, BT)) * H + i_h
104	            b_g = tl.load(p_g, mask=(i_t * BT + tl.arange(0, BT) < T), other=0.)
105	            b_h *= exp(b_g_last)
106	            b_v = (b_v * exp(b_g_last - b_g)[:, None]).to(b_v.dtype)
107	
108	        if USE_G_GAMMA:
109	            b_g_last = b_gamma * min(BT, T - i_t * BT)
110	            b_h *= exp(b_g_last)
111	            b_v = (b_v * exp(b_g_last - b_g)[:, None]).to(b_v.dtype)
112	
113	        # vector decay, h = Diag(gk) @ h
114	        if USE_GK:
115	            p_gk = tl.make_block_ptr(gk + (bos*H + i_h) * K, (K, T), (1, H*K), (i_k * BK, i_t * BT), (BK, BT), (0, 1))
116	            p_gk_last = gk + (bos + last_idx) * H*K + i_h * K + i_k * BK + tl.arange(0, BK)
117	
118	            b_gk_last = tl.load(p_gk_last, mask=(i_k * BK + tl.arange(0, BK) < K), other=0.)
119	            b_h *= exp(b_gk_last)[:, None]
120	
121	            b_gk = tl.load(p_gk, boundary_check=(0, 1))
122	            b_k = (b_k * exp(b_gk_last[:, None] - b_gk)).to(b_k.dtype)
123	
124	        # vector decay, h = h @ Diag(gv)
125	        if USE_GV:
126	            p_gv = tl.make_block_ptr(gv + (bos*H + i_h) * V, (T, V), (H*V, 1), (i_t * BT, i_v * BV), (BT, BV), (1, 0))
127	            p_gv_last = gv + (bos + last_idx) * H*V + i_h * V + i_v * BV + tl.arange(0, BV)
128	
129	            b_gv_last = tl.load(p_gv_last, mask=(i_v * BV + tl.arange(0, BV) < V), other=0.)
130	            b_h *= exp(b_gv_last)[None, :]

  "content": "\"\"\"GLA internal kernel breakdown at MiniCPM-SALA shapes.\n\nGoal: measure each sub-kernel time inside chunk_simple_gla forward at\nprefill chunk shape (T=8192, H=32, K=V=128, B=1) to find the dominant\ninner kernel, given that gla_kernel total ~1250 us/op.\n\nStack:\n  chunk_local_cumsum(g_gamma, BT=64)     # g_gamma is [H] so this is skipped\n  chunk_fwd_h(k, v, g_gamma, BT=64)      # state recurrence\n  chunk_fwd_o(q, k, v, h, g_gamma, BT=64)  # output\n\nBoth fwd_h and fwd_o are upstream triton.autotune'd.\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nimport triton\nfrom fla.ops.simple_gla import chunk_simple_gla\nfrom fla.ops.common.chunk_h import chunk_fwd_h\nfrom fla.ops.common.chunk_o import chunk_fwd_o\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\ndevice = \"cuda\"\n\nB, T, H, K, V = 1, 8192, 32, 128, 128\nprint(f\"shapes: B={B} T={T} H={H} K={K} V={V}  (head_dim=128, NH_q=NH_kv=32)\")\n\nq = torch.randn(B, T, H, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)\nk = torch.randn(B, T, H, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)\nv = torch.randn(B, T, H, V, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)\ng_gamma = torch.randn(H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)\ncu_seqlens = torch.tensor([0, T], dtype=torch.long, device=device)\nscale = K ** -0.5\n\n\ndef bench(fn, n=20, warm=10):\n    for _ in range(warm):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(n)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(n)]\n    for i in range(n):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    return times[n // 2]  # median in us\n\n\n# Full chunk_simple_gla (the ground truth gla_kernel)\ndef full():\n    o, _ = chunk_simple_gla(\n        q=q, k=k, v=v, g=None, g_gamma=g_gamma,\n        scale=scale, initial_state=None, output_final_state=True,\n        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,\n    )\n    return o\n\nt_full = bench(full)\nprint(f\"\\nchunk_simple_gla TOTAL:  {t_full:.1f} us\")\n\n# Isolated fwd_h\ndef fwd_h_only():\n    h, _ = chunk_fwd_h(\n        k=k, v=v, g=None, g_gamma=g_gamma, gk=None, gv=None,\n        h0=None, output_final_state=True,\n        states_in_fp32=False, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens, chunk_size=64,\n    )\n    return h\n\nt_h = bench(fwd_h_only)\nprint(f\"chunk_fwd_h alone:       {t_h:.1f} us\")\n\n# Build h once for fwd_o isolation\nh, _ = chunk_fwd_h(\n    k=k, v=v, g=None, g_gamma=g_gamma, gk=None, gv=None,\n    h0=None, output_final_state=True,\n    states_in_fp32=False, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens, chunk_size=64,\n)\n\ndef fwd_o_only():\n    o = chunk_fwd_o(\n        q=q, k=k, v=v, g=None, g_gamma=g_gamma, h=h,\n        scale=scale, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens, chunk_size=64,\n    )\n    return o\n\nt_o = bench(fwd_o_only)\nprint(f\"chunk_fwd_o alone:       {t_o:.1f} us\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nfwd_h share:  {t_h/t_full*100:.1f}%  ({t_h:.1f}/{t_full:.1f})\")\nprint(f\"fwd_o share:  {t_o/t_full*100:.1f}%  ({t_o:.1f}/{t_full:.1f})\")\nprint(f\"sum:          {(t_h+t_o)/t_full*100:.1f}%\")\n\n# Bandwidth-bound floor for fwd_h:\n#   reads/writes: k,v in (T*H*K + T*H*V) bf16 = 16M elem = 32 MB\n#   writes h: NT*H*K*V bf16 = 128*32*128*128*2 = 128 MB\n# Theoretical floor at 1.2 TB/s mem bw: 128MB / 1200 GB/s = 107 us\n# Plus k,v reads: 32MB / 1200 = 27 us → ~134 us ideal\nfloor_h_mb = (T * H * K * V * 2 + T * H * (K + V) * 2) / 1e6  # MB\nprint(f\"\\nfwd_h memory traffic estimate:  {floor_h_mb:.0f} MB\")\nprint(f\"fwd_h floor at 1.2 TB/s:        {floor_h_mb*1000/1200:.0f} us\")\nprint(f\"fwd_h SOL%:                     {floor_h_mb*1000/1200/t_h*100:.0f}%\")\n"
}
