```
107	@triton.jit
108	def concat_and_cast_mha_k_kernel(
109	    k_ptr,
110	    k_nope_ptr,
111	    k_rope_ptr,
112	    head_cnt: tl.constexpr,
113	    k_stride0: tl.constexpr,
114	    k_stride1: tl.constexpr,
115	    nope_stride0: tl.constexpr,
116	    nope_stride1: tl.constexpr,
117	    rope_stride0: tl.constexpr,
118	    nope_dim: tl.constexpr,
119	    rope_dim: tl.constexpr,
120	):
121	    pid_loc = tl.program_id(0)
122	    head_range = tl.arange(0, head_cnt)
123	
124	    k_head_ptr = k_ptr + pid_loc * k_stride0 + head_range[:, None] * k_stride1
125	
126	    nope_offs = tl.arange(0, nope_dim)
127	
128	    src_nope_ptr = (
129	        k_nope_ptr
130	        + pid_loc * nope_stride0
131	        + head_range[:, None] * nope_stride1
132	        + nope_offs[None, :]
133	    )
134	    dst_nope_ptr = k_head_ptr + nope_offs[None, :]
135	
136	    src_nope = tl.load(src_nope_ptr)
137	    tl.store(dst_nope_ptr, src_nope)
138	
139	    rope_offs = tl.arange(0, rope_dim)
140	    src_rope_ptr = k_rope_ptr + pid_loc * rope_stride0 + rope_offs[None, :]
141	    dst_rope_ptr = k_head_ptr + nope_dim + rope_offs[None, :]
142	    src_rope = tl.load(src_rope_ptr)
143	    tl.store(dst_rope_ptr, src_rope)
144	
145	
146	def concat_and_cast_mha_k_triton(
147	    k: torch.Tensor,
148	    k_nope: torch.Tensor,
149	    k_rope: torch.Tensor,
150	):
151	    # The source data type will be implicitly converted to the target data type.
152	    assert (
153	        len(k.shape) == 3 and len(k_nope.shape) == 3 and len(k_rope.shape) == 3
154	    ), f"shape should be 3d, but got {k.shape=}, {k_nope.shape=}, {k_rope.shape=}"
155	    assert (
156	        k.shape[0] == k_nope.shape[0] and k.shape[0] == k_rope.shape[0]
157	    ), f"invalid shape, got {k.shape=}, {k_nope.shape=}, {k_rope.shape=}"
158	    assert (
159	        k.shape[1] == k_nope.shape[1] and 1 == k_rope.shape[1]
160	    ), f"invalid shape, got {k.shape=}, {k_nope.shape=}, {k_rope.shape=}"
161	    assert (
162	        k.shape[-1] == k_nope.shape[-1] + k_rope.shape[-1]
163	    ), f"invalid shape, got {k.shape=}, {k_nope.shape=}, {k_rope.shape=}"
164	
165	    nope_dim = k_nope.shape[-1]
166	    rope_dim = k_rope.shape[-1]
167	    grid = (k.shape[0],)
168	
169	    concat_and_cast_mha_k_kernel[grid](
170	        k,
171	        k_nope,
172	        k_rope,
173	        k.shape[1],
174	        k.stride(0),
175	        k.stride(1),
176	        k_nope.stride(0),
177	        k_nope.stride(1),
178	        k_rope.stride(0),
179	        nope_dim,
180	        rope_dim,
181	    )

184	@triton.jit
185	def pad_sequence_with_mask_kernel(
186	    input_ptr,  # (total_tokens, hidden)
187	    offsets_ptr,  # (B,)
188	    lengths_ptr,  # (B,)
189	    output_ptr,  # (B, max_len, hidden)
190	    mask_ptr,  # (B, max_len)
191	    max_len,
192	    hidden_dim,
193	    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,  # seq block
194	    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,  # hidden block
195	):
196	    b = tl.program_id(0)  # batch index
197	    m = tl.program_id(1)  # seq block index
198	
199	    offset = tl.load(offsets_ptr + b)
200	    length = tl.load(lengths_ptr + b)
201	
202	    seq_ids = m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
203	    hid_ids = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
204	
205	    seq_mask = seq_ids < max_len
206	    valid_token = seq_ids < length
207	
208	    # input index
209	    in_token = offset + seq_ids
210	    in_ptr = input_ptr + in_token[:, None] * hidden_dim + hid_ids[None, :]
211	
212	    # output index
213	    out_ptr = (
214	        output_ptr
215	        + b * max_len * hidden_dim
216	        + seq_ids[:, None] * hidden_dim
217	        + hid_ids[None, :]
218	    )
219	
220	    values = tl.load(
221	        in_ptr,
222	        mask=valid_token[:, None] & (hid_ids[None, :] < hidden_dim),
223	        other=0.0,
224	    )
225	
226	    tl.store(
227	        out_ptr,
228	        values,
229	        mask=seq_mask[:, None] & (hid_ids[None, :] < hidden_dim),
230	    )
231	
232	    # attention mask
233	    if tl.program_id(2) == 0:
234	        mask_out_ptr = mask_ptr + b * max_len + seq_ids
235	        tl.store(mask_out_ptr, valid_token, mask=seq_mask)
236	
237	
238	def pad_sequence_with_mask(
239	    input_emb,  # (total_tokens, hidden)
240	    offsets,  # (B,)
241	    lengths,  # (B,)
242	    max_len,
243	):
244	    B = offsets.shape[0]
245	    hidden_dim = input_emb.shape[1]
246	
247	    output = torch.zeros(
248	        (B, max_len, hidden_dim),
249	        device=input_emb.device,
250	        dtype=input_emb.dtype,
251	    )
252	    attn_mask = torch.empty(
253	        (B * max_len),
254	        device=input_emb.device,
255	        dtype=torch.bool,
256	    )
257	
258	    BLOCK_M = 32
259	    BLOCK_D = triton.next_power_of_2(hidden_dim)
260	
261	    grid = (
262	        B,
263	        triton.cdiv(max_len, BLOCK_M),
264	        1,
265	    )
266	
267	    pad_sequence_with_mask_kernel[grid](
268	        input_emb,
269	        offsets,
270	        lengths,
271	        output,
272	        attn_mask,
273	        max_len,
274	        hidden_dim,
275	        BLOCK_M=BLOCK_M,
276	        BLOCK_D=BLOCK_D,
277	    )
278	
279	    return B, output, attn_mask
280
```

```
82	        self,
83	        size: int,
84	        max_context_len: int,
85	        device: str,
86	        enable_memory_saver: bool,

88	
89	        memory_saver_adapter = TorchMemorySaverAdapter.create(

91	        )
92	
93	        self.size = size
94	        self.max_context_len = max_context_len
95	        self.device = device
96	        with memory_saver_adapter.region(GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE):
97	            self.req_to_token = torch.zeros(
98	                (size, max_context_len), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
99	            )
100	
101	        self.free_slots = list(range(size))
102	
103	    def write(self, indices, values):
104	        self.req_to_token[indices] = values
105	
106	    def available_size(self):
107	        return len(self.free_slots)
108	
109	    def alloc(self, need_size: int) -> List[int]:
110	        if need_size > len(self.free_slots):
111	            return None
112	
113	        select_index = self.free_slots[:need_size]
114	        self.free_slots = self.free_slots[need_size:]
115	
116	        return select_index
117	
118	    def free(self, free_index: Union[int, List[int]]):
119	        if isinstance(free_index, (int,)):
120	            self.free_slots.append(free_index)
121	        else:
122	            self.free_slots.extend(free_index)
123	
124	    def clear(self):
125	        self.free_slots = list(range(self.size))
```

```
414	def generate_draft_decode_kv_indices(
415	    req_pool_indices,
416	    req_to_token,
417	    paged_kernel_lens,
418	    kv_indices,
419	    kv_indptr,
420	    positions,
421	    pool_len: tl.constexpr,
422	    kv_indices_stride: tl.constexpr,
423	    kv_indptr_stride: tl.constexpr,
424	    bs_upper: tl.constexpr,
425	    iter_upper: tl.constexpr,
426	    num_tokens_upper: tl.constexpr,
427	    page_size: tl.constexpr,
428	):
429	    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr = 128
430	    iters = tl.program_id(axis=0)
431	    bid = tl.program_id(axis=1)
432	    topk_id = tl.program_id(axis=2)
433	
434	    num_steps = tl.num_programs(axis=0)
435	    num_seqs = tl.num_programs(axis=1)
436	    topk = tl.num_programs(axis=2)
437	
438	    kv_indices += kv_indices_stride * iters
439	    kv_indptr += kv_indptr_stride * iters
440	    iters += 1
441	
442	    load_offset = tl.arange(0, bs_upper)
443	    seq_lens = tl.load(paged_kernel_lens + load_offset, mask=load_offset < bid, other=0)
444	    seq_len = tl.load(paged_kernel_lens + bid)
445	    cum_seq_len = tl.sum(seq_lens)
446	
447	    # Update kv_indices
448	    kv_offset = cum_seq_len * topk + bid * iters * topk + topk_id * (seq_len + iters)
449	    kv_ptr = kv_indices + kv_offset
450	    token_pool_ptr = req_to_token + tl.load(req_pool_indices + bid) * pool_len
451	
452	    kv_offset = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
453	    num_loop = tl.cdiv(seq_len, BLOCK_SIZE)
454	    for _ in range(num_loop):
455	        mask = kv_offset < seq_len
456	        data = tl.load(token_pool_ptr + kv_offset, mask=mask)
457	        tl.store(kv_ptr + kv_offset, data, mask=mask)
458	        kv_offset += BLOCK_SIZE
459	
460	    extend_offset = tl.arange(0, iter_upper)
461	    if page_size == 1 or topk == 1:
462	        extend_data = tl.load(
463	            token_pool_ptr + seq_len + topk_id * num_steps + tl.arange(0, iter_upper),
464	            mask=extend_offset < iters,
465	        )
466	    else:
467	        prefix_len = seq_len
468	        last_page_len = prefix_len % page_size
469	        num_new_pages_per_topk = (
470	            last_page_len + num_steps + page_size - 1
471	        ) // page_size
472	        prefix_base = seq_len // page_size * page_size
473	        start = (
474	            prefix_base + topk_id * num_new_pages_per_topk * page_size + last_page_len
475	        )
476	        extend_data = tl.load(
477	            token_pool_ptr + start + extend_offset,
478	            mask=extend_offset < iters,
479	        )
480	
481	    tl.store(kv_ptr + seq_len + extend_offset, extend_data, mask=extend_offset < iters)
482	
483	    # Update kv_indptr
484	    bs_offset = tl.arange(0, num_tokens_upper)
485	
486	    zid = bid * topk + topk_id
487	    if zid == 0:
488	        zid = num_seqs * topk
489	    positions = tl.load(positions + bs_offset, mask=bs_offset < zid, other=0)
490	    base = tl.sum(positions)
491	    tl.store(kv_indptr + zid, base + zid * iters)
```

```
commit c87538d9a2e0bd3fd7f9dbacf70a0cc515968014
Author: SOAR User <[REDACTED]>
Date:   Mon May 18 03:28:15 2026 +0800

    eagle: draft sliding-window attention (kv_indices clip,消除 stale-KV 风险)
    
    在 EAGLE-3 draft 1 层 attention 启用 FlashInfer 原生 SWA(真截断 kv_indices,
    非 mask),配合 --speculative-draft-prefix-last-n 的 chunk-skip 使用。
    
    动机:chunk-skip 留下早 chunk 的 draft KV 未写(allocator slot 复用不清零,可
    能是前次请求残留),decode 时 draft attention 仍会读到 garbage。draft 是 1 层
    self-attn 局部主导 softmax,单 request 测试 OK,但多 request 连续跑 / 长会话可
    能暴。SWA 让 draft attention 只读 trailing N tokens,garbage 不进 softmax —
    彻底消除 stale-KV 风险,production-safe。
    
    实现:
    - server_args.py 加 speculative_draft_sliding_window: int = 0 + CLI flag。
    - LlamaForCausalLMEagle3 实现 get_attention_sliding_window_size(),从
      get_global_server_args() 读;LlamaDecoderLayer.__init__ 后置 patch
      self_attn.attn.sliding_window_size 让 prefill window_left 在 forward 时
      生效。模型构造 0 → None,严防 RadixAttention `0 or -1` 路由错。
    - start_eagle.sh 默认 --speculative-draft-sliding-window 40960
      (LAST_N 32768 + chunk_size 8192 margin)。
    - FlashInferMultiStepDraftBackend 在 SWA (num_wrappers=2) 时分配 2 套
      kv_indptr buf,绕过 num_wrappers==1 assert;FlashInferAttnBackend
      接受 list 的 kv_indptr_buf。
    - update_sliding_window 容忍 prefix_lens=None(draft_extend / target_verify
      cuda graph capture 路径会传 None)。
    
    实测(80K prompt + 500 tok decode):SWA 在当前 spec config (topk=2 steps=3)
```

> AGENT

读完了。深入定位到的最可能 user_4813494d cause——

## 关键发现 1: NO_SPEC 路径有显式跨流 sync，SPEC 路径没有

`eagle_worker.py:977-994` `_forward_no_spec` 里：
```python
self._no_spec_next_token_copy_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=...)
copy_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(...))
with torch.cuda.stream(copy_stream):
    next_token_cpu_tensor.copy_(next_token_ids, non_blocking=True)
...
copy_stream.synchronize()  # line 1025
```

显式 producer/consumer 跨流握手。

**但 SPEC 路径完全没这层握手。** `verify()` 在 1812 行调 `target_worker.forward_batch_generation(...)`，target 内部走 CUDA graph（target 的 CudaGraphRunner 有 dedicated `self.stream`），输出的 `logits_output.hidden_states` 落在 target stream 写的 buffer 里。然后：
- `eagle_info.py:1844`: `spec_info.hidden_states = logits_output.hidden_states`（**Python 引用赋值，无 sync**）
- 下一轮 `_draft_preprocess_decode` → `cuda_graph_runner.replay()` 在 default stream 上 `.copy_(spec_info.hidden_states)`（**也无 stream wait**）

如果 target 的 cuda_graph 用的不是 default stream（它有自己 capture stream），那 default stream 的 `.copy_()` **没等 target stream 的写**——读到 stale hidden_states。

## 关键发现 2: `c87538d` SWA fix 的 margin 算错了

`start_eagle.sh:38` 注释：
```
DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW="40960"
# >= LAST_N(32768) + chunk_size(8192) 留 margin
```

但**实际推导**：SWA window 在 decode step K 时读 `[seq_len_initial + K - 40960, seq_len_initial + K)`。要落在 prefill 写过的区域 `[seq_len_initial - 32768, seq_len_initial + K)`，需要：
$$K - 40960 \geq -32768 \Rightarrow K \geq 8192$$

**decode 前 8192 个 token，SWA 窗口起点在 prefill 写过的区域之前**——读到 req_to_token 里**前任请求的残留 slot index**。

残留 slot index 是 valid kv slot（因为前任也分配过有效 slot），不直接 IMA；**但读到的 KV 数据是错的**，会污染 hidden_states / topk_index。**污染后的 topk_index 可能超出 vocab 范围 → embedding lookup IMA**。

## 关键发现 3: `topk_index` 越界路径

`draft_forward:1711`:
```python
if self.hot_token_id is not None:
    topk_index = self.hot_token_id[topk_index]
```

EAGLE-3 这里：`hot_token_id` 是 `(draft_vocab_size,)`，期待 `topk_index ∈ [0, draft_vocab_size)`。如果 stale-KV 污染让 draft logits → topk → 取到 ≥ draft_vocab_size 的索引（比如 vocab=73448 但 draft_vocab=32k）→ **IMA at line 1711**。

或者 topk_index 后续被传到 `select_top_k_tokens` → 用作 embedding lookup `embed[topk_index]`，同样 OOB IMA。

## 三条线索的合流

这三条加起来：
1. **跨流 sync 缺失**（产生竞争窗口）+ **SWA margin 偏小**（产生 stale KV 污染）+ **topk_index 没有 clamp**（污染→ IMA 路径）
2. **`.item()` 之所以 mask 掉 race**：sync 强制 target stream 完成 → spec_info.hidden_states 拿到的是 fresh 数据，stage 2 不被污染，topk_index 在 vocab 内
3. **demo-sala 总崩 vs probe-sala-s2 不崩**：demo-sala 是 production 提交，跑长 prompt + 长 decode，命中 K<8192 stale-KV 区间高；probe-sala-s2 我们手动的 EVAL+S1 也命中过但概率低（race 窗口 + 残留模式不一定踩中）

## 推荐 fix（无 overhead）

按嫌疑度分两条：

**Fix A**（最稳，必做）：把 SWA window 调到 `prefix_last_n + chunk_size + decode_max_K = 32768 + 8192 + 4096 = 45056`，或直接关掉 prefix_last_n（取消 chunk-skip），强制 draft 全 prompt prefill。后者代价是 prefill 慢但 production-safe。

**Fix B**（事件 sync，微秒级）：`eagle_worker.py:1812` target verify 完后 record event 在 target stream；`eagle_draft_cuda_graph_runner.py:269` 之前 wait event。具体位置是 `eagle_worker.py:1844` 那次 `spec_info.hidden_states = logits_output.hidden_states` 之前插 event record。

**最少代码改动**：先做 Fix A——单行改 `start_eagle.sh` 的 `DRAFT_SLIDING_WINDOW` 和/或 `DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N`，无 GPU sync 开销，验证一轮就知道是不是这个。

要不要我先把 Fix A 应用到 probe-sala-s2（DRAFT_PREFIX_LAST_N=0 关掉 chunk-skip），重打重提，跑 EVAL+S1 验证？

CPU-only metadata: bs, raw_bs, oc_len, seq_no, kvp_size\n                self._diag_meta = torch.zeros((_N, 5), dtype=torch.int64)\n                self._diag_meta_log = open(\"/tmp/draft_cg_meta.log\", \"a\", buffering=1)\n                self._diag_buf_path = \"/tmp/draft_cg_buf.bin\"\n                # Periodic flush counter\n                self._diag_flush_every = 64\n                import atexit, signal\n                def _dump_on_exit():\n                    try:\n                        self._diag_dump()\n                    except Exception:\n                        pass\n                atexit.register(_dump_on_exit)\n                # Also dump on SIGTERM/SIGUSR1 (sglang scheduler uses SIGQUIT to children)\n                for _sig in (signal.SIGUSR1, signal.SIGUSR2):\n                    try:\n                        signal.signal(_sig, lambda *_a: _dump_on_exit())\n                    except Exception:\n                        pass\n                self._diag_init = True\n\n            bs = self.bs\n            raw_bs = getattr(self, \"raw_bs\", bs)\n            ntp = self.num_tokens_per_bs\n            sns = self.speculative_num_steps\n            kvp = getattr(self.model_runner.token_to_kv_pool, \"size\", -1)\n            oc_len = bs * ntp * sns\n            i = self._diag_i % self._diag_n\n            self._diag_meta[i, 0] = bs\n            self._diag_meta[i, 1] = raw_bs\n            self._diag_meta[i, 2] = oc_len\n            self._diag_meta[i, 3] = self._diag_i\n            self._diag_meta[i, 4] = kvp\n            # Async non-blocking copies to pinned CPU. Stays on default stream;\n            # pytorch sequences these before any subsequent kernel on same stream.\n            if oc_len > 0:\n                self._diag_oc[i, :oc_len].copy_(self.out_cache_loc[:oc_len], non_blocking=True)\n            if bs > 0:\n                self._diag_rp[i, :bs].copy_(self.req_pool_indices[:bs], non_blocking=True)\n                self._diag_sl[i, :bs].copy_(self.seq_lens[:bs], non_blocking=True)\n            # CPU-side line log (no GPU touch). Includes seq_no so we can pair\n            # with the pinned ring buffer post-mortem.\n            self._diag_meta_log.write(\n                f\"{self._diag_i} bs={bs} raw_bs={raw_bs} ntp={ntp} sns={sns} oc_len={oc_len} kvp={kvp}\\n\"\n            )\n            self._diag_i += 1\n            # Periodic snapshot to disk in case process is killed without atexit\n            if self._diag_i % self._diag_flush_every == 0:\n                self._diag_dump_async()\n        except Exception as _e:\n            with open(\"/tmp/draft_cg_debug.log\", \"a\") as _f:\n                _f.write(f\"[diag_setup_failed] {_e}\\n\")\n        self.graphs[self.bs].replay()\n\n    def _diag_dump_async(self):\n        # Non-blocking attempt to checkpoint pinned buffers + meta to disk.\n        # We schedule no sync; the buffers may contain partial data from\n        # in-flight copies (slot at _diag_i % N might be mid-write). That is\n        # fine — the last fully-written slot is _diag_i-1 modulo N.\n        try:\n            import os\n            tmp = self._diag_buf_path + \".tmp\"\n            torch.save({\n                \"meta\": self._diag_meta.clone(),\n                \"oc\": self._diag_oc.clone(),\n                \"rp\": self._diag_rp.clone(),\n                \"sl\": self._diag_sl.clone(),\n                \"i\": self._diag_i,\n                \"n\": self._diag_n,\n            }, tmp)\n            os.replace(tmp, self._diag_buf_path)\n        except Exception as _e:\n            pass\n\n    def _diag_dump(self):\n        # Forced sync (post-crash this raises the IMA again; pre-graceful-exit\n        # this completes pending async copies). Either way the pinned tensors\n        # are now consistent with the GPU state at the moment of the call.\n        try:\n            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        try:\n            torch.save({\n                \"meta\": self._diag_meta,\n                \"oc\": self._diag_oc,\n                \"rp\": self._diag_rp,\n                \"sl\": self._diag_sl,\n                \"i\": self._diag_i,\n                \"n\": self._diag_n,\n            }, self._diag_buf_path)\n        except Exception:\n            pass"
```json
}
```

```
1	#!/bin/bash
2	set -euo pipefail
3	# Kill sglang server safely — 只杀 launch_server 进程及其子进程，不碰 jupyter
4	# 用法: bash bench/kill_sglang.sh
5	
6	# 找到 sglang.launch_server 的主进程（排除 grep 自身和 jupyter）
7	# `ps aux` 在某些环境里会截断命令行，导致 grep 匹配失败；改用 args 全长输出。
8	find_sglang_pids() {
9	    ps -eo pid=,args= \
10	        | grep '[s]glang.launch_server' \
11	        | grep -v jupyter \
12	        | awk '{print $1}' \
13	        || true
14	}
15	
16	PIDS=$(find_sglang_pids)
17	
18	if [ -z "$PIDS" ]; then
19	    echo "No sglang launch_server running"
20	    exit 0
21	fi
22	
23	for PID in $PIDS; do
24	    echo "Killing sglang PID=$PID and its children"
25	    # 先杀子进程树，再杀主进程
26	    pkill -P "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
27	    kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
28	done
29	
30	# 等待退出
31	for i in $(seq 1 15); do
32	    REMAINING=$(find_sglang_pids)
33	    if [ -z "$REMAINING" ]; then
34	        echo "Server stopped"
35	        exit 0
36	    fi
37	    sleep 1
38	done
39	
40	# 强制杀
41	REMAINING=$(find_sglang_pids)
42	for PID in $REMAINING; do
43	    echo "Force killing PID=$PID"
44	    kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
45	done
46	sleep 1
47	echo "Done"
48
```

```
# Stage 6: launch sglang server (background)
# Mirrors eval/start_eagle.sh: SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS already has all flags
# (--port 30000, --speculative-draft-model-path, --max-running-requests 64,
#  --quantization modelopt_fp4, EAGLE3, etc.).
# ============================================================
if [ ${ABORT} -eq 0 ]; then
{
    log "=== Stage 6: launch sglang server ==="
    log "TARGET_MODEL=${QUANT_OUT}"
    log "SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS=${SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS}"
} > "${S6_LOG}" 2>&1

# Launch in background, log everything to SGL_FULL_LOG
nohup python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model-path "${QUANT_OUT}" \
    ${SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS} \
    > "${SGL_FULL_LOG}" 2>&1 &
SGL_PID=$!
echo "SGL_PID=${SGL_PID}" >> "${S6_LOG}"
log "server launched PID=${SGL_PID}"
sleep 3
if ! kill -0 "${SGL_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
    {
        echo "[FATAL] server died within 3s of launch"
        echo "--- last 40 lines of sglang_full.log ---"
        tail -40 "${SGL_FULL_LOG}" 2>/dev/null || true
    } >> "${S6_LOG}"
    S6_STATUS=1
    probe_die "6 sglang-launch" "${S6_LOG}"
else
    # Wait 30s for sglang to import quant module + run _load_fp4_autotune_cache().
    # Then grep the head of sglang_full.log for the cache-load proof lines.
    # If we don't see "[fp4-autotune] loaded cache ok=True entries=N" here,
    # the tune cache silently failed to load — that's the user_4813494d cause of the
    # autotune avalanche we saw on the previous platform run.
    log "Stage 6 post-launch: sleep 30s then grep cache-load lines"
    sleep 30
    {
        echo
        echo "=== post-launch +30s: cache-load proof lines from sglang_full.log ==="
        if ! kill -0 "${SGL_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "[WARN] server PID ${SGL_PID} died within 30s post-launch"
        fi
        echo "--- grep [fp4-autotune] / b12x / cute_dsl ---"
        grep -nE "(fp4-autotune|cute_dsl|b12x.*[Cc]ache|AOT.*loaded|JIT.*compile)" "${SGL_FULL_LOG}" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "(no matching lines yet)"
        echo
        echo "--- sglang_full.log first 80 lines (init / import phase) ---"
        head -80 "${SGL_FULL_LOG}" 2>/dev/null || echo "(empty)"
    } >> "${S6_LOG}"
    S6_STATUS=0
fi
fi

# ============================================================
# Stage 7: wait for sglang ready (poll /v1/models, 5s interval, max 300s)
# Also extract b12x AOT cache hit/miss summary from sglang log for the email.
# ============================================================
```

```
if [ -n "${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED:-}" ]; then
    export SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS="${SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS} --random-seed ${SGLANG_RANDOM_SEED}"
fi

# --- runtime hot-path tunables (mirrors eval/start_eagle.sh) -----------------
export EAGLE_FORCE_NO_ACCEPT="${EAGLE_FORCE_NO_ACCEPT:-0}"
export EAGLE_TRACE_FILE="${EAGLE_TRACE_FILE:-}"

export SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=0
# b12x sm_120a CUTLASS NVFP4 GEMM kernel: explicit OFF in current demo-sala default.

# --- MARS verify (per-mode + global fallback) --------------------------------

export EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:-0.85}"
export EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA:-0.5}"

# --- dynamic spec mode (NO_SPEC / D5 / D7 by running batch size) -------------
export EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE="${EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE:-1}"
export EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS="${EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS:-32}"

export EAGLE_D7_TOPK="${EAGLE_D7_TOPK:-2}"
export EAGLE_D7_STEPS="${EAGLE_D7_STEPS:-7}"
```

Monitor `bfkym5io1` 已挂（60 min timeout）。Full EVAL（150 samples × max_out=65536）预计 20-30 分钟，然后 S1 ~2 分钟。等通知。

Patch 现在做的事：
- **没 GPU sync**：每次 `_replay` 入口写一行到 `/tmp/draft_cg_meta.log`（CPU-only，seq_no/bs/raw_bs/oc_len/kvp）
- **async non-blocking copies**：把 out_cache_loc / req_pool_indices / seq_lens 拷到 pinned CPU ring buffer（1024 slots）
- **每 64 replay 落盘**：`torch.save` pinned buffer 到 `/tmp/draft_cg_buf.bin`
- **atexit/SIGUSR1**：进程退出或收到 USR1 时强 sync 后 dump

崩溃时：sglang 进程死前会触发 atexit → dump 完整 pinned buffer。我们能看到崩溃前 ~1024 次 replay 的完整 out_cache_loc/req_pool_indices/seq_lens 三元组，直接定位哪个索引越界。

## P3 完整结果——user_4813494d cause 假设全数证伪

| 指标 | 数值 |
|---|---|
| `_replay` 总次数 | **40516** |
| 崩溃 | **0** |
| Full EVAL avg score | **79.51%** |
| Full EVAL duration | 1215s |
| S1 bench duration | 193.95s |
| sgl_p3.log crash signals | 无 |
| bs 分布 | bs=1: 18709（D7/S1）, bs=2-18: ~21800（D5/EVAL 多并发） |

**关键反转**：移除 `.item()` sync 后，4 万次 draft graph replay **零崩溃** + **79.51% score**（demo-sala 提交都是 0 score / crash）。我之前的"跨流 sync mask race"假设**完全错了**。

## 真正的差异在哪

probe-sala-s2 跟 demo-sala 唯一**没对齐**的环节：

| | demo-sala | probe-sala-s2 |
|---|---|---|
| 量化方式 | `prepare_model.sh` 每次提交**现场量化**（GPTQ + FourOverSix + wikitext 90 校准） | 从 BOS 拉**预量化版** `sala-quantized-det` |
| 代码 | 用户保证三方对齐 ✓ | 与 demo-sala bitwise 一致 ✓ |
| 环境 | prepare_env.sh 同源 ✓ | 同源 ✓ |

代码已被排除——剩下的就是**量化产物**。BOS 上的预量化 model 跑出 79.51% 是健康的，那 demo-sala 现场量化的 model 大概率**输出 NaN/Inf 或越界值**，被下游 kernel 拿去做 embedding lookup / KV slot 索引 → IMA。

崩溃定位到 `eagle_draft_cuda_graph_runner.py:248` 或 `eagle_info.py:515.tolist()` 也讲得通——这两处都是**异步 CUDA error 的下一个 sync 点**，不是真凶现场。真凶在量化模型某层的 weights / scale 上。

## 下一步建议方向

1. **复现路径**：在 probe-sala-s2 上**重新跑一次 `prepare_model.sh` 现场量化**，用产物替换 BOS 版本，再跑 full EVAL+S1，看 score / 是否崩
2. **如果重新量化后 score=0 / crash** → bug 锁定在 `prepare_model.sh` 的某一步（GPTQ / FourOverSix / NVFP4 cast / scale 量化）
3. **如果重新量化后正常** → bug 是平台机器特定（GPU 漂移、cuDNN/FlashInfer 版本边界、autotune cache 漂移）

```
12	# GPTQ + NVFP4 + FourOverSix quantization
13	# expandable_segments is REQUIRED for 90K + calib90 — otherwise the 4D causal
14	# attention mask alloc (~16 GiB at seq=92160) fragments and OOMs even at 80 GB
15	# headroom. It only affects allocator block merge/split policy (block reuse
16	# patterns), not numerical paths or cuBLAS algo selection (those depend on
17	# problem shape + CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG, not tensor base addresses), so it
18	# does NOT break determinism. Verified: local 4K/8 bit-exact pair was reproduced
19	# with this on the production NVFP4 build prior to the 8-fix patch.
20	export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:True"
21	export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:True"
22	export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8"
23	# Disable TF32 globally — PyTorch's allow_tf32 flags are honored, but cuBLAS
24	# also reads NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE for its own GEMM path selection.
25	export NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
26	echo "[prepare_model] starting quantization (GPTQ+FourOverSix, 90K, calib90, deterministic)"
27	set +e
28	python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/preprocess_model.py" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$QUANT_LOG"
29	quant_rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
30	set -e
31	echo "[prepare_model] preprocess exit_code=${quant_rc}"
32	
33	echo "[prepare_model] done $(date '+%F %T')"
34	exit "$quant_rc"
35
```

# 诊断方案：probe-sala-s2.v3 完全模拟 demo-sala 提交流程

## demo-sala 实际提交流程
平台收到 tar 后做的事：
```
1. tar -xzf
2. prepare_env.sh                    # 装依赖（fla 当时 pip resolve）
3. prepare_model.sh --input <BF16> --output <quant>   # fresh quant
4. 启 sglang server with SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS
5. wait /v1/models
6. entrypoint.sh Step 3: eval_model.py --concurrency 32 max_out=65536  ← 评测 acc
7. entrypoint.sh Step 4: bench_serving.sh (S1+S8+Smax)                  ← 评测 speed
8. score 上报
```

## 当前 probe-sala-s2 vs demo-sala 的关键偏差

| 项 | demo-sala 真实流程 | probe-sala-s2 当前 |
|---|---|---|
| 量化 | `prepare_model.sh` fresh quant（每次提交独立 quant） | 跳过，从 BOS 拉 pre-quant cache |
| sleep DEBUG-HOLD | 无 | **18000s** → 阻塞 entrypoint.sh |
| eval/bench 由谁跑 | **平台 entrypoint.sh** 自动跑 | AI 手动 SSH 进去跑 |
| frpc/dropbear | 不存在 | 跑在 prepare_env.sh 内 |
| 时序 / 并发负载 | 平台真实 | 我手动 = **不一致** |

→ 我们手动 SSH 跑的 eval 跟 **平台真实评测**有偏差，所以即使 fresh-quant 在我手里不崩，platform 上 demo-sala 仍可能崩。要**真的对齐**必须让平台自己跑评测。

## probe-sala-s2.v3 设计（完整方案）

### 改动 1：加 `prepare_model.sh` + fresh quant 流程
- 从 `demo-sala/prepare_model.sh` 复制
- `preprocess_model.py` 已在 s2 内，参数走 `MAX_SEQ_LENGTH=4096 NUM_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES=4` 快速版（5min vs 1h）；如果用户允许花 1h 完全对齐生产则走 calib90+90k
- 删 prepare_env.sh 内的"BOS 下载预量化"分支，强制走 fresh quant

### 改动 2：去掉 DEBUG-HOLD，让 entrypoint.sh 自然跑
- `prepare_env.sh` 末尾的 `sleep 18000` 删掉
- 让 prepare_env.sh 正常 exit 0，**平台**触发 `/app/entrypoint.sh` 跑 eval/bench
- 这一步关键——这才是 demo-sala 真实评测条件

### 改动 3：frpc + dropbear 作为后台 daemon
- 在 `prepare_env.sh` 启动 sglang 之前用 `nohup ... &` 启隧道
- prepare_env.sh exit 后**隧道独立存活**——AI 仍能 SSH 进去
- entrypoint.sh 跑 eval/bench 时 AI 可旁观日志

### 改动 4：邮件回捞 hook（防容器销毁数据丢失）
- 在 `prepare_env.sh` 加 `trap` 捕 EXIT/SIGTERM/ERR → 打包 `/tmp/sgl_*.log` + `/tmp/draft_cg_buf.bin` + `/tmp/draft_cg_meta.log` + entrypoint.sh 的 stdout → `probe_email.py` 发到 `[REDACTED]`
- 在 entrypoint.sh 完成（或失败）后，再触发一次 dump+email

### 改动 5：保留 passive `_replay` patch
- 已在当前 probe-sala-s2/sglang 中
- crash 时 atexit 强 sync + dump pinned buf → 邮件附件

### 改动 6（关键）：fla 版本对照实验
- **v3-A**（control）：不 pin fla → 平台 resolve 当前 0.4.2（demo-sala 提交时也是这个）
- **v3-B**（hypothesis test）：`uv pip install flash-linear-attention==0.4.1 fla-core==0.4.1` 强制降级
- 各提交一次，对比 score 和 crash 行为

## 提交方式

```bash

cp /user_4813494d/.soar_cookie_d16552 /user_4813494d/openbmb/submit/.soar_cookie
python3 /user_4813494d/openbmb/submit/submit.py /user_4813494d/openbmb/probe-sala-s2-v3-A.tar.gz "v3-A: full demo-sala mirror, fresh quant, fla unpinned (control)"
# 等邮件
python3 /user_4813494d/openbmb/submit/submit.py /user_4813494d/openbmb/probe-sala-s2-v3-B.tar.gz "v3-B: same as v3-A but fla pinned to 0.4.1"
```

## 期望结果矩阵

| 实验 | quant | fla | 推理 | 期望 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 当前 P3（已跑） | BOS pre-quant | 0.4.2 | manual SSH eval | 不崩，79.51% ✓ |
| 当前 P4（跑着） | fresh-quant local | 0.4.2 | manual SSH eval | ? 等结果 |
| **v3-A** | fresh-quant 平台 | 0.4.2 | **平台 entrypoint** | **如崩 → 锁定 fresh+fla0.4.2+platform 组合** |
| **v3-B** | fresh-quant 平台 | **0.4.1** | 平台 entrypoint | 如不崩 → **fla 0.4.2 = 元凶** ✓ |

## 关键约束（重申）

- 提交的是 **probe-sala-s2.v3.tar.gz**，**不是 demo-sala**
- 用户 demo-sala 配额（每日 3 次）**完全不消耗**
- probe-sala-s2 配额另算（也是稀缺资源，但 AI 可用）
- AI 全程不调用 `submit.py` 上 demo-sala

**找到原因**：

```
10:50:13 [3c1893e9aa2e5a1f] new proxy [probe-sala-s2-ssh] error: proxy already exists
10:51:12 [702578d5554b6fc4] [probe-sala-s2-ssh] proxy closing  ← 老的死了
```

v3-A 的 frpc（控制 ID 3c1893e9...）在 10:50:13 尝试注册 `probe-sala-s2-ssh`，**老 frpc 还活着**(id 702578d5...)→**已存在**错误。然后 10:51:12 老的才死。

frpc 收到 "already exists" 后**不会自动重试 new_proxy**。需要从 frps admin API 强制 disconnect v3-A 的 client，让它重连重新注册。frps 在 127.0.0.1:7500 有 admin port。

> AGENT

老 `probe-sala-s2-ssh` proxy 在 frps 上是 **offline 但 name 占着**（clientID `702578d5554b6fc4` close at 10:51:12）。v3-A 的 frpc 拒绝注册后**不会主动重试**。

需要：(a) 强 disconnect v3-A 的 control conn 让它重连，(b) 删 offline proxy slot。试 frps admin API 看有没有 DELETE/kick：

> TOOL

tool_use Bash
```json
{
  "command": "ssh -i /user_4813494d/.ssh/id_ed25519_probe -o ConnectTimeout=5 user_4813494d@[REDACTED] 'CRED=\"admin:d5r5FSem7olRIDb9Y6NmIrh3\"\necho \"=== try various API delete/kick paths ===\"\nfor path in /api/proxy/probe-sala-s2-ssh /api/proxy/tcp/probe-sala-s2-ssh /api/client/kick/3c1893e9aa2e5a1f /api/client/3c1893e9aa2e5a1f /api/server/proxy/probe-sala-s2-ssh; do\n    for method in DELETE GET POST; do\n        rc=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" -u \"$CRED\" -X \"$method\" \"http://127.0.0.1:7500$path\")\n        [ \"$rc\" = \"200\" ] && echo \"$method $path -> 200\"\n        [ \"$rc\" = \"404\" ] || echo \"$method $path -> $rc\"\n    done\ndone\necho \"=== current connected v3-A control ===\"\nss -tnp 2>/dev/null | grep :7000 | head' 2>&1 | tail -25",

}
```
